en.title: DEA Background Check
en.description: DEA background check service
en.overview:
Screen individuals or entities against the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) watchlist using `documentType` and `documentNumber`, or `fullName`. The API returns whether a match was found and, when applicable, a URL to the official DEA record.

**Note:** Dates (date of birth or expedition date) must be in `dd/mm/yyyy` format.

params.description: The document type that you want to request.
Document number to consult, without spaces or points.
Instead of documentType and documentNumber, you can pass the name directly of the person/business.

es.title: Verificación de Antecedentes DEA
es.description: El servicio de verificación de antecedentes de DEA permite a los desarrolladores verificar si una persona o entidad aparece en la lista de vigilancia de la Administración de Control de Drogas de Estados Unidos (DEA). Al proporcionar el tipo de documento y número de documento, o el nombre completo, los usuarios pueden determinar rápidamente si el individuo u organización ha sido marcado por la DEA.
es.overview:
El servicio de verificación de antecedentes de DEA permite a los desarrolladores verificar si una persona o entidad aparece en la lista de vigilancia de la Administración de Control de Drogas de Estados Unidos (DEA). Al proporcionar el tipo de documento y número de documento, o el nombre completo, los usuarios pueden determinar rápidamente si el individuo u organización ha sido marcado por la DEA.

**Nota:** Las fechas (fecha de nacimiento o fecha de expedición) deben ir en formato dd/mm/yyyy.

El servicio retorna un indicador booleano que muestra si existe una coincidencia y, si es aplicable, incluye una URL que enlaza al registro oficial de la DEA.

Esta herramienta es esencial para el cumplimiento regulatorio y la mitigación de riesgos en industrias donde individuos o entidades pueden estar involucrados con sustancias controladas.

params.description: El tipo de documento que desea solicitar.
Número de documento a consultar, sin espacios ni puntos.
Descripción
En lugar de documentType y documentNumber, puede pasar el nombre directamente de la persona/empresa.

ko.title: 🌐 DEA 배경 조회
ko.description: DEA 배경 조회 서비스.
ko.overview:
`documentType`과 `documentNumber`, 또는 `fullName`을 사용해 미국 마약단속국(DEA) 감시 명단 대상으로 개인 또는 법인을 조회합니다. API는 일치 여부를 반환하며, 해당하는 경우 공식 DEA 기록의 URL도 함께 제공합니다.

**참고:** 날짜(출생일 또는 발급일)는 `dd/mm/yyyy` 형식이어야 합니다.

ja.title: DEA 身元照会
ja.description: 米国 DEA のウォッチリストとの照合サービス。

zh.title: DEA 背景核查
zh.description: 筛查美国缉毒局（DEA）观察名单。
zh.overview:
使用 `documentType` 与 `documentNumber`，或直接使用 `fullName`，对个人或机构在美国缉毒局（DEA）观察名单上进行筛查。该 API 会返回是否命中匹配，并在适用时返回指向 DEA 官方记录的 URL。

en.description: Temporarily unavailable — use U.S. vehicle lookup by VIN instead
en.overview:
:::info Temporarily unavailable
U.S. vehicle lookup by **license plate and state** (`GET /v2/usa/vehicle`) is temporarily disabled and is not available for new integrations.

Use **Vehicle by VIN** instead:

- **[United States - Vehicle by VIN](/vehicle-validation/united-states/vehicle-by-vin)** — `GET /v2/usa/vehicle-by-vin`
:::

This route previously accepted `plate` and `state` query parameters. Prefer the VIN endpoint while plate lookup remains offline.

en.title: RUNT - Driver's License (Premium)
en.description: Verify driver''s licenses in Colombia using the document number with the Verifik API. Omit primerApellido to pay Premium (name lookup included) or send it to pay the Basic rate.
en.overview:
Verifik's Driver's License Validation API allows you to query official information registered in Colombia's Registro Único Nacional de Tránsito (RUNT) using the driver's identification document number.

This integration is essential for transport companies, car rental agencies, insurers, and logistics platforms that need to verify the legal status and eligibility of drivers before hiring or authorizing vehicle use.

RUNT now authenticates drivers with the first last name (`primerApellido`) and may return masked names. This **v2** path still works without an integration change.

**Pricing from 1 September 2026 (America/Bogota):**

- Omit `primerApellido` — Verifik resolves the last name internally — **Premium** (conductor + name lookup). One history row.
- Send `primerApellido` — name lookup is skipped — **Basic** price (same as [`/v3/co/runt/conductor`](/vehicle-validation/colombia/runt-drivers-license-basic)). One history row.

Use the dedicated [Basic v3](/vehicle-validation/colombia/runt-drivers-license-basic) path if you always send `primerApellido` and want that requirement enforced.

When a document number query is made, the API returns updated data directly from RUNT, including:

-   Driver's full name and document details
-   License status (active, suspended, canceled)
-   License categories (e.g., B1, C1, A2)
-   Expiration dates for each category
-   Medical and aptitude certificate status
-   Traffic fines and infractions history (the official traffic infraction registry/RUNT)

This data enables verification of the driver's capability and legal standing to operate vehicles.

params.description: One of **`CC`**, **`CE`**, **`PA`**, **`PPT`**. See the table below — **`PA` is passport, `PPT` is not**.
Driver's document number, without spaces or periods.

First last name. **Required for `PA`**. Optional for `CC`, `CE`, and `PPT`. Omit it for **Premium** (Verifik resolves the name). Send it to skip the name lookup and pay **Basic**. the official disciplinary oversight authority and `/v2/co/cedula` cannot look up passport names.

es.title: Consulta de Licencia de Conducción por Cédula en RUNT (Premium) | Verifik API Colombia
es.description: Valida licencias de conducción en Colombia mediante el número de cédula. Omite primerApellido para pagar Premium (incluye consulta de nombre) o envíalo para pagar la tarifa Básica.
es.overview:
La API de validación de licencias de Verifik permite consultar información oficial registrada en el Registro Único Nacional de Tránsito (RUNT) de Colombia, utilizando el número de documento de identidad del conductor.

Esta integración es esencial para empresas de transporte, agencias de alquiler de vehículos, aseguradoras y plataformas logísticas que necesitan verificar el estado legal y la idoneidad de los conductores antes de la contratación o autorización de uso de vehículos.

RUNT ahora autentica al conductor con el primer apellido (`primerApellido`) y puede devolver nombres enmascarados. Esta ruta **v2** sigue funcionando sin cambios de integración.

**Tarifa desde el 1 de septiembre de 2026 (America/Bogota):**

- Omita `primerApellido` — Verifik resuelve el apellido internamente — **Premium** (conductor + consulta de nombre). Una fila en el historial.
- Envíe `primerApellido` — se omite la consulta de nombre — tarifa **Básica** (igual que [`/v3/co/runt/conductor`](/verifik-es/validacion-vehiculos/colombia/licencia-conducir-runt-basico)). Una fila en el historial.

Use la ruta [Básica v3](/verifik-es/validacion-vehiculos/colombia/licencia-conducir-runt-basico) si siempre envía `primerApellido` y quiere que sea obligatorio.

Al realizar una consulta por número de documento, la API retorna datos actualizados directamente del RUNT, incluyendo:

-   Nombre completo y datos del documento del conductor
-   Estado de la licencia (activa, suspendida, cancelada)
-   Categorías de la licencia (ej. B1, C1, A2)
-   Fechas de vencimiento por categoría
-   Estado de certificados médicos y de aptitud
-   Historial de multas e infracciones de tránsito

Estos datos permiten validar la capacidad y situación legal del conductor para operar vehículos.

params.description: Uno de **`CC`**, **`CE`**, **`PA`**, **`PPT`**. Vea la tabla — **`PA` es pasaporte, `PPT` no lo es**.
Número de documento del conductor, sin espacios ni puntos.

Primer apellido. **Obligatorio para `PA`**. Opcional para `CC`, `CE` y `PPT`. Omítalo para **Premium** (Verifik resuelve el nombre). Envíelo para omitir la consulta de nombre y pagar **Básico**. la entidad oficial de control disciplinario y `/v2/co/cedula` no consultan pasaportes.

en.title: SOAT and RTM Validation in RUNT
en.description: Verify the status of mandatory insurance (SOAT) and technical review (RTM) for vehicles in Colombia. Real-time API for traffic compliance.
en.overview:
Verifik's SOAT and RTM Validation API provides real-time access to the status of mandatory documents for vehicles registered in Colombia: the Mandatory Traffic Accident Insurance (SOAT) and the Mechanical Technical Review (RTM).

This service is critical for ensuring that vehicles comply with Colombian traffic regulations, helping to prevent fines and legal issues.

When a query is made using the license plate and owner's document, the API returns:

-   **SOAT Status**: Validity, policy number, insurer, issuance and expiration dates.
-   **RTM Status**: Validity, certificate number, diagnostic center, issuance and expiration dates.
-   **Vehicle Details**: Make, line, model, color, and registration status.
-   **Owner Verification**: Confirmation of the document number associated with the vehicle.

params.description: Document type. Allowed values are: CC, CE, PA, RC, NIT.
Document number of the owner of the vehicle, without spaces or periods.
Vehicle plate to consult.

<?php
require_once 'HTTP/Request2.php';
$request = new HTTP_Request2();
$request->setUrl('https://api.verifik.co/v2/co/runt/vehiculo?documentType=CC&documentNumber=&plate=');
$request->setMethod(HTTP_Request2::METHOD_GET);
$request->setConfig(array(
  'follow_redirects' => TRUE
));
$request->setHeader(array(
  'Content-Type' => 'text/plain'
));
$request->setBody('https://api.verifik.co/v2/co/runt/consultarVehiculo?documentType=CC&documentNumber=98622259&plate=KBU003');
try {
  $response = $request->send();
  if ($response->getStatus() == 200) {
    echo $response->getBody();
  }
  else {
    echo 'Unexpected HTTP status: ' . $response->getStatus() . ' ' .
    $response->getReasonPhrase();
  }
}
catch(HTTP_Request2_Exception $e) {
  echo 'Error: ' . $e->getMessage();
}

pt.title: RUNT — SOAT e RTM por placa
pt.description: Verifique SOAT e revisão técnico-mecânica (RTM) de veículos colombianos em tempo real.
pt.overview:
Verifik's SOAT and RTM Validation API provides real-time access to the status of mandatory documents for vehicles registered in Colombia: the Mandatory Traffic Accident Insurance (SOAT) and the Mechanical Technical Review (RTM).

This service is critical for ensuring that vehicles comply with Colombian traffic regulations, helping to prevent fines and legal issues.

When a query is made using the license plate and owner's document, the API returns:

-   **SOAT Status**: Validity, policy number, insurer, issuance and expiration dates.
-   **RTM Status**: Validity, certificate number, diagnostic center, issuance and expiration dates.
-   **Vehicle Details**: Make, line, model, color, and registration status.
-   **Owner Verification**: Confirmation of the document number associated with the vehicle.

en.title: \U0001F1E8\U0001F1F1 Chile - Vehicle Information
en.description: Verify a Chilean vehicle by license plate: technical data, fines flag, owner RUT when available—ideal for fleet, insurance, and asset checks.
en.overview:
Chilean vehicle validation service provides comprehensive verification capabilities for vehicle information. This service allows you to retrieve detailed information about vehicles registered in Chile.

Related Chile vehicle endpoints:

- **Vehicle Information (`v2/cl/vehicle`)**: commercial vehicle lookup (Reale / getapi). A **404** means the plate is not in that source—not an outage.
- **Vehicle Technical Review (`v3/cl/vehicle`)**: technical review status and inspection history. See [Chile - Vehicle Technical Review](/vehicle-validation/chile/vehicle-technical-review). Use this route for ficha técnica / revisión (`GET /v3/cl/vehicle`, not `/v2/cl/vehicle/v3`).
- **Vehicle SOAP (`v2/cl/vehicle-soap`)**: mandatory personal accident insurance certificate. See [Chile - Vehicle SOAP](/vehicle-validation/chile/vehicle-soap).

Query by **license plate** (`plate`, no spaces or dots). Typical fields include **make**, **model**, **year**, **VIN/chassis**, **engine**, **color**, **vehicle type**, **fines summary**, and **owner RUT** when the provider exposes them—use for **fleet onboarding**, **collateral checks**, and **claims** workflows. This is not official permiso de circulación; a valid plate can still 404 if it is missing from the commercial source.

es.title: 🇨🇱 Chile - Información de Vehículos
es.description: Consulta vehículo chileno por placa: datos técnicos, multas y RUT del titular cuando el registro lo expone—flotas, seguros y activos.
es.overview:
El servicio de validación de vehículos chilenos proporciona capacidades de verificación integrales para información vehicular. Este servicio te permite recuperar información detallada sobre vehículos registrados en Chile.

Endpoints vehiculares relacionados en Chile:

- **Información vehicular (`v2/cl/vehicle`)**: consulta comercial (Reale / getapi). Un **404** significa que la placa no está en esa fuente, no una caída del servicio.
- **Revisión técnica vehicular (`v3/cl/vehicle`)**: estado e historial de inspecciones técnicas. Ver [Chile - Revisión técnica vehicular](/verifik-es/validacion-vehiculos/chile/vehicle-technical-review). Usa esta ruta para ficha técnica / revisión (`GET /v3/cl/vehicle`, no `/v2/cl/vehicle/v3`).
- **SOAP vehicular (`v2/cl/vehicle-soap`)**: certificado de seguro obligatorio de accidentes personales. Ver [Chile - SOAP vehicular](/verifik-es/validacion-vehiculos/chile/vehicle-soap).

Consulta por **placa** (`plate`, sin espacios ni puntos). Suele devolver **marca**, **modelo**, **año**, **chasis/VIN**, **motor**, **color**, **tipo**, **resumen de multas** y **RUT del titular** si el proveedor lo expone—útil para **flotas**, **garantías** y **siniestros**. No es el permiso de circulación oficial; una placa válida puede responder 404 si no está en la fuente comercial.

ko.description: 번호판으로 칠레 차량을 검증합니다. 기술 데이터, 과태료 표시, 가용 시 소유자 RUT를 제공해 차량 운영, 보험, 자산 점검에 적합합니다.

칠레 차량 검증 서비스는 차량 정보에 대한 종합적인 검증 기능을 제공합니다. 본 서비스를 통해 칠레에 등록된 차량의 상세 정보를 조회할 수 있습니다.

관련 칠레 차량 endpoint:

- **차량 정보 (`v2/cl/vehicle`)**: 일반 차량 등록 정보.
- **차량 기술 검사 (`v3/cl/vehicle`)**: 기술 검사 상태와 이력. [칠레 - 차량 기술 검사](/verifik-ko/vehicle-validation/chile/vehicle-technical-review)를 참조하세요.
- **차량 SOAP (`v2/cl/vehicle-soap`)**: 의무 보험 증명서. [칠레 - 차량 SOAP](/verifik-ko/vehicle-validation/chile/vehicle-soap)를 참조하세요.

**번호판**(`plate`, 공백이나 점 없음)으로 조회합니다. 일반적으로 반환되는 필드에는 **제조사**, **모델**, **연식**, **VIN/차대 번호**, **엔진**, **색상**, **차량 종류**, **과태료 요약**, 그리고 등기소가 노출하는 경우 **소유자 RUT** 가 포함됩니다. **차량 운영 온보딩**, **담보 점검**, **보험금 청구** 워크플로우에 활용할 수 있습니다.

ja.overview:
チリの車両検証サービスは、車両情報の包括的な検証機能を提供します。本サービスでは、チリで登録された車両に関する詳細情報を取得できます。

- **車両情報 (`v2/cl/vehicle`)**: 一般的な車両登録情報。

en.title: Vehicle Records by VIN
en.description: Query vehicle information in Colombia using the VIN (Vehicle Identification Number). Connect to the RUNT and obtain complete official data.
en.overview:
Verifik’s Vehicle Validation by VIN API allows you to query the complete history and technical specifications of a vehicle registered in Colombia using its Vehicle Identification Number (VIN).

This method is particularly useful when the license plate is unavailable or when verifying the authenticity of a vehicle's identity during inspections, as the VIN is a unique, tamper-resistant identifier.

When a VIN query is made, the API returns comprehensive data from RUNT, including:

-   Detailed technical specifications (engine, chassis, weight, axles)
-   Vehicle make, model, line, and color
-   Current legal status (Active, Cancelled)
-   Insurance history (SOAT) and Technical Inspection (RTM) status
-   Insurer and policy type (Contractual or Extra-contractual Civil Liability, not comprehensive / todo riesgo).
-   Ownership limitations and active alerts
-   Accident and claim history (if available)

This data is crucial for detecting cloned vehicles and validating technical compliance.

params.description: 17-character VIN to query (no spaces; letters and digits as registered in RUNT).

}

}
?>

es.title: Registros de Vehículos por VIN en RUNT
es.description: Verifica el historial y especificaciones técnicas de vehículos en Colombia usando el VIN. Detecta fraudes y valida la identidad vehicular con datos oficiales del RUNT.
es.overview:
La API de Validación Vehicular por VIN de Verifik permite consultar el historial completo y las especificaciones técnicas de un vehículo registrado en Colombia utilizando su Número de Identificación Vehicular (VIN).

Este método es particularmente útil cuando no se dispone de la placa o para verificar la autenticidad de la identidad de un vehículo durante inspecciones, ya que el VIN es un identificador único y difícil de alterar.

Al realizar una consulta por VIN, la API retorna datos exhaustivos del RUNT, incluyendo:

-   Especificaciones técnicas detalladas (motor, chasis, peso, ejes)
-   Marca, modelo, línea y color del vehículo
-   Estado legal actual (Activo, Cancelado)
-   Historial de seguros (SOAT) y Revisión Técnico-Mecánica (RTM)
-   Aseguradora y tipo de Pólizas (Responsabilidad Civil Contractual o Extracontractual, no todo riesgo).
-   Limitaciones a la propiedad y alertas activas
-   Historial de accidentes y reclamaciones (si está disponible)

Estos datos son cruciales para detectar vehículos gemeleados y validar el cumplimiento técnico.

params.description: VIN del vehículo del que quieres verificar datos.

en.title: Brazilian Citizen
en.description: Validate the identity of individuals in Brazil with Verifik's KYC API. Connect with official sources and verify personal data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's Identity Verification API helps you authenticate Brazilian citizens using the Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas (CPF). It's designed to streamline your KYC (Know Your Customer) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the true identity of users, employees, or customers.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Full Name & CPF Number**: Supports *Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas* (CPF).
-   **Identity Match**: Confirms that the name provided matches the CPF number.
-   **Date of Birth Verification**: Validates the date of birth matches the official records.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the person you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

Confirms a Brazilian natural person’s **CPF** against official sources. Provide **CPF**, **date of birth** in `DD/MM/YYYY`, and the document number with or without separators; when the data matches, the response returns normalized name parts and identifiers. Built for **KYC**, **fraud prevention**, and **regulated onboarding**.

CPF number (with or without separators).
Date of birth in `DD/MM/YYYY` format.

notes: CPF must be valid; date of birth is required and must match.
**Fintech & Banking**: Verify identities instantly during account opening or loan applications.
**E-commerce & Delivery**: Authenticate users and couriers before they become active on your platform.
**HR & Recruitment**: Validate candidate documents as part of your hiring workflow.
**Insurance & Healthcare**: Confirm identities before issuing policies or providing medical benefits.
**Automated Compliance**: Streamline your KYC checks to prevent fraud without adding friction for your users.
**Instant Results**: Process verifications in seconds, perfect for real-time digital onboarding.
**Trusted Data**: Rely on data sourced directly from official records.
**Easy Integration**: Connect easily via our REST API or use our compatible SDKs.

es.title: Ciudadano Brasileño
es.description: Valida la identidad de personas en Brasil con la API KYC de Verifik. Conecta con fuentes oficiales y verifica datos personales en segundos.
es.overview:
La API de Verificación de Identidad de Verifik te ayuda a autenticar ciudadanos brasileños usando el Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas (CPF). Está diseñada para agilizar tus procesos de KYC (Conozca a su Cliente), prevenir fraudes y asegurar el cumplimiento normativo sin complicaciones.

Creamos esta integración para empresas que necesitan una forma rápida, segura y automatizada de confirmar la verdadera identidad de usuarios, empleados o clientes.

Nuestra API se conecta directamente con registros oficiales para validar:

-   **Nombre Completo y Número CPF**: Soporta *Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas* (CPF).
-   **Coincidencia de Identidad**: Verifica que el nombre proporcionado coincida con el número CPF.
-   **Verificación de Fecha de Nacimiento**: Valida que la fecha de nacimiento coincida con los registros oficiales.

Al verificar estos detalles, puedes tener la certeza de que la persona con la que tratas es real y posee un documento válido, reduciendo significativamente el riesgo de suplantación y fraude.

Confirma el **CPF** de una persona física en Brasil contra fuentes oficiales. Envía **CPF**, **fecha de nacimiento** en `DD/MM/YYYY` y el número de documento con o sin separadores; si los datos coinciden, la respuesta devuelve nombres e identificadores normalizados. Pensado para **KYC**, **prevención de fraude** y **onboarding regulado**.

params.description: Tipo de documento. Valor permitido: `CPF`.

endpoints.descriptionES: Valida la identidad de personas en Colombia con la API KYC de Verifik. Conecta con fuentes oficiales y verifica datos personales en segundos.

en.overview:
Verifik's Identity Verification API helps you authenticate Colombian citizens using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYC (Know Your Customer) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the true identity of users, employees, or customers.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Full Name & ID Number**: *Cédula de Ciudadanía* (**CC**) and *Permiso por Protección Temporal* (**PPT**) on this endpoint — not **CE** (use dedicated CE endpoints for foreign ID).
-   **Document Status**: Checks the current status in the *the official national civil registry* database.
-   **Issuance & Validity**: Verifies the date of issuance and whether the document is currently valid.
-   **Identity Match**: Confirms that the name provided matches the ID number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the person you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

Same path: `GET https://verifik.app/v2/co/cedula`. **`POST`** with the same fields is also supported.

Creamos esta integración para empresas que necesitan una forma rápida, segura y automatizada de confirmar la verdadera identidad de usuarios, empleados o clientes.

-   **Coincidencia de Identidad**: Verifica que el nombre proporcionado coincida con el número de identificación.

Al verificar estos detalles, puedes tener la certeza de que la persona con la que tratas es real y posee un documento válido, reduciendo significativamente el riesgo de suplantación y fraude.

en.title: Colombia — RETHUS (health professionals registry)
en.description: Query the Colombian RETHUS registry for health-sector talent data via GET /v2/co/cedula/rethus.
en.overview:
Verifik confirms identity against **RETHUS** (*Registro Único Nacional de Talento Humano en Salud*) using **`documentType`** and **`documentNumber`**. The flow first resolves the person via the Colombian citizen lookup, then queries RETHUS for **registry status**, **academic** qualifications, and **social security / benefit (SSO)** rows when the source returns them.

Use this endpoint for **credentialing**, **compliance**, and **workforce** checks where RETHUS data is permitted.

- **Identity** fields from the underlying citizen match (name parts, document type/number)
- **`rethus.status`** — registry status text from the RETHUS result grid
- **`rethus.academic`** — array of academic/professional rows (type, degree origin, profession, dates, entity, etc.) when present
- **`rethus.dataSSO`** — benefit / modality / entity rows when present
- A **signed** Verifik response

Same fields may be sent in a **`POST`** JSON body. **`GET`** uses **query parameters** as below.

Query-only summary: **`documentType`**, **`documentNumber`**.

params.description: Document number without spaces or punctuation (length **5–15**).

requestExamples.label: JavaScript
Python

notes: RETHUS is queried **after** a successful citizen match; if the person cannot be resolved upstream, you may see **404** or other errors.
**`rethus.academic`** and **`rethus.dataSSO`** may be **empty arrays** when the portal returns no rows.
Captcha or source outages can surface as **5xx** or **`Endpoint_out_of_service`**-style errors depending on handling.
Treat responses as **sensitive personal data**; comply with Colombian health-privacy rules.

en.title: Colombia — Cédula PDF417 Barcode Verification
en.description: Real-time official verification and background screening for Colombia.
en.overview:
Read the **PDF417 barcode** printed on the **reverse** of a Colombian *cédula de ciudadanía* (CC). Use this endpoint when you already have a capture of the back of the card and want machine-readable identity fields from the barcode, with optional fuzzy matching against values you collected elsewhere (OCR, user input, or a prior official identity lookup).

This is **not** an official civil registry or disciplinary oversight authority lookup. For official name resolution by document number, use the official identity verification endpoints.

:::important Anti-Fraud & Document Alteration Detection
This endpoint is specifically engineered as a **critical anti-fraud mechanism**. In real-world fraud scenarios, bad actors commonly modify the printed text or photo on the front of a cédula, but are unable to forge the proprietary 2D PDF417 barcode on the back. Cross-checking the barcode against front OCR exposes physical tampering immediately (**`verdict: "mismatch"`**). Furthermore, any attempt to tamper with or smudge the barcode itself breaks its Reed-Solomon error correction codewords, causing the read to fail completely (**`verdict: "unreadable"`**).
:::

Same path on the app host: `POST https://verifik.app/v2/co/cedula/barcode`.

params.description: Back of the cédula as base64 (with or without data-URI prefix) or HTTPS URL.
CC, CO:1993_CC, or CO:DIGITAL_CC. Defaults to CC.
Optional cross-check against the barcode document number.
Optional cross-check against barcode given names.
Optional cross-check against barcode surnames.
Optional object with documentNumber, firstName, lastName, gender, dateOfBirth, bloodType.

requestExamples.label: cURL
requestExamples.code:
curl -X POST "https://api.verifik.co/v2/co/cedula/barcode" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"

response = requests.post('https://api.verifik.co/v2/co/cedula/barcode', headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer <token>', 'Accept': 'application/json'})
print(response.json())

Production responses include signed cryptographic verification stamps.
Rate limits apply per client tier.

es.title: Colombia — Verificación de Código de Barras PDF417 (Cédula)
es.description: Verificación oficial en tiempo real y consulta para Colombia.
es.overview:
Lee el **código de barras PDF417** impreso en el **reverso** de una *cédula de ciudadanía* (CC) colombiana. Usa este endpoint cuando ya tienes una captura del dorso y necesitas los campos de identidad codificados en el código, con comparación opcional contra datos que obtuviste por OCR, formulario o una consulta previa de identidad.

**No** es una consulta de identidad ante la fuente oficial de registro civil o la entidad oficial de control disciplinario. Para resolver nombres oficiales por número de documento, use los servicios de consulta oficial de ciudadanos.

:::important Prevención de Fraude y Detección de Alteraciones
Este endpoint está diseñado específicamente como un **mecanismo crítico contra el fraude de identidad**. En intentos de suplantación, los atacantes suelen alterar el texto impreso o la foto en el frente de la cédula, pero no pueden falsificar el código de barras bidimensional PDF417 del reverso. Al contrastar el código contra el OCR del frente, cualquier manipulación física queda en evidencia de inmediato (**`verdict: "mismatch"`**).
:::

ja.title: コロンビア — 本人確認 (KYC)
ja.description: コロンビアの公式データベースによるリアルタイム確認・照会。
ja.overview:
Read the **PDF417 barcode** printed on the **reverse** of a Colombian *cédula de ciudadanía* (CC). Use this endpoint when you already have a capture of the back of the card and want machine-readable identity fields from the barcode, with optional fuzzy matching against values you collected elsewhere (OCR, user input, or a prior official identity lookup).

This is **not** an official civil registry or disciplinary oversight authority lookup. For official name resolution by document number, use the official identity verification endpoints.

:::important Anti-Fraud & Document Alteration Detection
This endpoint is specifically engineered as a **critical anti-fraud mechanism**. In real-world fraud scenarios, bad actors commonly modify the printed text or photo on the front of a cédula, but are unable to forge the proprietary 2D PDF417 barcode on the back. Cross-checking the barcode against front OCR exposes physical tampering immediately (**`verdict: "mismatch"`**). Furthermore, any attempt to tamper with or smudge the barcode itself breaks its Reed-Solomon error correction codewords, causing the read to fail completely (**`verdict: "unreadable"`**).
:::

Same path on the app host: `POST https://verifik.app/v2/co/cedula/barcode`.

params.description: Back of the cédula as base64 (with or without data-URI prefix) or HTTPS URL.
CC, CO:1993_CC, or CO:DIGITAL_CC. Defaults to CC.
Optional cross-check against the barcode document number.
Optional cross-check against barcode given names.
Optional cross-check against barcode surnames.
Optional object with documentNumber, firstName, lastName, gender, dateOfBirth, bloodType.

en.title: Colombia — ADRES (BDUA affiliation)
en.description: Query Colombian ADRES / BDUA health affiliation status via GET /v2/co/adres.
en.overview:
Verifik queries **ADRES** (*Administradora de los Recursos del Sistema General de Seguridad Social en Salud*) / **BDUA** affiliation status using **`documentType`** and **`documentNumber`**.

Use this endpoint when you need **EPS affiliation**, **regime**, and **status** from ADRES/BDUA. It is **not** the same as [`GET /v2/co/afiliaciones`](/legal/verify-colombian-affiliations), which returns a broader RUAF/SISPRO social-security bundle (EPS, ARL, pension, cajas, cesantías) and requires a document issue **`date`**.

- **Identity** fields when present (`firstName`, `lastName`, `fullName`, `arrayName`, document type/number)
- **Location** (`department`, `municipality`) when returned by the source
- **`affiliations`** — array of affiliation rows with `status`, `entity` (EPS), `regime`, `effectiveDate`, `endDate`, `affiliationType`
- A **signed** Verifik response

This endpoint is **GET-only** (query parameters).

en.title: Venezuelan Citizen (CCVE)

en.overview:
Verifik's Identity Verification API helps you authenticate Venezuelan citizens using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYC (Know Your Customer) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the true identity of users, employees, or customers.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Full Name & Document Number**: Supports Venezuelan identity documents (CCVE).
-   **Identity Match**: Confirms that the name provided matches the document number.
-   **Optional Personal Details**: May include date of birth, gender, and marital status when available.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the person you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

This route returns identity data for **Venezuelan nationals** using the **CCVE** (*Cédula de Identidad*) document class. Send the cédula number as **`documentNumber`**; the API resolves the record and returns structured name fields for **KYC**, onboarding, and fraud checks. For **foreign residents**, use [`GET /v2/ve/foreigner-id`](/identity/venezuela-foreigner-id) (CEVE) instead.

사용자, 직원, 고객의 진짜 신원을 빠르고 안전하게 자동으로 확인해야 하는 비즈니스를 위해 만들어졌습니다.

당사의 API는 공식 기록과 직접 연결되어 다음을 검증합니다.

-   **전체 성명 및 문서 번호**: 베네수엘라 신분증(CCVE)을 지원합니다.
-   **신원 일치 여부**: 제공된 이름이 문서 번호와 일치하는지 확인합니다.
-   **선택적 개인 상세 정보**: 출생일, 성별, 혼인 상태가 가용할 경우 포함될 수 있습니다.

Verifik の本人確認 API は、公的な政府データを利用してベネズエラ市民を認証します。KYC（Know Your Customer）プロセスの効率化、不正防止、各種規制要件への対応を簡単に実現できるよう設計されています。

ユーザー、従業員、顧客の真の本人性を、迅速・安全・自動的に確認したいビジネス向けに構築しました。

本 API は公式記録と直接接続し、以下を検証します。

-   **氏名と文書番号**: ベネズエラの身分証（CCVE）に対応します。
-   **本人一致**: 入力された氏名が文書番号と一致するかを確認します。
-   **任意の個人情報**: 利用可能な場合、生年月日、性別、配偶者の有無を含む場合があります。

これらを検証することで、相手が実在し有効な文書を保有していることを確認でき、なりすましや不正のリスクを大幅に低減できます。

本ルートは、**CCVE**（*Cédula de Identidad*）の文書クラスを用いて、**ベネズエラ国民** の本人情報を返します。cédula 番号を **`documentNumber`** に指定すると、API はレコードを解決し、**KYC**、オンボーディング、不正防止に活用できる構造化された氏名フィールドを返します。**外国人居住者** の場合は [`GET /v2/ve/foreigner-id`](/identity/venezuela-foreigner-id)（CEVE）を使用してください。

params.description: 国民 cédula 番号（CCVE）。`documentType` クエリは不要で、このエンドポイントでは **CCVE** が自動的に適用されます。

zh.title: 委内瑞拉公民（CCVE）
zh.description: 委内瑞拉国民身份查询 — 通过 GET /v2/ve/cedula 按证件号核验 cédula（CCVE）持有人，适用于 KYC 与反欺诈。
zh.overview:
Verifik 的身份核验 API 可基于政府官方数据对委内瑞拉公民进行身份核实。该接口旨在简化您的 KYC（了解您的客户）流程、防范欺诈，并轻松满足合规要求。

我们专为需要快速、安全且自动化确认用户、员工或客户真实身份的企业打造此集成。

我们的 API 直接对接官方记录，验证以下内容：

-   **姓名全称与证件号码**：支持委内瑞拉身份证件（CCVE）。
-   **身份匹配**：确认所提供姓名与证件号码相符。
-   **可选个人详情**：在数据可用时可包含出生日期、性别与婚姻状态。

通过验证这些信息，您可以确信对接的人员真实存在并持有有效证件，从而显著降低身份冒用与欺诈风险。

该接口面向**委内瑞拉本国公民**，使用 **CCVE**（*Cédula de Identidad*）证件类别返回身份数据。请将 cédula 号码作为 **`documentNumber`** 传入；API 会查询记录并返回结构化的姓名字段，适用于 **KYC**、客户开通与反欺诈核查。如需核验**外国居民**，请改用 [`GET /v2/ve/foreigner-id`](/identity/venezuela-foreigner-id)（CEVE）。

en.title: Mexico — ISSSTE Social Security Affiliation
en.description: Verify Mexican public sector social security affiliation (ISSSTE) and official non-affiliation certificates by CURP, including labor status, official folio, certificate UUID, and digital seal.
en.overview:
Verifik's **Mexico ISSSTE Affiliation API** allows organizations, employers, and compliance teams to verify a citizen's public sector social security affiliation status and retrieve official non-affiliation certificates directly using an 18-character **CURP** (*Clave Única de Registro de Población*):

- **Labor Status Verification**: Determines whether the person is currently active (*ACTIVO*), inactive with historical records (*INACTIVO*), or unlocated (*NO LOCALIZADO*) in the federal public sector social security registry.
- **Certified Digital Details**: Extracts the official certificate metadata, including barcode folio number, unique identifier (UUID), issuance timestamp, and cryptographic digital seal.
- **Official Signed PDF Document**: Generates and downloads the official digitally signed PDF certificate (*Constancia de Acreditación de No Afiliación*) encoded as Base64 when requested (`includePdf=true`).
- **Federal Demographic Validation**: Validates and returns the citizen's official legal name parsed into `firstName`, `paternalSurname`, `maternalSurname`, `dateOfBirth`, `sex`, and `gender`.

---

- **Affiliation Status (`affiliationStatus`)**: Reports whether the individual has an active public sector labor relationship with the Mexican government (`ACTIVO`), previously worked in the federal public sector but is now inactive (`INACTIVO`), or has never had registered contributions (`NO LOCALIZADO`).

es.title: México — Acreditación de Afiliación ISSSTE
es.description: Consulta la acreditación de afiliación o no afiliación al ISSSTE por CURP, incluyendo estatus laboral (activo, inactivo, no localizado), folio oficial, UUID del certificado y sello digital.
es.overview:
La **API de Afiliación al ISSSTE en México** de Verifik permite a empresas, departamentos de recursos humanos y plataformas de cumplimiento verificar el estatus laboral de un ciudadano en el sector público federal y descargar la constancia oficial de no afiliación directamente con su **CURP** (*Clave Única de Registro de Población*):

- **Verificación de Estatus Laboral**: Determina si la persona se encuentra cotizando como trabajadora del sector público federal (*ACTIVO*), si cuenta con registros históricos pero actualmente está inactiva (*INACTIVO*), o si no figura en los registros de derechohabientes (*NO LOCALIZADO*).
- **Metadatos Oficiales Certificados**: Extrae el folio de registro del código de barras, identificador único (UUID), fecha/hora exacta de emisión y sello digital criptográfico.
- **Descarga de Constancia en PDF**: Genera y descarga la **Constancia de Acreditación de No Afiliación** oficial firmada digitalmente por el ISSSTE en formato Base64 cuando se solicita (`includePdf=true`).
- **Validación Demográfica Federal**: Confirma la identidad oficial del titular ante RENAPO desglosando `firstName`, `paternalSurname`, `maternalSurname`, `dateOfBirth`, `sex` y `gender`.

---

- **Estatus de Afiliación (`affiliationStatus`)**: Retorna con precisión el vínculo laboral del ciudadano con el Estado mexicano:
  - `ACTIVO`: Cotizando actualmente como servidor público.
  - `INACTIVO`: Con historial laboral previo en el sector público federal pero actualmente dado de baja.
  - `NO LOCALIZADO`: Sin antecedentes de afiliación en el padrón de derechohabientes.
- **Confirmación Demográfica**: Valida la identidad del titular y retorna sus atributos normalizados: `firstName`, `lastName`, `paternalSurname`, `maternalSurname`, `dateOfBirth` (`AAAA-MM-DD`), `sex` y `gender`.
- **Certificación Digital (`certificate`)**:
  - `folio`: Folio oficial emitido junto al código de barras (ej. `082611565`).
  - `uuid`: Identificador único criptográfico de la constancia.
  - `issuedAt`: Marca de tiempo oficial de la emisión.
  - `digitalSeal`: Sello digital que certifica la validez legal del documento.
  - `pdfBase64`: (Opcional) El archivo PDF oficial completo codificado en Base64.
- **Firma Criptográfica Verifik**: Cada respuesta es firmada digitalmente para garantizar la integridad y trazabilidad de la consulta.

en.title: Mexico — CURP
en.description: Validate the identity of individuals in Mexico using CURP with Verifik's KYC API. Connect with official sources and verify personal data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's Identity Verification API helps you authenticate Mexican citizens using the Unique Population Registry Code (CURP). It's designed to streamline your KYC (Know Your Customer) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the true identity of users, employees, or customers.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Full Name & CURP**: Supports *Clave Única de Registro de Población* (CURP).
-   **Personal Details**: Returns date of birth, gender, and nationality.
-   **Identity Match**: Confirms that the name provided matches the CURP number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the person you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

This endpoint verifies a Mexican national’s **CURP** (*Clave Única de Registro de Población*) against official records. Send `documentType` and `documentNumber` on a GET request; a successful response confirms the identity record and returns validated name and biographical fields when the CURP is recognized.

requestExamples.label: JavaScript
Python
requestExamples.code:
conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.verifik.co")
payload = ''
headers = {}
conn.request("GET", "/v2/co/procuraduria/antecedentes?documentType=CC&documentNumber=", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))

requestExamples.label: Swift
PHP
requestExamples.code:
<?php
require_once 'HTTP/Request2.php';
$request = new HTTP_Request2();
$request->setUrl('https://api.verifik.co/v2/co/procuraduria/antecedentes?documentType=CC&documentNumber=');
$request->setMethod(HTTP_Request2::METHOD_GET);
$request->setConfig(array(
  'follow_redirects' => TRUE
));
try {
  $response = $request->send();
  if ($response->getStatus() == 200) {
    echo $response->getBody();
  }
  else {
    echo 'Unexpected HTTP status: ' . $response->getStatus() . ' ' .
    $response->getReasonPhrase();
  }
}
catch(HTTP_Request2_Exception $e) {
  echo 'Error: ' . $e->getMessage();
}

Verifik's Identity Verification API helps you authenticate Costa Rican citizens using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYC (Know Your Customer) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the true identity of users, employees, or customers.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Full Name & CCCR Number**: Supports *Cédula de Identidad Costarricense* (CCCR).
-   **Identity Match**: Confirms that the name provided matches the CCCR number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the person you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

This endpoint verifies the **CCCR** (*Cédula de Identidad Costarricense*) against official sources. zh.title: 哥斯达黎加公民（CCCR）
zh.description: 通过 GET /v2/cr/cedula 与 documentType、documentNumber 在哥斯达黎加进行 CCCR 国民身份证核验，适用于 KYC 与反欺诈。
zh.overview:
Verifik 的身份核验 API 可基于政府官方数据对哥斯达黎加公民进行身份核实。该接口旨在简化您的 KYC（了解您的客户）流程、防范欺诈，并轻松满足合规要求。

我们专为需要快速、安全且自动化确认用户、员工或客户真实身份的企业打造此集成。

我们的 API 直接对接官方记录，验证以下内容：

-   **姓名全称与 CCCR 号码**：支持 *Cédula de Identidad Costarricense*（CCCR）。
-   **身份匹配**：确认所提供姓名与 CCCR 号码相符。

通过验证这些信息，您可以确信对接的人员真实存在并持有有效证件，从而显著降低身份冒用与欺诈风险。

该接口基于官方数据源核验 **CCCR**（*Cédula de Identidad Costarricense*）。请通过 GET 请求传入 **`documentType`** 为 `CCCR` 与 **`documentNumber`**（不含空格的 cédula 号码）；响应包含结构化的姓名字段，适用于 **KYC**、客户开通与反欺诈核查。

params.description: 证件类型。允许取值：`CCCR`。
不含空格的 cédula 号码。

requestExamples.label: Node.js
PHP
requestExamples.code:
<?php
$ch = curl_init("https://api.verifik.co/v2/cr/cedula");
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
    "Accept: application/json",
    "Authorization: Bearer " . getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN")
]);
$query = http_build_query([
    "documentType" => "CCCR",
    "documentNumber" => "010000001"
]);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, "https://api.verifik.co/v2/cr/cedula?".$query);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
$response = curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);
echo $response;

requestExamples.label: Python
Go
requestExamples.code:
package main

    "fmt"
    "net/http"
)

func main() {
    url := "https://api.verifik.co/v2/cr/cedula?documentType=CCCR&documentNumber=010000001"
    req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", url, nil)
    req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN"))
    resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    fmt.Println(resp.Status)
}

en.title: Business Verification (CNPJ)
en.description: Validate Brazilian companies with Verifik's KYB API. Connect with official sources and verify business data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's Business Verification API helps you authenticate Brazilian companies using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYB (Know Your Business) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the legitimacy of companies, partners, or vendors.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Company Name & CNPJ Number**: Supports *Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica* (CNPJ).
-   **Business Information**: Returns company name, legal nature, opening date, status, and address.
-   **Economic Activities**: Provides main and secondary activity codes and descriptions.
-   **Company Match**: Confirms that the company information matches the CNPJ number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the company you're dealing with is legitimate and properly registered, significantly lowering the risk of fraud and ensuring compliance.

Verifies a Brazilian legal entity against official **CNPJ** registers. Send `documentType=CNPJ` and a 14-digit `documentNumber` with no punctuation. Typical fields include registration status, address, legal nature, and primary and secondary economic activities. Use it for **KYB**, **vendor due diligence**, and **compliance** programs.

params.description: Document type. Allowed value: `CNPJ`.
14-digit CNPJ without separators.

ko.overview:
Verifik 기업 검증 API는 공식 정부 데이터로 브라질 기업을 인증합니다. KYB 프로세스, 사기 방지, 규제 준수를 지원하도록 설계되었습니다.

공식 기록과 연결하여 다음을 검증합니다.

- **상호 및 CNPJ 번호**: *Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica*(CNPJ)를 지원합니다.

- **경제 활동**: 주·부업종 코드와 설명을 제공합니다.
- **일치 여부**: 기업 정보가 CNPJ 번호와 일치하는지 확인합니다.

브라질 법인을 공식 **CNPJ** 등기와 대조합니다. `documentType=CNPJ`와 구분 기호 없는 14자리 `documentNumber`를 전달합니다. 일반적으로 등기 상태, 주소, 법적 성격, 주·부 경제 활동 등이 포함됩니다. **KYB**, **공급업체 실사**, **컴플라이언스**에 활용하세요.

en.title: Colombia Legal Invoicer Verification
en.description: Validate legal invoicer registration in DIAN for Colombian companies with Verifik's KYB API.
en.overview:
Verifik's Legal Invoicer Verification API helps you validate whether a Colombian company has a legal invoicer registered in DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales). It's designed to streamline your KYB (Know Your Business) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the invoicer registration status of Colombian companies, partners, or vendors.

Our API connects directly with official DIAN records to validate:

-   **Company NIT & electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) registration**: Supports *Número de Identificación Tributaria* (NIT).
-   **Invoicer contact**: Returns the registered invoicer **email** and related fields when DIAN exposes them.
-   **Registration check**: Confirms that the entity appears in DIAN’s **legal invoicer** dataset for electronic invoicing (distinct from general taxpayer status — see [Colombia DIAN Verification](../colombia-dian-verification.mdx)).

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the company you're dealing with has proper invoicing capabilities and is compliant with DIAN requirements, significantly lowering the risk of fraud and ensuring compliance.

Same path on the app host: `GET https://verifik.app/v2/co/company/dian/invoicer`.

params.description: Must be **`NIT`**.
Tax ID (NIT). Spaces are removed server-side; you may include or omit the verification digit. Minimum length **5** characters (API validation).

requestExamples.label: Node.js
Python

notes: **`GET` query only** — no body. Use **`Accept`** (not `Content-Type`) for JSON responses.

When the service is temporarily unavailable, the API returns **409** with `code: "Conflict"` and `message: "The service is temporarily unavailable, please try again later."` That response is not billed. A record that does not exist stays **404**.

This route returns **legal invoicer / e-invoicing registration** data (e.g. **email** when available). For **general taxpayer** status and obligations, use **[Colombia DIAN Verification](../colombia-dian-verification.mdx)** (`GET /v2/co/company/dian`).
**404** may occur when DIAN does not return invoicer **email** for that NIT (see integration logic).
**B2B Onboarding**: Verify companies instantly during partner or vendor registration.
**Financial Services**: Authenticate businesses before opening accounts or processing transactions.
**Compliance & Due Diligence**: Validate company invoicer registration as part of your KYC/KYB workflows.
**E-commerce & Marketplaces**: Confirm business invoicing capabilities before allowing companies to sell on your platform.
**Automated Compliance**: Streamline your KYB checks to prevent fraud without adding friction for your business partners.
**Instant Results**: Process verifications in seconds, perfect for real-time business onboarding.
**Trusted Data**: Rely on data sourced directly from official tax authority records.
**Easy Integration**: Connect easily via our REST API or use our compatible SDKs.

-   **NIT de l'entreprise et enregistrement de facturation électronique** : prend en charge le *Número de Identificación Tributaria* (NIT).

en.title: Colombia - Public Contracts

The Public Contracts service allows users to retrieve a list of public contracts associated with a person or company by providing their document number and document type. This service promotes transparency and facilitates the monitoring of public contracts with the state in Colombia.

en.title: Colombia - Verify Police Compliance with Corrective Measures
en.description: Verify police compliance with corrective measures. The caller supplies the expedition date. Costs 0.30 credits and accepts CC, CE, PPT, and PA.
en.overview:
The Police RNMC service checks whether a person has pending corrective measures. You send the document type, document number, and the document expedition date.

**Cost: 0.30 credits.** Accepted document types: `CC`, `CE`, `PPT`, and `PA`.

If you have a Colombian citizenship card (`CC`) and do not want to send the expedition date, use [Police RNMC premium](/background-check/colombia-police-compliance-corrective-measures-premium). That lookup costs **1.20 credits** and returns the same corrective-measures result.

This service helps ensure that individuals comply with corrective measures and supports informed decision-making based on their compliance status.

es.title: Colombia - Verificar Cumplimiento Policial con Medidas Correctivas
es.description: Consulta RNMC de la Policía. El cliente envía la fecha de expedición. Cuesta 0.30 créditos y acepta CC, CE, PPT y PA.
es.overview:
El servicio RNMC de Policía verifica si una persona tiene medidas correctivas pendientes. Tú envías el tipo de documento, el número de documento y la fecha de expedición.

**Costo: 0.30 créditos.** Tipos de documento aceptados: `CC`, `CE`, `PPT` y `PA`.

Si tienes una cédula de ciudadanía (`CC`) y no quieres enviar la fecha de expedición, usa [RNMC de la Policía premium](/verifik-es/verificacion-antecendentes/verificacion-antecendentes-colombia-cumplimiento-policial-premium). Esa consulta cuesta **1.20 créditos** y devuelve el mismo resultado de medidas correctivas.

Este servicio ayuda a asegurar que los individuos cumplan con las medidas correctivas y apoya la toma de decisiones informadas basadas en su estatus de cumplimiento.

Número de documento de la persona a consultar, sin espacios ni puntos.
Fecha de expedición del documento. Formato válido: DD/MM/YYYY.

en.title: Colombia DIAN Verification
en.description: Validate Colombian companies' DIAN status with Verifik's KYB API. Connect with official sources and verify tax authority data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's DIAN Verification API helps you authenticate Colombian companies' tax authority status using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYB (Know Your Business) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the tax status and legitimacy of Colombian companies, partners, or vendors.

Our API connects directly with official DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) records to validate:

-   **Company Name & NIT Number**: Supports *Número de Identificación Tributaria* (NIT).
-   **Tax Status**: Returns the company's registration status with DIAN.
-   **Company Match**: Confirms that the company information matches the NIT number and validates active tax responsibilities.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the company you're dealing with is legitimate, properly registered with the tax authority, and has active tax responsibilities, significantly lowering the risk of fraud and ensuring compliance.

Same path on the app host: `GET https://verifik.app/v2/co/company/dian`.

params.description: Must be **`NIT`**.
Tax ID (NIT). Spaces are removed server-side; you may include or omit the verification digit. Minimum length **5** characters (API validation).

requestExamples.label: Node.js
Python

responses.label: 200 - Company
200 - Natural Person

notes: **`GET` query only** — no body. Use **`Accept`** (not `Content-Type`) for JSON responses.

When the service is temporarily unavailable, the API returns **409** with `code: "Conflict"` and `message: "The service is temporarily unavailable, please try again later."` That response is not billed. A record that does not exist stays **404**.
Use a valid NIT string; the integration handles formatting and verification digit as returned by DIAN.

**Name Splitting for Natural Persons**: When the response is for a "persona natural" (natural person), Verifik automatically splits the name from the `nombreRazon` field into `firstName`, `lastName`, `fullName`, and `arrayName` using internal functions. However, since the source data returns the name as a single field (`nombreRazon`), the splitting may not always be 100% accurate. The `nombreRazon` field always contains the original, unmodified name as returned by DIAN.
**B2B Onboarding**: Verify companies instantly during partner or vendor registration.
**Financial Services**: Authenticate businesses before opening accounts or processing transactions.
**Compliance & Due Diligence**: Validate company tax status as part of your KYC/KYB workflows.
**E-commerce & Marketplaces**: Confirm business legitimacy and tax compliance before allowing companies to sell on your platform.
**Automated Compliance**: Streamline your KYB checks to prevent fraud without adding friction for your business partners.
**Instant Results**: Process verifications in seconds, perfect for real-time business onboarding.
**Trusted Data**: Rely on data sourced directly from official tax authority records.
**Easy Integration**: Connect easily via our REST API or use our compatible SDKs.

fr.title: 🇨🇴 Colombie — Vérification DIAN
fr.description: Validez le statut DIAN des entreprises colombiennes avec l'API KYB de Verifik. Connectez-vous aux sources officielles et vérifiez les données fiscales en quelques secondes.
fr.overview:
L'API de vérification DIAN de Verifik vous aide à authentifier le statut fiscal des entreprises colombiennes à partir de données gouvernementales officielles. Elle est conçue pour fluidifier vos processus KYB (Know Your Business), prévenir la fraude et vous assurer de respecter sans effort toutes les exigences réglementaires.

Nous avons construit cette intégration pour les entreprises qui ont besoin d'un moyen rapide, sécurisé et automatisé de confirmer le statut fiscal et la légitimité d'entreprises, partenaires ou fournisseurs colombiens.

Notre API se connecte directement aux registres officiels de la DIAN (*Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales*) pour valider :

-   **Raison sociale et NIT** : prend en charge le *Número de Identificación Tributaria* (NIT).
-   **Statut fiscal** : renvoie le statut d'enregistrement de l'entreprise auprès de la DIAN.
-   **Correspondance d'entreprise** : confirme que les informations correspondent au NIT et valide les responsabilités fiscales actives.

En vérifiant ces éléments, vous pouvez avoir la certitude que l'entreprise avec laquelle vous traitez est légitime, correctement enregistrée auprès de l'autorité fiscale et possède des obligations fiscales actives, ce qui réduit considérablement les risques de fraude et garantit la conformité.

Même chemin sur l'application : `GET https://verifik.app/v2/co/company/dian`.

en.title: Colombia — Health & social security affiliations
en.description: Query Colombian EPS, ARL, pension (AP), compensation funds, and severance (cesantías) via GET /v2/co/afiliaciones.
en.overview:
Verifik returns **affiliation and personal data** for a Colombian individual from official **health and social security** sources (including **RUAF / SISPRO** flows), using **document type**, **document number**, and **document issue date**. Typical blocks include **EPS** (health), **ARL** (occupational risk), **pension (AP)**, **caja de compensación**, and **cesantías**, plus **personal** fields when returned by the source.

This endpoint is **GET-only** (query parameters). Use it for **employment**, **benefits**, and **compliance** checks where this data is allowed.

- **Personal** summary (names, ID line, sex, cut-off date) when available
- **EPS**: regime, affiliation date, status, municipality, etc.
- **ARL**: risk entries with administrator, activity, municipality
- **Pension (AP)**: pension regimes and administrators
- **Caja de compensación** and **cesantías** blocks (may be empty arrays)
- A **signed** Verifik response

Query-only **GET**; pass **`documentType`**, **`documentNumber`**, and **`date`** (`DD/MM/YYYY`).

params.description: Document number without spaces or punctuation (min. length enforced by API).
**Issue date** of the document in **`DD/MM/YYYY`**.

es.title: Colombia — Afiliaciones de salud y seguridad social
es.description: Consulta EPS, ARL, pensión (AP), cajas de compensación y cesantías en Colombia mediante GET /v2/co/afiliaciones.
es.overview:
Verifik devuelve **datos de afiliación e información personal** de una persona en Colombia a partir de fuentes oficiales de **salud y seguridad social** (incluido el flujo **RUAF / SISPRO**), usando **tipo de documento**, **número** y **fecha de expedición**. Suele incluir bloques de **EPS**, **ARL**, **pensión (AP)**, **caja de compensación** y **cesantías**, además de **datos personales** cuando la fuente los provee.

Este endpoint es solo **GET** (parámetros en query). Úsalo para **empleo**, **prestaciones** y **cumplimiento** cuando la ley y tu política lo permitan.

- Resumen **personal** (nombres, línea de documento, sexo, fecha de corte) cuando exista
- **EPS**: régimen, fechas, estado, municipio, etc.
- **ARL**: riesgos con administradora, actividad, municipio
- **Pensiones (AP)**: regímenes y administradoras
- Bloques de **caja de compensación** y **cesantías** (pueden ser listas vacías)
- Respuesta **firmada** por Verifik

Solo **GET** por query; envía **`documentType`**, **`documentNumber`** y **`date`** (`DD/MM/AAAA`).

en.title: Colombia — the official national civil registry ID validity certificate (CC)
en.description: Obtain the official the official national civil registry certificate of validity for a Colombian cédula (CC) using document number and issue date via GET /v2/co/the official national civil registry/certificado.
en.overview:
This endpoint returns the **certificate of validity** (*certificado de vigencia*) for a **Colombian Cédula de Ciudadanía (CC)** from **the official national civil registry**, using the **document number** and **issue date**. The response includes structured fields parsed from the official PDF (including a **base64-encoded PDF**) and status information such as **novedad** (validity state from the preliminary check).

The underlying flow targets **CC** holders; the API validates **`documentNumber`** and **`date`** only.

- **Validity status** context (**novedad**) from the upstream vigencia check
- **Structured document** fields (e.g. number, issue date, issue place, name) when parsing succeeds
- **Verification code** and **PDF** (**pdfBase64**) for audit and downstream use
- A **signed** Verifik response wrapper

The same integration is available as **`POST`** with a JSON body containing the same fields. **`GET`** uses **query parameters** as shown below.

params.description: CC number without spaces or punctuation.
**Issue date** of the document in **`DD/MM/YYYY`**.

requestExamples.label: JavaScript
Python

notes: **`date`** is the **document issue date**, not the date of birth.
Wrong **`DD/MM/YYYY`** format typically returns **409** (`MissingParameter`).
Temporary source availability issues may surface as **409** with codes such as **`Endpoint_out_of_service`**.
**`GET`** and **`POST`** share the same handler; use **`POST`** if you prefer a JSON body.
Treat **pdfBase64** and personal fields as **sensitive**; comply with Colombian privacy rules and your contracts.

es.title: Colombia — Certificado de vigencia de cédula (la fuente oficial de registro civil)
es.description: Obtén el certificado oficial de vigencia de la cédula colombiana (CC) con número y fecha de expedición mediante GET /v2/co/la fuente oficial de registro civil/certificado.
es.overview:
Este endpoint devuelve el **certificado de vigencia** de la **Cédula de Ciudadanía (CC)** desde la **la fuente oficial de registro civil**, usando **número de documento** y **fecha de expedición**. La respuesta incluye campos estructurados extraídos del PDF oficial (incluido **PDF en base64**) e información como **novedad** (estado de vigencia en la consulta previa).

El flujo aplica a titulares de **CC**; la API valida solo **`documentNumber`** y **`date`**.

- Contexto de **estado de vigencia** (**novedad**) según la consulta upstream
- **Datos del documento** (número, expedición, lugar, nombre) cuando el parseo es correcto
- **Código de verificación** y **PDF** (**pdfBase64**) para auditoría
- Respuesta **firmada** por Verifik

La misma integración está disponible como **`POST`** con cuerpo JSON con los mismos campos. **`GET`** usa **parámetros de consulta** como abajo.

params.description: Número de CC sin espacios ni signos.
**Fecha de expedición** en **`DD/MM/AAAA`**.

requestExamples.label: JavaScript
Python

notes: **`date`** es la **fecha de expedición del documento**, no la fecha de nacimiento.
Un formato incorrecto suele devolver **409** (`MissingParameter`).
Problemas temporales de disponibilidad de la fuente pueden aparecer como **409** con códigos como **`Endpoint_out_of_service`**.
**`GET`** y **`POST`** comparten el mismo manejador.
Trata **pdfBase64** y datos personales como **sensibles**; cumple la normativa colombiana y tus contratos.

en.title: Colombia — Delinquent debtors (BDME)
en.description: Query Colombia’s BDME (Base de Datos de Morosos) delinquent debtors registry via GET /v2/co/deudoresmorosos.
en.overview:
Verifik queries **BDME** (*Base de Datos de Morosos*), the Colombian **delinquent debtors bulletin** published by **Contaduría General de la Nación** (via the official **BDME** web portal), using **`documentType`** and **`documentNumber`**. The integration returns a **status** line and **reporting** fields when the source responds with a match.

Use this for **credit risk**, **onboarding**, and **compliance** checks where BDME consultation is allowed.

- **`documentType`** / **`documentNumber`** echoed from the request
- **`status`** — bulletin state text from the upstream response
- **`reportingEntity`**, **`reportedName`**, **`city`**, **`phone`** — fields parsed from the BDME payload when present
- A **signed** Verifik wrapper (`data` + `signature`)

Query-only **GET**; pass **`documentType`** and **`documentNumber`**. There is **no** `POST` route for this path in the current backend.

params.description: Document category. Use **`CC`**, **`CE`**, **`PA`**, **`NIT`**, or **`PPT`** (maps to BDME identification types in the integration).

notes: Both **`documentType`** and **`documentNumber`** are **required**; the API returns **409** if either is missing.
BDME is an official **debtor bulletin**; interpret **`status`** and entity fields under your legal and policy rules.
Upstream **captcha** or portal outages may cause failures (e.g. captcha resolution errors).
**PPT** uses the integration’s **PPT** mapping; confirm behaviour in your environment if you rely on it.

en.title: Colombia — SICAAC Pre-Litigation Conciliation Cases
en.description: Query pre-litigation conciliation records and personal insolvency filings in Colombia by document number.
en.overview:
Verifik provides direct access to the official Colombian statutory dispute resolution and personal insolvency registry. Under Colombian Law (Ley 640 and Ley 2220), extrajudicial conciliation is a mandatory legal prerequisite (*requisito de procedibilidad*) before filing civil, commercial, or labor lawsuits in court.

This API provides **early warning fraud prevention signals**, detecting commercial disputes and insolvency petitions **60 to 120 days before** they appear in court dockets (Rama Judicial) or credit bureaus.

---

*Alias route:* `GET https://api.verifik.co/v2/co/legal/insolvency`

params.description: Document type: `CC` (default), `CE`, `TI`, `RC`, `PAS`, `NIT`, `NIE`, `PPT`.
Document number (e.g. `75086330` or `900123456`).
Set to `true` to bypass cache and query the official source live.

es.title: Colombia — Casos de Conciliación Prejudicial SICAAC
es.description: Consulta casos de conciliación prejudicial y trámites de insolvencia de persona natural en Colombia por número de documento.
es.overview:
Verifik ofrece acceso programático al registro oficial de resolución de conflictos e insolvencia económica de Colombia. De conformidad con las Leyes 640 y 2220, la conciliación extrajudicial en derecho es un **requisito de procedibilidad obligatorio** previo a la presentación de demandas civiles, comerciales y laborales.

Este endpoint es una herramienta clave para **prevención de fraude y evaluación crediticia**, ya que detecta litigios inminentes e insolvencias **60 a 120 días antes** de que aparezcan en juzgados (Rama Judicial) o centrales de riesgo.

---

*Ruta alterna:* `GET https://api.verifik.co/v2/co/legal/insolvency`

en.title: Colombia — Judicial processes
en.description: List judicial processes linked to a Colombian person or company (CC or NIT) via Rama Judicial.
en.overview:
Verifik’s **Judicial processes** endpoint returns a **list of legal processes** from Colombia’s judicial system for a given **CC** (natural person) or **NIT** (company). Typical fields include process dates, last action, court office (**despacho**), department, and **sujetosProcesales**, with **pagination** when there are many matches.

Send **`documentType`** and **`documentNumber`** as **query** parameters.

**Data-source limitation:** Judicial Branch lookups are driven by **name resolution** tied to the document, not only raw ID fields. Match quality can vary, so Verifik **does not guarantee** a complete or successful hit on every request.

params.description: CC` (citizen) or `NIT` (company tax ID).
Document or NIT number to search.

en.title: Panamanian Citizen
en.description: Verify Panamanian CCPA national ID data (document and name) for KYC and fraud prevention.
en.overview:
Verifik's Identity Verification API helps you authenticate Panamanian citizens. It's designed to streamline your KYC (Know Your Customer) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the true identity of users, employees, or customers.

Our API validates:

-   **Full Name & CCPA Number**: Supports *Cédula de Identidad Personal* (CCPA) for citizens and residents.
-   **Identity Match**: Confirms that the name provided matches the CCPA number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the person you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

Verify Panamanian **CCPA** (*Cédula de Identidad Personal*) data. Send **`documentType`** (`CCPA`) and a normalized **`documentNumber`**; the response confirms that the identity record is consistent for **KYC**, customer onboarding, and fraud controls.

params.description: Document type. Allowed value: `CCPA`.
Full Panamanian cédula after normalization (see **[Accepted `documentNumber` formats](#accepted-documentnumber-formats)** below).

requestExamples.label: Node.js
PHP
requestExamples.code:
<?php
$ch = curl_init("https://api.verifik.co/v2/pa/cedula");
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
    "Accept: application/json",
    "Authorization: Bearer " . getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN")
]);
$query = http_build_query([
    "documentType" => "CCPA",
    "documentNumber" => "8-1251-1829"
]);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, "https://api.verifik.co/v2/pa/cedula?".$query);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
$response = curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);
echo $response;

requestExamples.label: Python
Go
requestExamples.code:
package main

    "fmt"
    "net/http"
)

func main() {
    url := "https://api.verifik.co/v2/pa/cedula?documentType=CCPA&documentNumber=8-1251-1829"
    req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", url, nil)
    req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN"))
    resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    fmt.Println(resp.Status)
}

notes: Birth date is required and must match the identification holder.
See **[Accepted `documentNumber` formats](#accepted-documentnumber-formats)** for all supported cédula patterns and normalization behavior.

ko.title: 🇵🇦 파나마 국민(CCPA)
ko.description: 파나마 CCPA 신분증 데이터(문서와 이름)를 검증하여 KYC 및 사기 방지에 활용합니다.
ko.overview:
Verifik의 신원 확인 API는 파나마 국민의 신원을 인증할 수 있도록 합니다. KYC(Know Your Customer) 절차를 자동화하고, 사기를 예방하며, 규제 요구사항을 손쉽게 충족할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

사용자, 직원, 고객의 진짜 신원을 빠르고 안전하게 자동으로 확인해야 하는 비즈니스를 위해 만들어졌습니다.

당사의 API는 검증된 신원 기록과 직접 연결되어 다음을 검증합니다.

-   **전체 성명 및 CCPA 번호**: 국민 및 거주자를 위한 *Cédula de Identidad Personal*(CCPA)을 지원합니다.
-   **신원 일치 여부**: 제공된 이름이 CCPA 번호와 일치하는지 확인합니다.

이러한 항목을 검증함으로써 거래 상대가 실존하며 유효한 문서를 보유하고 있음을 확신할 수 있고, 신원 도용 및 사기 위험을 크게 낮출 수 있습니다.

파나마 **CCPA**(*Cédula de Identidad Personal*) 데이터를 검증합니다. **`documentType`**(`CCPA`)와 정규화된 **`documentNumber`**를 전달하면, **KYC**, 고객 온보딩, 사기 통제에 활용할 수 있도록 신원 기록의 일치 여부를 응답으로 확인합니다.

params.description: 문서 종류. 허용 값: `CCPA`.
정규화 후 완전한 파나마 cédula. 아래 **[허용되는 `documentNumber` 형식](#accepted-documentnumber-formats)** 참고.

-   **Verificación de Fecha de Vencimiento**: Valida la fecha de vencimiento del documento.

ja.description: Verifik の KYC API でスペインの個人の本人確認を行います。公式ソースに直接接続し、個人情報を数秒で検証できます。
ja.overview:
Verifik の本人確認 API は、公的な政府データを利用してスペイン市民および居住者を認証します。KYC（Know Your Customer）プロセスの効率化、不正防止、各種規制要件への対応を簡単に実現できるよう設計されています。

ユーザー、従業員、顧客の真の本人性を、迅速・安全・自動的に確認したいビジネス向けに構築しました。

本 API は公式記録と直接接続し、以下を検証します。

-   **氏名と文書番号**: *Documento Nacional de Identidad*（DNI）および *Número de Identidad de Extranjero*（NIE）に対応します。
-   **本人一致**: 入力された氏名が文書番号と一致するかを確認します。
-   **有効期限の検証**: 文書の有効期限を検証します。

これらを検証することで、相手が実在し有効な文書を保有していることを確認でき、なりすましや不正のリスクを大幅に低減できます。

スペイン国民・居住者の本人確認を公式ソースと照合します。**`documentType`**（`DNIES` または `NIE`）、スペースなしの **`documentNumber`**、有効期限 **`date`**（`DD/MM/YYYY`）を指定します。**KYC**、**不正防止**、**規制対応オンボーディング**向けです。

params.description: 文書タイプ。許可される値: `DNIES`, `NIE`。
スペースを含まない文書番号。
有効期限（`DD/MM/YYYY` 形式）。

notes: `date` は `DD/MM/YYYY` の形式に従ってください。

zh.title: 西班牙公民
zh.description: 使用 Verifik 的 KYC API 核验西班牙个人身份。直接对接官方数据源，在数秒内完成个人数据核验。
zh.overview:
Verifik 的身份核验 API 可基于政府官方数据对西班牙公民与居民进行身份核实。该接口旨在简化您的 KYC（了解您的客户）流程、防范欺诈，并轻松满足合规要求。

我们专为需要快速、安全且自动化确认用户、员工或客户真实身份的企业打造此集成。

我们的 API 直接对接官方记录，验证以下内容：

-   **姓名全称与证件号码**：支持 *Documento Nacional de Identidad*（DNI）与 *Número de Identidad de Extranjero*（NIE）。
-   **身份匹配**：确认所提供姓名与证件号码相符。
-   **到期日期核验**：核验证件到期日期。

通过验证这些信息，您可以确信对接的人员真实存在并持有有效证件，从而显著降低身份冒用与欺诈风险。

在官方来源核验西班牙自然人身份：需提供 **`documentType`**（`DNIES` 或 `NIE`）、无空格的 **`documentNumber`**，以及 **`date`**（有效期，`DD/MM/YYYY`）。适用于 **KYC**、**反欺诈**与**受监管入驻**。

params.description: 证件类型。允许取值：`DNIES`、`NIE`。
证件号码，不含空格。
到期日期，格式为 `DD/MM/YYYY`。

requestExamples.label: Node.js
Python

notes: `date` 必须遵循 `DD/MM/YYYY` 格式。
**金融科技与银行**：在开户或贷款申请过程中即时核验身份。
**电商与配送**：在用户与配送员入驻您的平台前完成身份核验。
**人力资源与招聘**：将候选人证件核验纳入招聘流程。
**保险与医疗**：在出单或提供医疗福利前确认身份。
**自动化合规**：在不增加用户摩擦的前提下简化 KYC 检查并防范欺诈。
**即时结果**：在数秒内完成核验，适用于实时数字化开通。
**可信数据**：采用直接来源于官方记录的数据。
**轻松集成**：通过 REST API 或兼容 SDK 即可便捷接入。

pt.description: Valide carteiras de motorista da Flórida (EUA) pelo número do documento — status, validade, restrições e endossos.

en.title: Vehicle Information
en.description: Brazilian plate lookup: registry-style vehicle attributes (make, model, years, VIN/chassis, FIPE codes when available) for fleet, insurance, collateral, and marketplace checks.
en.overview:
Given a Brazilian **license plate**, **Verifik** returns structured vehicle data in one request so you can tie a real-world asset to verified, normalized attributes. It is aimed at **fleet and mobility onboarding**, **insurance quoting and claims**, **secured finance and collateral review**, and **marketplace or dealer checks** where the plate is the primary identifier.

The Verifik API returns a **normalized vehicle record** for that plate, including **plate**, **brand**, **model**, **model year** and **year of manufacture**, **chassis (VIN)**, **engine**, **color**, **body type**, **fuel type**, **transmission**, **doors**, **manufacturer or plant**, **FIPE codes** where they apply to the vehicle, and **irregularity or restriction indicators** when they exist for that registration. Use it to confirm the unit in front of you matches the official line before you continue.

params.description: License plate to query (letters and digits; casing is normalized). Example: `PZY7H82`.

en.title: Argentine Citizen
en.description: Validate the identity of individuals in Argentina with Verifik's KYC API. Connect with official sources and verify personal data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's Identity Verification API helps you authenticate Argentine citizens using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYC (Know Your Customer) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the true identity of users, employees, or customers.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Full Name & DNI Number**: Supports *Documento Nacional de Identidad* (DNI).
-   **Identity Match**: Confirms that the name provided matches the DNI number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the person you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

Verify an Argentine identity using **`documentType`** `DNIAR` and **`documentNumber`**. Returns identity fields to support **KYC** and **compliance**.

es.overview:
La API de Verificación de Identidad de Verifik te ayuda a autenticar ciudadanos argentinos usando datos oficiales del gobierno. Está diseñada para agilizar tus procesos de KYC (Conozca a su Cliente), prevenir fraudes y asegurar el cumplimiento normativo sin complicaciones.

Creamos esta integración para empresas que necesitan una forma rápida, segura y automatizada de confirmar la verdadera identidad de usuarios, empleados o clientes.

Nuestra API se conecta directamente con registros oficiales para validar:

-   **Nombre Completo y Número de DNI**: Soporta *Documento Nacional de Identidad* (DNI).
-   **Coincidencia de Identidad**: Verifica que el nombre proporcionado coincida con el número de identificación.

Al verificar estos detalles, puedes tener la certeza de que la persona con la que tratas es real y posee un documento válido, reduciendo significativamente el riesgo de suplantación y fraude.

Consulta la identidad de un ciudadano argentino con **`documentType`** `DNIAR` y **`documentNumber`**. Devuelve campos basados en registros oficiales para **KYC** y **cumplimiento**.

ja.title: アルゼンチン — 国民身分証
ja.description: Verifik の KYC API でアルゼンチンの個人の本人確認を行います。公式ソースに直接接続し、個人情報を数秒で検証できます。
ja.overview:
Verifik の本人確認 API は、公的な政府データを利用してアルゼンチン市民を認証します。KYC（Know Your Customer）プロセスの効率化、不正防止、各種規制要件への対応を簡単に実現できるよう設計されています。

ユーザー、従業員、顧客の真の本人性を、迅速・安全・自動的に確認したいビジネス向けに構築しました。

本 API は公式記録と直接接続し、以下を検証します。

-   **氏名と DNI 番号**: *Documento Nacional de Identidad*（DNI）に対応します。
-   **本人一致**: 入力された氏名が DNI 番号と一致するかを確認します。

これらを検証することで、相手が実在し有効な文書を保有していることを確認でき、なりすましや不正のリスクを大幅に低減できます。

**`documentType`**（`DNIAR`）と **`documentNumber`** でアルゼンチン国民の本人確認を行います。公式記録に基づく主要フィールドを返し、**KYC** や **コンプライアンス**に利用できます。

en.title: Ecuadorian Business Verification
en.description: Validate Ecuadorian companies with Verifik's KYB API. Connect with official sources and verify business data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's Business Verification API helps you authenticate Ecuadorian companies using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYB (Know Your Business) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet regulatory requirements.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Legal name & RUCEC**: Supports *Registro Único de Contribuyentes del Ecuador* (RUCEC).
-   **Business information**: Returns legal name, status, and identifiers from official registries.
-   **Company match**: Confirms that the company information matches the RUCEC number.

By verifying these details, you can reduce fraud risk and support compliance workflows.

Look up an Ecuadorian company using **`documentType`** `RUCEC` and **`documentNumber`** (13 digits, no separators). Returns registration-oriented fields to support **KYB**, **vendor screening**, and **compliance**.

params.description: Document type. Allowed value: `RUCEC`.
13-digit RUCEC without spaces or periods.

requestExamples.label: Node.js
PHP
requestExamples.code:
<?php
$ch = curl_init("https://api.verifik.co/v2/ec/company");
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
    "Accept: application/json",
    "Authorization: Bearer " . getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN")
]);
$query = http_build_query([
    "documentType" => "RUCEC",
    "documentNumber" => "1790008959001"
]);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, "https://api.verifik.co/v2/ec/company?".$query);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
$response = curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);
echo $response;

requestExamples.label: Python
Go
requestExamples.code:
package main

    "fmt"
    "net/http"
)

func main() {
    url := "https://api.verifik.co/v2/ec/company?documentType=RUCEC&documentNumber=1790008959001"
    req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", url, nil)
    req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN"))
    resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    fmt.Println(resp.Status)
}

notes: `documentNumber` must be exactly 13 digits without separators.
