pt.title: Verificação de empresas no Canadá
pt.description: Valide empresas canadenses com a API KYB da Verifik. Conecte-se a fontes oficiais e verifique dados empresariais em segundos.
pt.overview:
A API de verificação de empresas da Verifik permite autenticar empresas canadenses usando dados oficiais do governo. Foi projetada para automatizar seus processos de KYB (*Know Your Business*), prevenir fraudes e garantir o cumprimento de todos os requisitos regulatórios sem esforço.

Construímos esta integração para empresas que precisam de uma forma rápida, segura e automatizada de confirmar a legitimidade de companhias, parceiros ou fornecedores.

Nossa API conecta-se diretamente aos registros oficiais para validar:

-   **Nome da empresa e número empresarial**: oferece consultas no registro empresarial canadense por nome da empresa e província.
-   **Informações empresariais**: retorna nome da empresa, número empresarial, tipo de empresa, status, detalhes de registro e endereço.
-   **Correspondência da empresa**: confirma que as informações da empresa correspondem ao registro empresarial.

Ao validar esses elementos, você pode confiar que a empresa com a qual está negociando é legítima e está devidamente registrada, reduzindo significativamente os riscos de fraude e garantindo conformidade.

Consulta **registros empresariais provinciais** no Canadá usando **`business`** (nome da empresa) e **`province`** (código de duas letras). Os campos retornados costumam incluir número de empresa, status, identificadores de registro e endereço. Indicado para **KYB**, **due diligence de fornecedores** e **compliance**.

ko.title: 🇨🇦 캐나다 기업 검증
ko.description: Verifik의 KYB API로 캐나다 기업을 검증합니다. 공식 출처와 직접 연결되어 수 초 내에 기업 데이터를 확인합니다.
ko.overview:
Verifik의 기업 검증 API는 정부 공식 데이터를 활용해 캐나다 기업의 진위를 확인할 수 있도록 합니다. KYB(Know Your Business) 절차를 자동화하고 사기를 방지하며 규제 요구사항을 손쉽게 충족할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

기업, 파트너, 공급업체의 적법성을 빠르고 안전하게 자동으로 확인해야 하는 비즈니스를 위해 만들어졌습니다.

당사의 API는 공식 기록과 직접 연결되어 다음을 검증합니다.

-   **회사명 및 사업자 번호**: 캐나다 기업 등기소를 회사명과 주(州) 단위로 조회할 수 있습니다.
-   **기업 정보**: 회사명, 사업자 번호, 사업 형태, 상태, 등록 정보, 주소를 반환합니다.
-   **회사 일치 여부**: 입력된 기업 정보가 등기소 기록과 일치하는지 확인합니다.

이러한 항목을 검증함으로써 거래 상대 기업이 실재하며 정상 등록된 기업임을 확신할 수 있고, 사기 위험을 크게 낮추는 동시에 컴플라이언스를 확보할 수 있습니다.

캐나다 **주별 기업 등기**를 **`business`**(기업명)와 **`province`**(주 코드)로 조회합니다. 일치 시 사업자 번호, 상태, 등기 식별자, 주소 등이 반환됩니다. **KYB**, **공급업체 실사**, **컴플라이언스**에 활용하세요.

ja.title: カナダ — 法人検証
ja.description: Verifik の KYB API を使用してカナダ法人を検証します。公式ソースに直接接続し、企業データを数秒で確認できます。
ja.overview:
Verifik の法人検証 API は、公的な政府データを利用してカナダ企業を認証します。KYB（Know Your Business）プロセスの効率化、不正防止、各種規制要件への対応を簡単に実現できるよう設計されています。

企業、取引先、ベンダーの正当性を迅速・安全・自動的に確認したいビジネス向けに構築しました。

本 API は公式記録と直接接続し、以下を検証します。

-   **企業名およびビジネス番号**: 企業名と州を指定したカナダ商業登記の照会に対応します。
-   **企業情報**: 企業名、ビジネス番号、企業形態、ステータス、登記情報、住所を返します。
-   **企業の一致**: 入力された企業情報が商業登記と一致するかを確認します。

これらを検証することで、取引相手の企業が正当に登記されていることを確認でき、不正リスクの大幅な低減と法令遵守を実現できます。

カナダの**州別商業登記**を、**`business`**（企業名）と**`province`**（州コード）で照会します。一致時には事業者番号、ステータス、登記情報、住所などが返ります。**KYB**、**取引先審査**、**コンプライアンス**に利用できます。

zh.title: 加拿大企业核验
zh.description: 使用 Verifik 的 KYB API 核验加拿大企业。直接对接官方数据源，在数秒内完成企业数据核验。
zh.overview:
Verifik 的企业核验 API 可基于政府官方数据对加拿大企业进行身份核实。该接口旨在简化您的 KYB（了解您的企业）流程、防范欺诈，并轻松满足合规要求。

我们专为需要快速、安全且自动化确认企业、合作伙伴或供应商合法性的组织打造此集成。

我们的 API 直接对接官方记录，验证以下内容：

-   **公司名称与企业编号**：支持通过公司名称与省份代码查询加拿大企业登记信息。
-   **企业信息**：返回公司名称、企业编号、企业类型、状态、注册详情及地址等。
-   **企业匹配**：确认所提供的企业信息与登记数据相符。

通过验证这些信息，您可以确信对接的企业真实合法且依法登记，从而显著降低欺诈风险并保障合规。

在加拿大**省级企业登记**中，使用 **`business`**（企业名称）与 **`province`**（两字母省/地区代码）查询法人主体。返回字段通常包括企业编号、状态、登记标识与地址等。适用于 **KYB**、**供应商尽职调查**与**合规**场景。

Array of base64 image strings to compare against.
One of `FAST` or `ACCURATE`.
Pass threshold for the comparison score (`0.67`–`0.95`). Default: `0.85`.

requestExamples.label: Node.js
PHP
requestExamples.code:
<?php
$ch = curl_init("https://api.verifik.co/v2/face-recognition/compare");
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
    "Content-Type: application/json",
    "Authorization: Bearer " . getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN")
]);
$body = json_encode([
    "probe" => ["<base64>"],
    "gallery" => ["<base64>", "<base64>"],
    "search_mode" => "FAST"
]);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, $body);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
$response = curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);
echo $response;

requestExamples.label: Python
Go
requestExamples.code:
package main

    "bytes"
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "net/http"
    "os"
)

func main() {
    payload := map[string]interface{}{
        "probe": []string{"<base64>"},
        "gallery": []string{"<base64>", "<base64>"},
        "search_mode": "ACCURATE",
    }
    b, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
    req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.verifik.co/v2/face-recognition/compare", bytes.NewBuffer(b))
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN"))
    resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    var out map[string]interface{}
    json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&out)
    fmt.Println(out)
}

notes: `probe` and `gallery` must be base64 strings; images shorter than ~100 characters are rejected with `412:only_images_in_base64`.
`search_mode` must be `FAST` or `ACCURATE` (required by validation).
Response is wrapped with `id`, `data`, and `signature` per standard middleware.

There is **no** `GET /v2/face-verifications/:id`. To read a SmartEnroll face-compare result, use [`GET /v2/app-registrations/:id?populates[]=compareFaceVerification`](/resources/app-registrations/retrieve-an-app-registration). FaceVerification records expire after about **90 days** in production (shorter in development).

en.description: Update an existing face recognition collection by its unique id. You can change the name, description, project, and optionally sync which people belong to the collection.

Updates a collection you own. The `{id}` path parameter is the collection’s unique `_id` (the same identifier used when [retrieving a collection](/resources/retrieve-a-collection)).

When you include `people` in the body, the server reconciles membership: people not listed may be removed from the collection, and new ids may be added, subject to server rules.

requestExamples.label: Node.js
PHP
requestExamples.code:
<?php
$ch = curl_init("https://api.verifik.co/v2/face-recognition/detect");

    "Content-Type: application/json",
    "Authorization: Bearer " . getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN")
]);

en.title: Mexican Business Verification
en.description: Validate Mexican companies with Verifik's KYB API. Connect with official sources and verify business data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's Business Verification API helps you authenticate Mexican companies using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYB (Know Your Business) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the legitimacy of companies, partners, or vendors.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Company Name & FME Number**: Supports *Folio Mercantil Electrónico* (FME).
-   **Business Information**: Returns company name, city, and registration details.
-   **Company Match**: Confirms that the company information matches the FME number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the company you're dealing with is legitimate and properly registered, significantly lowering the risk of fraud and ensuring compliance.

This endpoint looks up a Mexican legal entity by its **FME** (*Folio Mercantil Electrónico*) identifier. Use GET with `documentType=FME` and `documentNumber` to retrieve official registration details such as legal business name and city from government commercial registry sources.

Elle est conçue pour fluidifier vos processus KYB (Know Your Business), prévenir la fraude et vous assurer de respecter sans effort toutes les exigences réglementaires.

Nous avons construit cette intégration pour les entreprises qui ont besoin d'un moyen rapide, sécurisé et automatisé de confirmer la légitimité de sociétés, partenaires ou fournisseurs.

En vérifiant ces éléments, vous pouvez avoir la certitude que la société avec laquelle vous traitez est légitime et dûment enregistrée, ce qui réduit considérablement les risques de fraude et garantit votre conformité.

pt.description: Valide empresas mexicanas com a API KYB da Verifik. Conecte-se a fontes oficiais e verifique dados empresariais em segundos.
pt.overview:
A API de verificação de empresas da Verifik permite autenticar empresas mexicanas usando dados oficiais do governo. Foi projetada para automatizar seus processos de KYB (*Know Your Business*), prevenir fraudes e garantir o cumprimento de todos os requisitos regulatórios sem esforço.

Construímos esta integração para empresas que precisam de uma forma rápida, segura e automatizada de confirmar a legitimidade de companhias, parceiros ou fornecedores.

Nossa API conecta-se diretamente aos registros oficiais para validar:

-   **Nome da empresa e número de FME**: suporta o *Folio Mercantil Electrónico* (FME).
-   **Informações empresariais**: retorna nome da empresa, cidade e detalhes de registro.
-   **Correspondência da empresa**: confirma que as informações da empresa correspondem ao número do FME.

Ao validar esses elementos, você pode confiar que a empresa com a qual está negociando é legítima e está devidamente registrada, reduzindo significativamente os riscos de fraude e garantindo conformidade.

Este endpoint consulta uma pessoa jurídica mexicana pelo identificador **FME** (*Folio Mercantil Electrónico*). Use GET com `documentType=FME` e `documentNumber` para obter detalhes oficiais de registro, como razão social e cidade, a partir de fontes do registro mercantil governamental.

ko.title: 🇲🇽 멕시코 기업 검증
ko.description: Verifik의 KYB API로 멕시코 기업을 검증합니다. 공식 출처와 직접 연결되어 수 초 내에 기업 데이터를 확인합니다.
ko.overview:
Verifik의 기업 검증 API는 정부 공식 데이터를 활용해 멕시코 기업의 진위를 확인할 수 있도록 합니다. KYB(Know Your Business) 절차를 자동화하고 사기를 방지하며 규제 요구사항을 손쉽게 충족할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

기업, 파트너, 공급업체의 적법성을 빠르고 안전하게 자동으로 확인해야 하는 비즈니스를 위해 만들어졌습니다.

당사의 API는 공식 기록과 직접 연결되어 다음을 검증합니다.

-   **회사명 및 FME 번호**: *Folio Mercantil Electrónico*(FME)를 지원합니다.
-   **기업 정보**: 회사명, 도시, 등록 정보를 반환합니다.
-   **회사 일치 여부**: 입력된 기업 정보가 FME 번호와 일치하는지 확인합니다.

이러한 항목을 검증함으로써 거래 상대 기업이 실재하며 정상 등록된 기업임을 확신할 수 있고, 사기 위험을 크게 낮추는 동시에 컴플라이언스를 확보할 수 있습니다.

본 엔드포인트는 멕시코 법인을 **FME**(*Folio Mercantil Electrónico*) 식별자로 조회합니다. `documentType=FME`와 `documentNumber`를 사용해 GET 요청을 보내면, 정부 상업 등기소에서 제공하는 법인명, 도시 등 공식 등록 정보를 받아볼 수 있습니다.

ja.description: Verifik の KYB API を使用してメキシコ企業を検証します。公式ソースに直接接続し、企業データを数秒で確認できます。

企業、取引先、ベンダーの正当性を迅速・安全・自動的に確認したいビジネス向けに構築しました。

本 API は公式記録と直接接続し、以下を検証します。

Verifik 的企业核验 API 可基于政府官方数据对墨西哥企业进行身份核实。该接口旨在简化您的 KYB（了解您的企业）流程、防范欺诈，并轻松满足合规要求。

我们专为需要快速、安全且自动化确认企业、合作伙伴或供应商合法性的组织打造此集成。

通过验证这些信息，您可以确信对接的企业真实合法且依法登记，从而显著降低欺诈风险并保障合规。

该接口用于通过 **FME**（*Folio Mercantil Electrónico*）查询墨西哥法人实体。请使用 GET 方式，传入 `documentType=FME` 与 `documentNumber`，即可从政府工商登记数据源获取法定企业名称与所在城市等官方登记详情。

en.title: Vehicle Values by Plate
en.description: Fasecolda vehicle value service with dual-source specification matching and confidence breakdown
en.overview:
Verifik's Fasecolda Vehicle Values by Plate API retrieves official commercial valuations and technical specifications for vehicles registered in Colombia using a license plate. To maximize success rates across cars, SUVs, pickups, heavy vehicles, and motorcycles, this endpoint connects **two complementary official vehicle sources**:

1. **Primary Resolution (Direct Plate-to-Code Index)**: Resolves the license plate directly against the primary valuation index when an exact catalog code is linked to the plate.
2. **Secondary Resolution (Cross-Source Specification Matching)**: When a plate has no direct valuation code (common for motorcycles and newly registered vehicles), Verifik retrieves the vehicle's verified technical specifications (`brand`, `line`, `cylinderCapacity`, `year`, and `vehicleClass`) from a secondary official vehicle registry and matches them against the Fasecolda valuation catalog (`matchSource: "runt_fallback"`), returning a detailed confidence breakdown (`matchConfidence`, `matchNote`, `matchDetails`, and `runtVehicle`).

The Fasecolda Vehicle Value Inquiry service provides comprehensive information about vehicles registered in Colombia, including `code`, `marke` (brand), `line1`, `line2`, `line3`, `class`, `year`, `bcpp`, `valueModel`, `cylinderCapacity`, `fuel`, and `matchDetails` when resolved via cross-source specification matching. Pass the license **`plate`** as a **query** parameter.

es.title: Valores de Vehículos por Placa
es.description: Obtén valores e información de vehículos Fasecolda por placa con la API de Verifik. Accede a datos completos de vehículos y motocicletas para Colombia.
es.overview:
La API de Valores de Vehículos por Placa Fasecolda de Verifik permite obtener valoraciones comerciales oficiales y especificaciones técnicas de vehículos registrados en Colombia utilizando únicamente la placa. Para maximizar la tasa de éxito en automóviles, camionetas, camperos, vehículos pesados y motocicletas, este endpoint conecta **dos fuentes oficiales complementarias de datos vehiculares**:

1. **Resolución Primaria (Índice Directo Placa-Código)**: Cuando la placa tiene un código de valoración Fasecolda directamente asociado en el índice principal, Verifik retorna de inmediato la referencia exacta del catálogo.
2. **Resolución Secundaria (Cruce de Especificaciones Técnicas entre Fuentes)**: Cuando un vehículo (especialmente motocicletas o vehículos recién matriculados) no tiene un código directo asociado por placa en el índice de valoración, Verifik consulta automáticamente las especificaciones técnicas verificadas del vehículo (`brand`, `line`, `cylinderCapacity`, `year` y `vehicleClass`) en un registro oficial secundario y las cruza contra el catálogo de la Guía de Valores de Fasecolda.

Siempre que una respuesta se resuelve mediante el cruce de especificaciones entre fuentes, el payload incluye metadatos completos de trazabilidad y puntaje (`matchSource`, `matchConfidence`, `matchNote`, `matchDetails` y `runtVehicle`) para que tu flujo de suscripción o avalúo conozca con total transparencia cómo se obtuvo el código y qué factores redujeron el puntaje de confianza.

- **Información de Vehículos y Motocicletas por Placa**: Soporta placas colombianas de automóviles, camionetas, camperos, vehículos pesados y motocicletas (`ABC123`, `ABC12D`, `ABC12`). La placa se normaliza automáticamente (conversión a mayúsculas y eliminación de espacios, guiones y puntos).
- **Datos Técnicos y de Valoración Completos**: Retorna código Fasecolda (`code` / `homoloCode`), marca (`marke`), líneas (`line1`, `line2`, `line3`), clase (`class`), categoría (`category`), cilindraje (`cylinderCapacity`), combustible (`fuel`), transmisión (`transmission`), precio comercial base (`bcpp`) y valores históricos por modelo (`valueModel`).
- **Transparencia Multi-Fuente y Desglose de Confianza**: Entrega un puntaje ponderado de confianza (`0.60` a `1.00`) junto con la explicación detallada de cada deducción (`matchDetails.penalties`) cuando se utiliza el cruce de especificaciones técnicas.

El servicio de consulta de valor de vehículo Fasecolda ofrece información integral sobre vehículos registrados en Colombia (`code`, `marke`, `line1`, `line2`, `line3`, `class`, `cylinderCapacity`, `bcpp`, `valueModel`) e incluye `matchSource`, `matchConfidence`, `matchNote`, `matchDetails` y `runtVehicle` cuando se resuelve por cruce de especificaciones entre fuentes. Envía la **placa** como parámetro de **consulta** (`plate`).

Cuando la placa no está directamente indexada —lo cual ocurre con frecuencia en motocicletas y algunos vehículos livianos—, Verifik verifica las especificaciones técnicas en un registro vehicular oficial secundario y las cruza con el catálogo de Fasecolda (`matchSource: "runt_fallback"`).

**Fórmula de Confianza (`matchConfidence` y `matchDetails`)**: Las coincidencias por cruce entre fuentes se califican de `0.00` a `1.00` mediante la fórmula `0.55 * textScore + 0.25 * ccScore + 0.20 * yearScore`. Solo se retornan coincidencias con `matchConfidence >= 0.60`; por debajo de ese umbral se responde `404`.
**¿Qué reduce el puntaje `matchConfidence`? (`matchDetails.penalties`)**:

**Tokens adicionales de versión/equipamiento en el catálogo (`textPoints` sobre `0.55`)**: Los registros de matrícula suelen almacenar únicamente la línea base (por ejemplo, `"VERSA"`, `"TRACKER"` o `"TRK 502X"`), mientras que el catálogo de Fasecolda detalla la versión, caja y frenos (`"ADVANCE AT 1600CC 2AB ABS"` o `"MT 500CC ABS"`). Estos tokens adicionales se listan en `extraGuideTokens` y explican por qué una coincidencia exacta del vehículo suele obtener entre `0.71` y `0.95`.

**Códigos de homologación vs. nombre comercial**: Algunos fabricantes registran códigos de homologación (como `"FZN250 A"` para `"FZ25 250"` o `"GPD150 A NMAX"` para `"NMAX"`). Los tokens que difieren se detallan en `unmatchedRuntTokens`.

**Redondeo nominal de cilindraje (`ccPoints` sobre `0.25`)**: Una diferencia menor al 5% (como `199cc` vs `200cc` o `124cc` vs `125cc`) obtiene el puntaje completo (`0.25/0.25`); diferencias nominales mayores del catálogo (como `373cc` real frente a la clase nominal `400cc`) descuentan `-0.07` y se explican en `penalties`.
**Unidades de Valoración**: El arreglo `valueModel` contiene los valores comerciales por año de modelo y `bcpp` representa el precio comercial base (expresado en miles de Pesos Colombianos, COP).

fr.title: Fasecolda — Valeur par plaque
fr.description: Service Fasecolda de valorisation de véhicules par plaque avec croisement de sources et détail du score de confiance
fr.overview:
L'API Fasecolda de valeurs de véhicules par plaque de Verifik récupère les valorisations commerciales officielles et les spécifications techniques des véhicules immatriculés en Colombie. Pour maximiser le taux de réussite sur les voitures, SUV, pick-up, poids lourds et motos, ce point de terminaison combine **deux sources officielles complémentaires** :

1. **Résolution primaire (index direct plaque-code)** : résout directement la plaque lorsque le code Fasecolda est rattaché à l'immatriculation.
2. **Résolution secondaire (croisement des spécifications techniques entre sources)** : lorsque la plaque n'a pas de code direct, Verifik vérifie les spécifications techniques (`brand`, `line`, `cylinderCapacity`, `year`, `vehicleClass`) auprès d'un registre officiel secondaire et les croise avec le catalogue Fasecolda (`matchSource: "runt_fallback"`), en renvoyant `matchConfidence`, `matchNote`, `matchDetails` et `runtVehicle`.

Le service de valorisation Fasecolda fournit les données complètes des véhicules immatriculés en Colombie (`code`, `marke`, `line1`, `line2`, `line3`, `class`, `cylinderCapacity`, `bcpp`, `valueModel`, ainsi que `matchDetails` lors d'un croisement entre sources). Passez la **plaque** en paramètre **`plate`**.

pt.overview:
A API de Valores de Veículos por Placa Fasecolda da Verifik recupera avaliações comerciais oficiais e especificações técnicas de veículos registrados na Colômbia. Para maximizar a cobertura em automóveis, SUVs, picapes, caminhões e motocicletas, este endpoint conecta **duas fontes oficiais complementares**:

1. **Resolução Primária (Índice Direto Placa-Código)**: Resolve a placa diretamente quando há um código Fasecolda associado.
2. **Resolução Secundária (Cruzamento de Especificações Técnicas entre Fontes)**: Quando a placa não possui código direto, a Verifik consulta as especificações técnicas verificadas (`brand`, `line`, `cylinderCapacity`, `year`, `vehicleClass`) em um registro oficial secundário e as cruza com o catálogo Fasecolda (`matchSource: "runt_fallback"`), retornando `matchConfidence`, `matchNote`, `matchDetails` e `runtVehicle`.

O serviço Fasecolda de valores fornece informações detalhadas sobre veículos registrados na Colômbia: `code`, `marke`, `line1`, `line2`, `line3`, `class`, `year`, `bcpp`, `valueModel`, `cylinderCapacity`, `fuel` e `matchDetails` quando resolvido por cruzamento entre fontes.

params.description: Placa colombiana de veículo ou motocicleta. Espaços, hífens e pontos são removidos automaticamente.

ko.title: Fasecolda — 번호판 차량 가치
ko.description: 이중 소스 제원 매칭 및 신뢰도 분석을 제공하는 콜롬비아 Fasecolda 번호판 차량 가치 조회 API
ko.overview:
Verifik의 Fasecolda 번호판 차량 가치 조회 API는 번호판만으로 콜롬비아 등록 차량의 공식 상업 가치와 기술 제원을 조회합니다. 승용차, SUV, 픽업트럭, 상용차 및 오토바이 전반의 조회 성공률을 극대화하기 위해 **두 가지 상호보완적인 공식 데이터 소스를 연결**합니다:

1. **1차 조회 (번호판-코드 직접 인덱스)**: 번호판에 연결된 Fasecolda 코드를 직접 조회합니다.
2. **2차 조회 (교차 소스 제원 매칭)**: 직접 코드가 없는 경우 공식 차량 등록 제원(`brand`, `line`, `cylinderCapacity`, `year`, `vehicleClass`)을 검증하여 Fasecolda 카탈로그와 매칭(`matchSource: "runt_fallback"`)하고 `matchConfidence`, `matchNote`, `matchDetails`, `runtVehicle`을 함께 반환합니다.

콜롬비아 등록 차량의 `code`, `marke`, `line1`, `line2`, `line3`, `class`, `year`, `bcpp`, `valueModel`, `cylinderCapacity`, `fuel` 및 교차 매칭 상세 정보(`matchDetails`)를 반환합니다.

params.description: 조회할 콜롬비아 차량 또는 오토바이 번호판(공백, 하이픈, 마침표 자동 제거).

ja.title: Fasecolda — ナンバー別車両価格
ja.description: デュアルソース仕様照合と信頼度スコア内訳を備えたコロンビア Fasecolda ナンバー別車両価格 API
ja.overview:
Verifik の Fasecolda ナンバー別車両価格 API は、ナンバープレートからコロンビア登録車両の公式商業評価額と技術仕様を取得します。乗用車、SUV、ピックアップ、トラック、オートバイ全体で高い成功率を実現するため、**2つの補完的な公式データソースを接続**しています：

1. **一次解決（ナンバー・コード直接インデックス）**：ナンバープレートに紐付く Fasecolda コードを直接解決します。
2. **二次解決（複数ソース間の技術仕様クロスマッチング）**：直接コードがない場合、公式車両登録データから仕様（`brand`、`line`、`cylinderCapacity`、`year`、`vehicleClass`）を検証し、Fasecolda カタログと照合（`matchSource: "runt_fallback"`）して `matchConfidence`、`matchNote`、`matchDetails`、`runtVehicle` を返します。

コロンビア登録車両の `code`、`marke`、`line1`、`line2`、`line3`、`class`、`year`、`bcpp`、`valueModel`、`cylinderCapacity`、`fuel`、およびクロスマッチング時の `matchDetails` を返します。

params.description: 照会するコロンビアの車両またはオートバイのナンバープレート（スペース・ハイフン・句点は自動除去）。

zh.title: Fasecolda — 按车牌查询车辆价值
zh.description: 通过哥伦比亚车牌查询 Fasecolda 商业估值、技术参数与分年价格。
zh.overview:
Verifik 的 Fasecolda 按车牌查询车辆价值 API 仅需车牌即可获取哥伦比亚注册车辆的官方商业估值与技术规格。为了在乘用车、SUV、皮卡、重型商用车和摩托车上实现最高查询成功率，此端点**结合了两个互补的官方车辆数据源**：

1. **主要解析（车牌-代码直接索引）**：当车牌在主要估值索引中直接关联了 Fasecolda 估值代码时，Verifik 会立即返回目录中的精确条目。
2. **次要解析（跨源技术规格匹配）**：当车辆（尤其是大多数摩托车或新注册车辆）未按车牌直接编入估值索引时，Verifik 会自动从官方二级车辆登记记录中获取经核实的技术规格（`brand`、`line`、`cylinderCapacity`、`year` 和 `vehicleClass`），并与 Fasecolda 估值目录进行交叉匹配（`matchSource: "runt_fallback"`）。

每当响应通过跨源技术规格匹配解析时，返回结果都会包含完整的溯源和评分明细（`matchSource`、`matchConfidence`、`matchNote`、`matchDetails` 和 `runtVehicle`），让您的核保或评估流程清楚了解估值代码是如何匹配的，以及哪些因素扣减了置信度得分。

- **按车牌查询汽车与摩托车信息**：支持哥伦比亚轿车、SUV、皮卡、商用车和摩托车车牌（`ABC123`、`ABC12D`、`ABC12`）。输入的车牌会自动标准化（转为大写并去除空格、连字符和句点）。
- **完整的技术与估值数据**：返回 Fasecolda 代码（`code` / `homoloCode`）、品牌（`marke`）、车型系列（`line1`、`line2`、`line3`）、车辆类别（`class`）、分类（`category`）、排量（`cylinderCapacity`）、燃料（`fuel`）、变速箱（`transmission`）、基准商业价格（`bcpp`）以及分年份历史价格（`valueModel`）。
- **双源透明度与置信度评分明细**：在跨源匹配时提供加权置信度得分（`0.60` 至 `1.00`）以及每项扣分的详细说明（`matchDetails.penalties`）。

查询哥伦比亚注册车辆的官方估值与技术属性（`code`、`marke`、`line1`、`line2`、`line3`、`class`、`cylinderCapacity`、`bcpp`、`valueModel`），并在跨源规格匹配时返回 `matchSource`、`matchConfidence`、`matchNote`、`matchDetails` 和 `runtVehicle`。通过**查询参数** **`plate`** 传入**车牌**。

**置信度计算公式（`matchConfidence` 与 `matchDetails`）**：跨源匹配按 `0.55 * textScore + 0.25 * ccScore + 0.20 * yearScore` 在 `0.00` 至 `1.00` 范围内计分，最低阈值为 `0.60`。

en.overview:
Verifik's Fasecolda Vehicle Values by Code API helps you retrieve comprehensive vehicle information using Fasecolda codes. It's designed to streamline your vehicle verification processes, provide accurate valuations, and ensure you have complete vehicle data.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to access vehicle information and values using Fasecolda codes.

Our API connects directly with official Fasecolda records to validate:

-   **Vehicle Information by Code**: Supports Fasecolda codes to identify vehicles and their characteristics.
-   **Comprehensive Vehicle Data**: Returns vehicle class, brand, model, year, estimated value, load capacity, fuel type, and other key attributes.
-   **Vehicle Values**: Provides historical values for different model years and conditions.

By verifying these details, you can access complete vehicle information and accurate valuations, significantly helping with vehicle transactions and assessments.

La API de Valores de Vehículos por Código Fasecolda de Verifik te ayuda a obtener información completa de vehículos usando códigos Fasecolda. Está diseñada para agilizar tus procesos de verificación de vehículos, proporcionar valoraciones precisas y asegurar que tengas datos completos del vehículo.

-   **Valores de Vehículos**: Proporciona valores históricos para diferentes años de modelo y condiciones.

Al verificar estos detalles, puedes acceder a información completa del vehículo y valoraciones precisas, ayudando significativamente con transacciones y evaluaciones de vehículos.

en.title: United States Business Verification
en.description: Validate US companies with Verifik's KYB API. Connect with official sources and verify business data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's Business Verification API helps you authenticate US companies using official government data from SEC EDGAR. It's designed to streamline your KYB (Know Your Business) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the legitimacy of companies, partners, or vendors.

Our API connects directly with official SEC EDGAR records to validate:

-   **Company Name & Information**: Supports US company lookups by business name.
-   **Business Information**: Returns company name, CIK, EIN, addresses, entity type, exchanges, tickers, SIC codes, and more.
-   **Company Match**: Confirms that the company information matches official SEC records.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the company you're dealing with is legitimate and properly registered, significantly lowering the risk of fraud and ensuring compliance.

Look up a U.S. company by full or partial business name using SEC EDGAR data. Send `business` in the JSON body of a `POST` request.

pt.title: 🇺🇸 EUA — Empresa (SEC EDGAR)
pt.description: Consulta de empresas nos EUA via SEC EDGAR. POST /v2/usa/company com o campo business no corpo JSON.
pt.overview:
A API de verificação de empresas da Verifik permite **consultar empresas dos Estados Unidos** usando dados públicos do **SEC EDGAR**. É adequada para **KYB** (*Know Your Business*), diligência de fornecedores e conformidade regulatória.

A API consulta registros oficiais para retornar informações como:

-   **Nome empresarial e identificadores**: busca por nome completo ou parcial da empresa.
-   **Dados cadastrais**: nome, CIK, EIN, endereços, tipo de entidade, bolsas de valores, tickers, códigos SIC, entre outros campos disponíveis na fonte.
-   **Correspondência**: ajuda a confirmar se os dados conferem com o registro público da empresa.

Consulte uma empresa dos EUA pelo **nome comercial**. Envie o campo **`business`** no **corpo JSON** de uma requisição **POST** (`Content-Type: application/json`).

es.overview:
El Servicio de Validación de Licencia de Manejo de Kansas permite a los desarrolladores validar programáticamente el estado, restricciones, endosos y designaciones de las licencias de manejo de Kansas. Al proporcionar un número válido de licencia de manejo de Kansas, los usuarios pueden obtener una respuesta que incluye detalles como el estado de la licencia, fecha de vencimiento, cualquier restricción o endoso, y designaciones asociadas con la licencia.

Este servicio es esencial para verificar credenciales de manejo y asegurar el cumplimiento con las regulaciones estatales.

pt.title: 🇺🇸 Kansas (EUA) — Carteira de motorista
pt.description: Valide uma carteira de motorista do Kansas (EUA) pelo número do documento, data de nascimento, nome e sobrenome — status, validade e credenciais.
pt.overview:
Este serviço permite **validar programaticamente** o status, restrições, endossos e designações de carteiras de motorista emitidas no estado do **Kansas** (EUA). Com um número válido da licença e os demais parâmetros obrigatórios, a resposta pode incluir status da licença, data de validade, tipo de credencial e demais detalhes retornados pela fonte.

É útil para conferir credenciais de motoristas e apoiar fluxos de **conformidade** e **onboarding**.

Consulta por **`documentNumber`**, **`dateOfBirth`** (formato **DD/MM/AAAA**), **`firstName`** e **`lastName`**. A data de nascimento deve seguir o formato exigido pela API para evitar erro de validação.

en.title: Claims Verification
en.description: Fasecolda insurance claims history verification service. Check vehicle insurance claim history in Colombia with Verifik's API.
en.overview:
Verifik's Fasecolda Claims Verification API helps you check the insurance claim history of vehicles in Colombia using official Fasecolda data. It's designed to streamline your vehicle verification processes, assess risk, and ensure you have complete information about a vehicle's insurance history.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to verify vehicle insurance claims and accident history.

Our API connects directly with official Fasecolda records to validate:

-   **Vehicle License Plate**: Supports Colombian vehicle license plates.
-   **Insurance Claims History**: Returns comprehensive information about registered insurance claims associated with the vehicle.
-   **Claim Details**: Provides claim ID, accident date, and protection type for each claim.

By verifying these details, you can assess a vehicle's insurance history and potential risks, significantly helping with vehicle valuation and risk assessment.

params.description: Plate of the vehicle to consult, without spaces or periods.

requestExamples.label: Node.js
Python

notes: "Sinister" in the API endpoint refers to insurance claims or accidents in Colombian insurance terminology.
"Pérdida Menor Cuantía" indicates minor loss claims.
This service is essential for assessing a vehicle's insurance history and potential risks.
Each claim record includes a unique ID, accident date, and protection type.

es.title: Verificación de Siniestros
es.description: Servicio de verificación de historial de reclamos de seguros Fasecolda. Consulta el historial de siniestros de vehículos en Colombia con la API de Verifik.
es.overview:
La API de Verificación de Siniestros Fasecolda de Verifik te ayuda a verificar el historial de reclamos de seguros de vehículos en Colombia usando datos oficiales de Fasecolda. Está diseñada para agilizar tus procesos de verificación de vehículos, evaluar riesgos y asegurar que tengas información completa sobre el historial de seguros de un vehículo.

Creamos esta integración para empresas que necesitan una forma rápida, segura y automatizada de verificar reclamos de seguros e historial de accidentes de vehículos.

Nuestra API se conecta directamente con registros oficiales de Fasecolda para validar:

-   **Placa de Matrícula del Vehículo**: Soporta placas de vehículos colombianos.
-   **Historial de Reclamos de Seguros**: Retorna información completa sobre reclamos de seguros registrados asociados con el vehículo.
-   **Detalles de Reclamos**: Proporciona ID de reclamo, fecha de accidente y tipo de protección para cada reclamo.

Al verificar estos detalles, puedes evaluar el historial de seguros de un vehículo y riesgos potenciales, ayudando significativamente con la valoración de vehículos y evaluación de riesgos.

Consulta el historial de accidentes y **reclamos** (seguros) en Fasecolda usando la **placa** del vehículo como **parámetro de consulta** (`?plate=`).

params.description: Placa del vehículo a consultar, sin espacios ni puntos.

Cada registro de reclamo incluye un ID único, fecha de accidente y tipo de protección.

en.title: Costa Rican Business Verification (NITE)
en.description: KYB company lookup for Costa Rica via GET /v2/cr/company with documentType NITE and documentNumber for registration and compliance.
en.overview:
Verifik's Business Verification API helps you authenticate Costa Rican companies using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYB (Know Your Business) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the legitimacy of companies, partners, or vendors.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Company Name & NITE Number**: Supports *Número de Identificación Tributaria de Empresas* (NITE).
-   **Business Information**: Returns company name and registration details.
-   **Company Match**: Confirms that the company information matches the NITE number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the company you're dealing with is legitimate and properly registered, significantly lowering the risk of fraud and ensuring compliance.

Use this endpoint to confirm **NITE** (*Número de Identificación Tributaria de Empresas*) records for Costa Rican legal entities. Pass **`documentType`** `NITE` and the company **`documentNumber`**; the response returns registered business identifiers and related fields for **KYB** and onboarding.

params.description: Document type. Allowed value: `NITE`.
Company identifier.

requestExamples.label: Node.js
PHP

$ch = curl_init("https://api.verifik.co/v2/cr/company");
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
    "Accept: application/json",
    "Authorization: Bearer " . getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN")
]);
$query = http_build_query([
    "documentType" => "NITE",
    "documentNumber" => "3101122876"
]);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, "https://api.verifik.co/v2/cr/company?".$query);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
$response = curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);
echo $response;

    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN"))

**E-commerce & Marketplaces**: Confirm business legitimacy before allowing companies to sell on your platform.
**Automated Compliance**: Streamline your KYB checks to prevent fraud without adding friction for your business partners.
**Instant Results**: Process verifications in seconds, perfect for real-time business onboarding.
**Trusted Data**: Rely on data sourced directly from official records.
**Easy Integration**: Connect easily via our REST API or use our compatible SDKs.

en.title: Argentine Business Verification

en.overview:
Verifik's Business Verification API helps you authenticate Argentine companies using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYB (Know Your Business) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the legitimacy of companies, partners, or vendors.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Company Name & CUIT Number**: Supports *Código Único de Identificación Tributaria* (CUIT).
-   **Business Information**: Returns company name, legal form, contract date, and economic activities.
-   **Economic Activities**: Provides main and secondary activity codes and descriptions.
-   **Company Match**: Confirms that the company information matches the CUIT number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the company you're dealing with is legitimate and properly registered, significantly lowering the risk of fraud and ensuring compliance.

Look up an Argentine company using **`documentType`** `CUIT` and **`documentNumber`**. Returns registration fields to support **KYB**, **vendor screening**, and **compliance**.

Creamos esta integración para empresas que necesitan una forma rápida, segura y automatizada de confirmar la legitimidad de compañías, socios o proveedores.

Nuestra API se conecta directamente con registros oficiales para validar:

-   **Razón Social y Número de CUIT**: Soporta *Código Único de Identificación Tributaria* (CUIT).
-   **Información Empresarial**: Devuelve razón social, forma jurídica, fecha de contrato y actividades económicas.
-   **Actividades Económicas**: Proporciona códigos y descripciones de actividades principales y secundarias.
-   **Coincidencia de Empresa**: Confirma que la información de la empresa coincide con el número de CUIT.

Al verificar estos detalles, puedes tener la certeza de que la empresa con la que tratas es legítima y está debidamente registrada, reduciendo significativamente el riesgo de fraude y asegurando el cumplimiento.

ko.description: Verifik KYB API로 아르헨티나 기업을 검증합니다. 공식 출처와 직접 연결되어 수 초 내에 기업 데이터를 확인합니다.
ko.overview:
Verifik의 기업 검증 API는 공식 정부 데이터를 사용해 아르헨티나 기업을 인증할 수 있도록 합니다. KYB(Know Your Business) 절차를 자동화하고, 사기를 예방하며, 규제 요구사항을 손쉽게 충족할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

기업, 파트너, 벤더의 합법성을 빠르고 안전하게 자동으로 확인해야 하는 비즈니스를 위해 만들어졌습니다.

당사 API는 공식 기록과 직접 연결되어 다음을 검증합니다.

-   **회사명 및 CUIT 번호**: *Código Único de Identificación Tributaria*(CUIT)를 지원합니다.
-   **기업 정보**: 회사명, 법적 형태, 계약일, 경제 활동 등을 반환합니다.
-   **경제 활동**: 주요 및 부차적 활동 코드와 설명을 제공합니다.
-   **기업 일치**: 입력된 기업 정보가 CUIT 번호와 일치하는지 확인합니다.

이를 검증하면 거래 상대 기업이 적법하게 등록되어 있음을 확인할 수 있어 사기 위험을 크게 줄이고 규정 준수를 보장할 수 있습니다.

**`documentType`** `CUIT`와 **`documentNumber`**로 아르헨티나 법인을 조회합니다. **KYB**, **벤더 심사**, **컴플라이언스**를 지원하는 등록 필드를 반환합니다.

en.title: Bolivian Business Verification
en.description: Validate Bolivian companies with Verifik's KYB API. Connect with official sources and verify business data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's Business Verification API helps you authenticate Bolivian companies using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYB (Know Your Business) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the legitimacy of companies, partners, or vendors.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Company Name & NIT Number**: Supports *Número de Identificación Tributaria* (NIT).
-   **Business Information**: Returns company name, status, and registration details.
-   **Company Match**: Confirms that the company information matches the NIT number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the company you're dealing with is legitimate and properly registered, significantly lowering the risk of fraud and ensuring compliance.

Look up a Bolivian company using **`documentType`** `NIT` and **`documentNumber`**. Returns registration fields to support **KYB**, **vendor screening**, and **compliance**.

Document type. Allowed value: `NIT`.

ja.overview:
Verifik の法人検証 API は、公的な政府データを利用してボリビアの企業を認証します。KYB（Know Your Business）プロセスの効率化、不正防止、各種規制要件への対応を簡単に実現できるよう設計されています。

requestExamples.label: JavaScript
Python
requestExamples.code:
conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.verifik.co")

headers = {
    'Accept': "application/json",
    'Authorization': "JWT token"
}

conn.request("GET", "/v2/co/rama/certificado/vigencia?documentType=CC&documentNumber=123456789&quality=ABG", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

requestExamples.code:

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

  'headers' => [
    'Accept' => 'application/json',
    'Authorization' => 'JWT token',
  ],
]);

echo $response->getBody();

notes: **`documentType`** is restricted to **`CC`** or **`CE`** at the API layer (not NIT).

en.title: Paraguayan Business Verification

en.overview:
Verifik's Business Verification API helps you authenticate Paraguayan companies using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYB (Know Your Business) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the legitimacy of companies, partners, or vendors.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Company Name & RUC Number**: Supports *Registro Único de Contribuyente* (RUC).
-   **Business Information**: Returns company name and registration details.
-   **Company Match**: Confirms that the company information matches the RUC number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the company you're dealing with is legitimate and properly registered, significantly lowering the risk of fraud and ensuring compliance.

Look up a Paraguayan company using **`documentType`** `RUC` and **`documentNumber`**. Returns registration fields to support **KYB**, **vendor screening**, and **compliance**.

ko.overview:
Verifik의 기업 검증 API는 정부 공식 데이터를 활용해 파라과이 기업의 진위를 확인할 수 있도록 합니다. KYB(Know Your Business) 절차를 자동화하고 사기를 방지하며 규제 요구사항을 손쉽게 충족할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

기업, 파트너, 공급업체의 적법성을 빠르고 안전하게 자동으로 확인해야 하는 비즈니스를 위해 만들어졌습니다.

당사의 API는 공식 기록과 직접 연결되어 다음을 검증합니다.

-   **회사명 및 RUC 번호**: *Registro Único de Contribuyente*(RUC)를 지원합니다.
-   **기업 정보**: 회사명과 등록 정보를 반환합니다.
-   **회사 일치 여부**: 입력된 기업 정보가 RUC 번호와 일치하는지 확인합니다.

이러한 항목을 검증함으로써 거래 상대 기업이 실재하며 정상 등록된 기업임을 확신할 수 있고, 사기 위험을 크게 낮추는 동시에 컴플라이언스를 확보할 수 있습니다.

ja.description: Verifik の KYB API を使用してパラグアイ企業を検証します。公式ソースに直接接続し、企業データを数秒で確認できます。
ja.overview:
Verifik の法人検証 API は、公的な政府データを利用してパラグアイの企業を認証します。KYB（Know Your Business）プロセスの効率化、不正防止、各種規制要件への対応を簡単に実現できるよう設計されています。

企業、取引先、ベンダーの正当性を迅速・安全・自動的に確認したいビジネス向けに構築しました。

本 API は公式記録と直接接続し、以下を検証します。

-   **企業名と RUC 番号**: *Registro Único de Contribuyente*（RUC）に対応します。
-   **企業情報**: 企業名と登記情報を返します。
-   **企業の一致**: 入力された企業情報が RUC 番号と一致するかを確認します。

これらを検証することで、取引相手の企業が正当に登記されていることを確認でき、不正リスクの大幅な低減と法令遵守を実現できます。

**`documentType`**（`RUC`）と **`documentNumber`** でパラグアイの法人を照会します。登記に基づく主要フィールドを返し、**KYB**、**取引先審査**、**コンプライアンス**に利用できます。

zh.title: 巴拉圭企业核验
zh.description: 使用 Verifik 的 KYB API 核验巴拉圭企业。直接对接官方数据源，在数秒内完成企业数据核验。
zh.overview:
Verifik 的企业核验 API 可基于政府官方数据对巴拉圭企业进行身份核实。该接口旨在简化您的 KYB（了解您的企业）流程、防范欺诈，并轻松满足合规要求。

我们专为需要快速、安全且自动化确认企业、合作伙伴或供应商合法性的组织打造此集成。

我们的 API 直接对接官方记录，验证以下内容：

-   **公司名称与 RUC 号码**：支持 *Registro Único de Contribuyente*（RUC）。
-   **企业信息**：返回公司名称及登记详情。
-   **企业匹配**：确认企业信息与 RUC 号码相符。

通过验证这些信息，您可以确信对接的企业真实合法且依法登记，从而显著降低欺诈风险并保障合规。

使用 **`documentType`**（`RUC`）和 **`documentNumber`** 查询巴拉圭企业。返回登记相关字段，可用于 **KYB**、**供应商尽调**与 **合规**。

en.title: Chile — Identity document validation
en.description: Validate a Chilean RUN or RUT together with the document serial against civil or tax validation flows; returns a vigency-style status for physical ID checks.
en.overview:
This endpoint checks **document vigency** for Chilean **RUN** or **RUT** using the **printed serial number** on the physical ID, in addition to the identifier. Use it when you must confirm that a **card** is **valid** (not only that the number exists)—for example **high-assurance KYC** or **compliance** steps that go beyond a simple cedula lookup.

For name-only verification against civil registry without serial, use **[Identity verification in Chile](/identity/chile)** (`v2/cl/cedula`).

Submit **RUN** or **RUT**, **document number**, and **printed serial** to obtain a **vigency-style status** from civil or tax validation sources—use when the physical ID must be confirmed, not only the number.

es.description: Valida RUN o RUT chileno junto al número de serie del documento físico; devuelve un estado de vigencia para controles de alta confianza.

Este endpoint comprueba la **vigencia** del documento para **RUN** o **RUT** chileno usando el **número de serie** impreso en la cédula o tarjeta, además del identificador. Úsalo cuando debas confirmar que el **documento físico** es **válido**, no solo que el número existe—por ejemplo en **KYC de alta garantía** o pasos de **cumplimiento** que van más allá de una consulta simple a cédula.

Para verificación nominal contra registro civil **sin** serie, usa **[Verificación de identidad en Chile](/verifik-es/identidad/chile)** (`v2/cl/cedula`).

Envía **RUN** o **RUT**, **número de documento** y **serie impresa** para obtener un **estado de vigencia** desde fuentes de validación civil o tributaria—úsalo cuando deba confirmarse el documento físico, no solo el número.

fr.title: Chili — Validation de document d'identité

fr.overview:
Cet endpoint vérifie la **validité (vigencia) du document** chilien pour un **RUN** ou un **RUT** en utilisant le **numéro de série imprimé** sur la pièce d'identité physique, en plus de l'identifiant. Pour une vérification de nom uniquement contre le registre civil sans numéro de série, utilisez **[Vérification d'identité au Chili](/identity/chile)** (`v2/cl/cedula`).

Transmettez le **RUN** ou le **RUT**, le **numéro de document** et le **numéro de série imprimé** pour obtenir un **statut de vigence** issu des sources de validation civiles ou fiscales — utile lorsque la pièce d'identité physique doit être confirmée, et pas seulement le numéro.

fr.description: Consultation véhicule au Costa Rica par plaque d'immatriculation via GET /v2/cr/vehicle.
fr.overview:
Ce service retourne des informations détaillées sur un véhicule immatriculé au Costa Rica à partir de sa **plaque d'immatriculation**. Les données typiques incluent le propriétaire actuel, les caractéristiques du véhicule (cylindrée, valeur fiscale, poids, capacité, puissance, traction), l'historique des **infractions** et celui des **propriétaires précédents** lorsqu'ils sont exposés par la source.

Utilisez-le pour les vérifications de flotte, l'assurance et les flux de conformité.

Envoyez une requête GET avec le paramètre **`plate`** (sans espaces ni ponctuation). Une réponse réussie inclut les données structurées du véhicule, les champs propriétaire et les tableaux d'historique lorsqu'ils sont disponibles.

en.title: Guatemalan Citizen
en.description: Validate the identity of individuals in Guatemala with Verifik's KYC API. Connect with official sources and verify personal data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's Identity Verification API helps you authenticate Guatemalan citizens using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYC (Know Your Customer) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the true identity of users, employees, or customers.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Full Name & CUI Number**: Supports *Cédula de Vecindad* or *Documento Personal de Identificación* (CUI).
-   **Identity Match**: Confirms that the name provided matches the CUI number.
-   **Date of Birth Verification**: Validates that the date of birth matches official SAT records.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the person you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

Verify a Guatemalan citizen using **`documentType`** `CUI`, **`documentNumber`**, and **`dateOfBirth`** (`DD/MM/YYYY`). Returns identity fields to support **KYC** and **compliance**.

params.description: Document type. Allowed value: `CUI`.
Document number.
Date of birth (`DD/MM/YYYY`).

es.title: Ciudadano Guatemalteco
es.description: Valida la identidad de personas en Guatemala con la API KYC de Verifik. Conecta con fuentes oficiales y verifica datos personales en segundos.
es.overview:
La API de Verificación de Identidad de Verifik te ayuda a autenticar ciudadanos guatemaltecos usando datos oficiales del gobierno. Está diseñada para agilizar tus procesos de KYC (Conozca a su Cliente), prevenir fraudes y asegurar el cumplimiento normativo sin complicaciones.

Creamos esta integración para empresas que necesitan una forma rápida, segura y automatizada de confirmar la verdadera identidad de usuarios, empleados o clientes.

Nuestra API se conecta directamente con registros oficiales para validar:

-   **Nombre Completo y Número CUI**: Soporta *Cédula de Vecindad* o *Documento Personal de Identificación* (CUI).
-   **Coincidencia de Identidad**: Verifica que el nombre proporcionado coincida con el número CUI.
-   **Verificación de Fecha de Nacimiento**: Valida que la fecha de nacimiento coincida con los registros oficiales del SAT.

Al verificar estos detalles, puedes tener la certeza de que la persona con la que tratas es real y posee un documento válido, reduciendo significativamente el riesgo de suplantación y fraude.

Verifica un ciudadano guatemalteco usando **`documentType`** `CUI`, **`documentNumber`** y **`dateOfBirth`** (`DD/MM/YYYY`). Devuelve campos de identidad para apoyar **KYC** y **cumplimiento**.

en.title: Honduran Citizen
en.description: Validate the identity of individuals in Honduras with Verifik's KYC API. Connect with official sources and verify personal data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's Identity Verification API helps you authenticate Honduran citizens using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYC (Know Your Customer) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the true identity of users, employees, or customers.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Full Name & DNIHN Number**: Supports *Documento Nacional de Identidad de Honduras* (DNIHN).
-   **Identity Match**: Confirms that the name provided matches the DNIHN number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the person you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

params.description: Document type. Allowed value: `DNIHN`.
Document number.

requestExamples.label: Node.js
PHP
requestExamples.code:
<?php
$ch = curl_init("https://api.verifik.co/v2/hn/cedula");
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
    "Accept: application/json",
    "Authorization: Bearer " . getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN")
]);
$query = http_build_query([
    "documentType" => "DNIHN",
    "documentNumber" => "123456789"
]);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, "https://api.verifik.co/v2/hn/cedula?".$query);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
$response = curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);
echo $response;

requestExamples.label: Python
Go
requestExamples.code:
package main

    "fmt"
    "net/http"
)

func main() {
    url := "https://api.verifik.co/v2/hn/cedula?documentType=DNIHN&documentNumber=123456789"
    req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", url, nil)
    req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN"))
    resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    fmt.Println(resp.Status)
}

notes: `documentType` must be `DNIHN`.

en.title: Dominican Citizen
en.description: Validate the identity of individuals in the Dominican Republic with Verifik's KYC API. Connect with official sources and verify personal data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's Identity Verification API helps you authenticate Dominican citizens using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYC (Know Your Customer) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the true identity of users, employees, or customers.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Full Name & CIE Number**: Supports *Cédula de Identidad y Electoral* (CIE).
-   **Identity Match**: Confirms that the name provided matches the CIE number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the person you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

es.title: Ciudadano Dominicano
es.description: Valida la identidad de personas en República Dominicana con la API KYC de Verifik. Conecta con fuentes oficiales y verifica datos personales en segundos.
es.overview:
La API de Verificación de Identidad de Verifik te ayuda a autenticar ciudadanos dominicanos usando datos oficiales del gobierno. Está diseñada para agilizar tus procesos de KYC (Conozca a su Cliente), prevenir fraudes y asegurar el cumplimiento normativo sin complicaciones.

Creamos esta integración para empresas que necesitan una forma rápida, segura y automatizada de confirmar la verdadera identidad de usuarios, empleados o clientes.

Nuestra API se conecta directamente con registros oficiales para validar:

-   **Nombre Completo y Número CIE**: Soporta *Cédula de Identidad y Electoral* (CIE).
-   **Coincidencia de Identidad**: Verifica que el nombre proporcionado coincida con el número CIE.

Al verificar estos detalles, puedes tener la certeza de que la persona con la que tratas es real y posee un documento válido, reduciendo significativamente el riesgo de suplantación y fraude.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to verify the identity of foreign clients, employees, or partners in Venezuela.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Full Name & Document Number**: Foreigner identification (**CEVE**—*Cédula de Identidad de Extranjero*).

-   **Document Type**: Responses include `documentType: "CEVE"` for this route.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the foreign individual you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

Use this endpoint for **foreign nationals** registered with a **CEVE** cédula. Pass the document number as **`documentNumber`**; the API applies **CEVE** and returns structured identity fields. For **Venezuelan citizens** (national **CCVE**), use [`GET /v2/ve/cedula`](/identity/venezuela) instead.

zh.overview:
Verifik 的身份核验 API 可基于政府官方数据对在委内瑞拉的外国人进行身份核实。该接口旨在简化您的 KYC（了解您的客户）流程、防范欺诈，并轻松满足合规要求。

我们专为需要快速、安全且自动化核验委内瑞拉外籍客户、员工或合作方身份的组织打造此集成。

我们的 API 直接对接官方记录，验证以下内容：

-   **姓名全称与证件号码**：外国人识别证（**CEVE** — *Cédula de Identidad de Extranjero*）。

请使用此接口核验持 **CEVE** cédula 的**外国国民**。请将证件号作为 **`documentNumber`** 传入；API 默认按 **CEVE** 处理并返回结构化身份字段。如需核验**委内瑞拉本国公民**（**CCVE**），请使用 [`GET /v2/ve/cedula`](/identity/venezuela)。

en.title: Uruguayan Citizen
en.description: Validate the identity of individuals in Uruguay with Verifik's KYC API. Connect with official sources and verify personal data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's Identity Verification API helps you authenticate Uruguayan citizens using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYC (Know Your Customer) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the true identity of users, employees, or customers.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Full Name & CCUY Number**: Supports *Cédula de Ciudadanía Uruguaya* (CCUY).
-   **Identity Match**: Confirms that the name provided matches the CCUY number.
-   **Date of Birth Verification**: Validates the date of birth matches the official records.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the person you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

Verify Uruguayan identification by `documentType=CCUY`, `documentNumber`, and `dateOfBirth`.

params.description: Allowed: `CCUY`.
Document number.
DD/MM/YYYY`.

requestExamples.label: Node.js

requestExamples.code:

$ch = curl_init("https://api.verifik.co/v2/uy/cedula");
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
    "Accept: application/json",
    "Authorization: Bearer " . getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN")
]);
$query = http_build_query([
    "documentType" => "CCUY",
    "documentNumber" => "123456789",
    "dateOfBirth" => "20/02/1978"
]);

    req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN"))

es.title: España — Verificación empresarial (CIF/NIF)
es.description: Consulta datos de sociedades mercantiles en España mediante el endpoint v2/es/company. A partir del CIF u otro identificador fiscal válido obtienes información coherente para due diligence, onboarding de proveedores, scoring comercial y cumplimiento KYB. Indica si la consulta devuelve razón social, estado o metadatos según disponibilidad en la fuente; contacta con soporte para el detalle completo de campos en tu plan.
es.overview:
Este endpoint está pensado para equipos que deben **saber con quién contratan**: bancos, plataformas B2B, insuretech, operadores de marketplace o cualquier negocio que deba validar que una empresa existe, está activa y coincide con el identificador que te ha proporcionado el usuario o el fichero de alta.

**Qué hace en la práctica:** envías un **identificador de empresa** (por ejemplo CIF/NIF en el formato que admita el servicio) y recibes un objeto de datos que puedes usar para completar fichas de cliente, pipelines de aprobación o revisiones de cumplimiento. La respuesta incluye firma Verifik para trazabilidad. Los campos exactos dependen de la fuente y de tu configuración; si necesitas un listado campo a campo para tu sector, el equipo de soporte puede orientarte.

**Cuándo tiene sentido usarlo:** alta de proveedores, revisión previa a pagos recurrentes, apertura de cuentas corporativas, verificación de titulares reales en operaciones sensibles, o cualquier flujo KYB donde “la empresa es quien dice ser” sea un requisito previo a seguir adelante.

**Limitaciones y buenas prácticas:** no sustituye un informe legal completo ni una auditoría contable; es una capa de **verificación automatizada** encadenada a tu política interna. Asegúrate de manejar tokens de forma segura, de registrar intentos fallidos (empresa no encontrada) y de informar al usuario final cuando los datos no basten para una decisión automática.

Consulta de datos de **empresa en España** por identificador fiscal (por ejemplo CIF). La respuesta te ayuda en **KYB** y *due diligence*: confirmar que la entidad existe y alinear razón social o estado con tu política de contratación de proveedores o clientes B2B. No reemplaza un informe legal o auditoría contable; sí automatiza el paso previo de “¿esta empresa es quien dice ser?” en tiempo de solicitud. Si el identificador no existe o es inválido, maneja el error según la tabla de respuestas.

fr.title: Entreprise panaméenne (RUC)
fr.description: Vérifier les entreprises au Panama avec l'API KYB Verifik (RUC et chiffre clé).
fr.overview:
L'API de vérification d'entreprise de Verifik vous permet d'authentifier les sociétés panaméennes à partir des données officielles du gouvernement. Elle est conçue pour fluidifier vos processus KYB (Know Your Business), prévenir la fraude et vous assurer de respecter sans effort toutes les exigences réglementaires.

Nous avons construit cette intégration pour les entreprises qui ont besoin d'un moyen rapide, sécurisé et automatisé de confirmer la légitimité de sociétés, partenaires ou fournisseurs.

Notre API se connecte directement aux registres officiels pour valider :

-   **Nom et numéro RUC** : prend en charge le *Registro Único de Contribuyente* (RUC).
-   **Informations sur l'entreprise** : retourne la raison sociale, l'adresse, le capital, le type d'organisation, la date d'enregistrement et les représentants.
-   **Statut de la société** : indique le statut actuel, la durée de validité et les détails d'enregistrement.
-   **Correspondance d'entreprise** : confirme que les informations correspondent au numéro RUC.

En vérifiant ces éléments, vous pouvez avoir la certitude que la société avec laquelle vous traitez est légitime et dûment enregistrée, ce qui réduit considérablement les risques de fraude et garantit votre conformité.

Interrogez le registre **RUC** (*Registro Único de Contribuyente*) du Panama. Transmettez **`documentType`** (`RUC`), le **`documentNumber`** de la société et le **`dv`** (chiffre clé). Les usages courants incluent le **KYB**, l'onboarding des fournisseurs et les revues de conformité lorsque vous avez besoin, en une seule réponse HTTPS, de la raison sociale, du statut, des représentants et des principaux champs commerciaux.

pt.title: Verificação de empresas no Panamá
pt.description: Consulte empresas panamenhas por RUC — razão social, status, representantes e campos do registro a partir de fontes oficiais para KYB e diligência prévia.
pt.overview:
A API de verificação de empresas da Verifik permite autenticar empresas panamenhas usando dados oficiais do governo. Foi projetada para automatizar seus processos de KYB (*Know Your Business*), prevenir fraudes e garantir o cumprimento de todos os requisitos regulatórios sem esforço.

Construímos esta integração para empresas que precisam de uma forma rápida, segura e automatizada de confirmar a legitimidade de companhias, parceiros ou fornecedores.

Nossa API conecta-se diretamente aos registros oficiais para validar:

-   **Nome da empresa e número do RUC**: suporta o *Registro Único de Contribuyente* (RUC).
-   **Informações empresariais**: retorna nome da empresa, endereço, capital, tipo de organização, data de registro e representantes.
-   **Status da empresa**: fornece status atual, validade e detalhes de registro.
-   **Correspondência da empresa**: confirma que as informações da empresa correspondem ao número do RUC.

Ao validar esses elementos, você pode confiar que a empresa com a qual está negociando é legítima e está devidamente registrada, reduzindo significativamente os riscos de fraude e garantindo conformidade.

Consulte o registro de **RUC** (*Registro Único de Contribuyente*) do Panamá. Envie **`documentType`** (`RUC`), o **`documentNumber`** da empresa e o **`dv`** (dígito verificador). Usos comuns incluem **KYB**, onboarding de fornecedores e revisões de conformidade quando você precisa de razão social, status, representantes e campos comerciais essenciais em uma única resposta HTTPS.

ko.title: 🇵🇦 파나마 기업 검증
ko.description: RUC로 파나마 기업을 조회합니다. KYB 및 실사를 위해 공식 출처에서 법인명, 상태, 대표자, 등기소 필드를 제공합니다.
ko.overview:
Verifik의 기업 검증 API는 정부 공식 데이터를 활용해 파나마 기업의 진위를 확인할 수 있도록 합니다. KYB(Know Your Business) 절차를 자동화하고 사기를 방지하며 규제 요구사항을 손쉽게 충족할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

기업, 파트너, 공급업체의 적법성을 빠르고 안전하게 자동으로 확인해야 하는 비즈니스를 위해 만들어졌습니다.

당사의 API는 공식 기록과 직접 연결되어 다음을 검증합니다.

-   **회사명 및 RUC 번호**: *Registro Único de Contribuyente*(RUC)를 지원합니다.
-   **기업 정보**: 회사명, 주소, 자본금, 조직 형태, 등록 일자, 대표자를 반환합니다.
-   **회사 상태**: 현재 상태, 유효성, 등록 상세 정보를 제공합니다.
-   **회사 일치 여부**: 입력된 기업 정보가 RUC 번호와 일치하는지 확인합니다.

이러한 항목을 검증함으로써 거래 상대 기업이 실재하며 정상 등록된 기업임을 확신할 수 있고, 사기 위험을 크게 낮추는 동시에 컴플라이언스를 확보할 수 있습니다.

파나마의 **RUC**(*Registro Único de Contribuyente*) 등기소를 조회합니다. **`documentType`**(`RUC`), 회사 **`documentNumber`**, **`dv`**(검증 자릿수)를 함께 전달합니다. 단일 HTTPS 응답으로 법인명, 상태, 대표자, 주요 상업 정보 필드가 필요한 **KYB**, 공급업체 온보딩, 컴플라이언스 검토 등에 활용할 수 있습니다.

ja.title: パナマ — 法人検証
ja.description: RUC でパナマの企業を照会し、法人名、ステータス、代表者、登記情報などを公式ソースから取得します。KYB やデューデリジェンスに活用できます。
ja.overview:
Verifik の法人検証 API は、公的な政府データを利用してパナマの企業を認証します。KYB（Know Your Business）プロセスの効率化、不正防止、各種規制要件への対応を簡単に実現できるよう設計されています。

企業、取引先、ベンダーの正当性を迅速・安全・自動的に確認したいビジネス向けに構築しました。

本 API は公式記録と直接接続し、以下を検証します。

-   **企業名と RUC 番号**: *Registro Único de Contribuyente*（RUC）に対応します。
-   **企業情報**: 企業名、住所、資本金、組織形態、登録日、代表者を返します。
-   **企業ステータス**: 現在のステータス、有効性、登録情報を提供します。
-   **企業の一致**: 入力された企業情報が RUC 番号と一致するかを確認します。

これらを検証することで、取引相手の企業が正当に登記されていることを確認でき、不正リスクの大幅な低減と法令遵守を実現できます。

パナマの **RUC**（*Registro Único de Contribuyente*）登記簿を照会します。**`documentType`**（`RUC`）、企業の **`documentNumber`**、**`dv`**（検証桁）を送信します。法人名、ステータス、代表者、主要な商業情報を 1 度の HTTPS レスポンスで取得する必要がある場合に、**KYB**、ベンダーオンボーディング、コンプライアンスレビュー等で利用されます。

zh.title: 巴拿马企业核验
zh.description: 通过 RUC 查询巴拿马企业 — 获取来自官方数据源的法定名称、状态、代表人及登记字段，适用于 KYB 与尽职调查。
zh.overview:
Verifik 的企业核验 API 可基于政府官方数据对巴拿马企业进行身份核实。该接口旨在简化您的 KYB（了解您的企业）流程、防范欺诈，并轻松满足合规要求。

我们专为需要快速、安全且自动化确认企业、合作伙伴或供应商合法性的组织打造此集成。

我们的 API 直接对接官方记录，验证以下内容：

-   **公司名称与 RUC 号码**：支持 *Registro Único de Contribuyente*（RUC）。
-   **企业信息**：返回公司名称、地址、注册资本、组织类型、登记日期及代表人等。
-   **企业状态**：提供当前状态、有效期与登记详情。
-   **企业匹配**：确认企业信息与 RUC 号码相符。

通过验证这些信息，您可以确信对接的企业真实合法且依法登记，从而显著降低欺诈风险并保障合规。

查询巴拿马 **RUC**（*Registro Único de Contribuyente*）登记数据。请传入 **`documentType`**（`RUC`）、企业 **`documentNumber`** 与 **`dv`**（校验位）。常见用途包括 **KYB**、供应商开通与合规审查，可在一次 HTTPS 响应中获取法定名称、状态、代表人及关键商业字段。

en.title: RUES Complete Business Validation (v3)
en.description: Retrieve complete Colombian business information from RUES with Verifik's KYB API. Connect with official sources and verify comprehensive business data.
en.overview:
Verifik's RUES Complete Business Validation API helps you retrieve comprehensive business information from Colombia's RUES (Registro Único Empresarial y Social) registry. It's designed to streamline your KYB (Know Your Business) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to access complete business information for Colombian companies, partners, or vendors.

Our API connects directly with official RUES records to validate:

-   **Company Name & NIT Number**: Supports *Número de Identificación Tributaria* (NIT).
-   **Complete Business Information**: Returns commercial registry data, economic activities, establishment owners, legal representatives, and more.
-   **Multiple categories**: Same registry lines as **`/v3/co/rues`** — e.g. **RM** (Registro Mercantil), **PROP**, **RUNEOL**, **RNT**, **ESAL**, **ESOL**, **JUEGOS**, **EXTRANJERAS** (see parameters below).
-   **Company Match**: Confirms that the company information matches the NIT number and provides comprehensive business details.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the company you're dealing with is legitimate and properly registered, significantly lowering the risk of fraud and ensuring compliance.

Retrieves **complete** Colombian business information from the RUES registry (same query parameters as `GET /v3/co/rues`, with a much richer response).

| | **`GET /v3/co/rues`** (basic) | **`GET /v3/co/rues-complete`** (this API) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Purpose** | Fast KYB check; category-specific **summary** | Full **dossier** for onboarding or enhanced due diligence |
| **Typical fields** | Core registry fields for the chosen category (e.g. RM: name, NIT, chamber, matrícula status) | Commercial registry, **economic activities**, **establishments**, **legal representatives**, and related blocks |
| **Parameters** | `documentType` (**`NIT`**), `documentNumber`, optional `category` | **Same** |
| **Catalog pricing** | Lower (e.g. **0.2** credits / **0.3** SmartCheck) | Higher (e.g. **0.3** credits / **0.4** SmartCheck) because more upstream data is aggregated |

Use the **basic** endpoint when you only need to confirm registration and key identifiers. Use **complete** when you need representatives, activities, establishments, or a signed full record for compliance workflows.

See also: [Colombia — RUES business lookup (v3)](/business-validation/colombia-rues-v3).

Also available at `GET https://verifik.app/v3/co/rues-complete` (same path on the app host).

en.title: \U0001F1F5\U0001F1EA Peru - Full ID
en.description: Extended Peruvian citizen identity verification with comprehensive DNI details using Verifik's KYC API. Connect with official sources and verify detailed identity data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's Identity Verification API helps you perform extended identity verification for Peruvian citizens using their DNI (Documento Nacional de Identidad) number. It's designed to streamline your KYC (Know Your Customer) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to access extended personal information, including full name, civil status, date of birth, address breakdown (province, area, home district), and related identity fields.

**The Authorization header is required for authentication to access this information securely.**

Our API connects directly with official Peruvian records to validate:

-   **Full Name & DNI Number**: Supports *Documento Nacional de Identidad* (DNI) documents.
-   **Identity Match**: Confirms that the name provided matches the DNI number.
-   **Extended Personal Data**: Returns civil status, date of birth, sex, address, province, area, and home district.
-   **Name Components**: Returns `firstName`, `lastName`, `paternalLastName`, `maternalLastName`, and `arrayName`.
-   **Document Information**: Returns document type and number.

Some fields are always present in the response but currently return the string `not_available` (they are not omitted): `photo`, `expeditionDate`, `expirationDate`, `ubigeoReniec`, and `verificationDigit`. Photo is not currently offered on this endpoint.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the person you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

fr.overview:
L'API de vérification d'identité de Verifik vous permet d'effectuer une vérification d'identité étendue pour les citoyens péruviens à l'aide de leur numéro de DNI (*Documento Nacional de Identidad*). Elle est conçue pour automatiser vos processus KYC (Know Your Customer), prévenir la fraude et vous assurer de respecter sans effort toutes les exigences réglementaires.

Nous avons construit cette intégration pour les entreprises qui ont besoin d'un moyen rapide, sécurisé et automatisé d'accéder à des informations personnelles étendues, notamment le nom complet, l'état civil, la date de naissance, le détail de l'adresse (province, zone, district de résidence) et d'autres champs d'identité associés.

**L'en-tête Authorization est requis pour authentifier l'accès à ces informations en toute sécurité.**

Notre API se connecte directement aux registres officiels péruviens pour valider :

-   **Nom complet et numéro de DNI** : prend en charge les documents *Documento Nacional de Identidad* (DNI).
-   **Correspondance d'identité** : confirme que le nom fourni correspond au numéro de DNI.
-   **Données personnelles étendues** : retourne l'état civil, la date de naissance, le sexe, l'adresse, la province, la zone et le district de résidence.
-   **Composantes du nom** : retourne `firstName`, `lastName`, `paternalLastName`, `maternalLastName` et `arrayName`.
-   **Informations sur le document** : retourne le type et le numéro de document.

Certains champs sont toujours présents dans la réponse mais retournent actuellement la chaîne `not_available` (ils ne sont pas omis) : `photo`, `expeditionDate`, `expirationDate`, `ubigeoReniec` et `verificationDigit`. La photo n'est pas actuellement proposée sur cet endpoint.

En vérifiant ces éléments, vous pouvez avoir la certitude que la personne avec qui vous traitez existe et possède un document valide, ce qui réduit considérablement les risques d'usurpation d'identité et de fraude.

Retourne les **données DNI RENIEC étendues** pour les citoyens péruviens : nom complet, état civil, date de naissance, adresse (province, zone, district de résidence) et autres champs d'identité associés. Envoyez `documentType=DNI` et le `documentNumber` à 8 chiffres.

A API de verificação de identidade da Verifik permite realizar verificação de identidade estendida para cidadãos peruanos usando o número do DNI (*Documento Nacional de Identidad*). Foi projetada para automatizar seus processos de KYC (Know Your Customer), prevenir fraudes e garantir o cumprimento de todos os requisitos regulatórios sem esforço.

Construímos esta integração para empresas que precisam de uma forma rápida, segura e automatizada de acessar informações pessoais estendidas, incluindo nome completo, estado civil, data de nascimento, detalhamento do endereço (província, área, distrito de residência) e outros campos de identidade relacionados.

**O cabeçalho Authorization é obrigatório para autenticar o acesso a essas informações com segurança.**

Nossa API conecta-se diretamente aos registros oficiais peruanos para validar:

-   **Nome completo e número do DNI**: suporta documentos do tipo *Documento Nacional de Identidad* (DNI).
-   **Correspondência de identidade**: confirma que o nome informado corresponde ao número do DNI.
-   **Dados pessoais estendidos**: retorna estado civil, data de nascimento, sexo, endereço, província, área e distrito de residência.
-   **Componentes do nome**: retorna `firstName`, `lastName`, `paternalLastName`, `maternalLastName` e `arrayName`.
-   **Informações do documento**: retorna tipo e número do documento.

Ao validar esses elementos, você pode confiar que a pessoa com quem está negociando é real e possui um documento válido, reduzindo significativamente os riscos de personificação e fraude.

ko.overview:
Verifik의 신원 확인 API는 페루 시민의 DNI(*Documento Nacional de Identidad*) 번호로 확장된 신원 정보를 조회할 수 있게 해 줍니다. KYC(Know Your Customer) 절차를 자동화하고, 사기를 예방하며, 규제 요구사항을 손쉽게 충족할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

성명, 시민 상태, 출생일, 주소 세부 정보(주, 지역, 거주 지구) 및 관련 신원 필드를 빠르고 안전하게 자동으로 조회해야 하는 비즈니스를 위해 만들어졌습니다.

**이 정보에 안전하게 접근하려면 Authorization 헤더가 필요합니다.**

당사의 API는 페루의 공식 기록과 직접 연결되어 다음을 검증합니다.

-   **성명 및 DNI 번호**: *Documento Nacional de Identidad*(DNI) 문서를 지원합니다.
-   **신원 일치 여부**: 제공된 이름이 DNI 번호와 일치하는지 확인합니다.
-   **확장 개인 정보**: 시민 상태, 출생일, 성별, 주소, 주, 지역, 거주 지구를 반환합니다.
-   **이름 구성 요소**: `firstName`, `lastName`, `paternalLastName`, `maternalLastName`, `arrayName`을 반환합니다.
-   **문서 정보**: 문서 종류와 번호를 반환합니다.

일부 필드는 응답에 항상 포함되지만 현재 문자열 `not_available`을 반환합니다(생략되지 않음): `photo`, `expeditionDate`, `expirationDate`, `ubigeoReniec`, `verificationDigit`. 이 엔드포인트에서는 현재 사진을 제공하지 않습니다.

이러한 항목을 검증함으로써 거래 상대가 실존하며 유효한 문서를 보유하고 있음을 확신할 수 있고, 신원 도용 및 사기 위험을 크게 낮출 수 있습니다.

페루 국민의 **RENIEC DNI 확장 데이터**를 반환합니다: 성명, 시민 상태, 출생일, 주소(주, 지역, 거주 지구) 및 관련 신원 필드. `documentType=DNI`와 8자리 `documentNumber`를 전송합니다.

`photo`, `expeditionDate`, `expirationDate`, `ubigeoReniec`, `verificationDigit`는 응답 구조에 포함되지만 현재 `not_available`을 반환합니다.

氏名、配偶者の有無、生年月日、住所の詳細（省、地域、居住地区）および関連する本人情報フィールドに、迅速・安全・自動的にアクセスする必要があるビジネス向けに構築しました。

**この情報に安全にアクセスするには Authorization ヘッダーが必要です。**

本 API はペルーの公式記録と直接接続し、以下を検証します。

zh.title: 🇵🇪 秘鲁 — DNI（扩展信息）
zh.description: 使用 Verifik 的 KYC API 对秘鲁公民进行扩展身份核验，获取 DNI（国民身份证）的详细信息。直接对接官方数据源，在数秒内完成身份验证。
zh.overview:
Verifik 的身份核验 API 可使用秘鲁公民的 DNI（*Documento Nacional de Identidad*）号码进行扩展身份验证。该 API 旨在简化您的 KYC（了解您的客户）流程、防范欺诈，并轻松满足合规要求。

我们专为需要快速、安全且自动化获取扩展个人信息（包括姓名全称、婚姻状态、出生日期、地址明细（省、区域、居住区）及相关身份字段）的企业打造此集成。

**为安全访问该信息，必须传入 Authorization 头。**

我们的 API 直接对接秘鲁官方记录，验证以下内容：

-   **姓名全称与 DNI 号码**：支持 *Documento Nacional de Identidad*（DNI）证件。
-   **身份匹配**：确认所提供姓名与 DNI 号码相符。
-   **扩展个人信息**：返回婚姻状态、出生日期、性别、地址、省、区域和居住区。
-   **姓名组成部分**：返回 `firstName`、`lastName`、`paternalLastName`、`maternalLastName` 和 `arrayName`。
-   **证件信息**：返回证件类型和号码。

部分字段始终出现在响应中，但当前返回字符串 `not_available`（不会被省略）：`photo`、`expeditionDate`、`expirationDate`、`ubigeoReniec` 和 `verificationDigit`。此端点当前不提供照片。

通过验证这些信息，您可以确信对接的人员真实存在并持有有效证件，从而显著降低身份冒用与欺诈风险。

返回秘鲁公民的 **RENIEC DNI 扩展数据**：姓名全称、婚姻状态、出生日期、地址（省、区域、居住区）及相关身份字段。请传入 `documentType=DNI` 和 8 位 `documentNumber`。

`photo`、`expeditionDate`、`expirationDate`、`ubigeoReniec` 和 `verificationDigit` 包含在响应结构中，但当前返回 `not_available`。

params.description: 证件类型。允许值：`DNI`。
8 位 DNI 号码（不含空格）。

en.title: Peruvian Citizen v3
en.description: Verify identities of Peruvian citizens using DNI v3 API
en.overview:
Verifik's Identity Verification API helps you authenticate Peruvian citizens using the National Identity Document (DNI). It's designed to streamline your KYC (Know Your Customer) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the true identity of users, employees, or customers.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Full Name & DNI**: Supports *Documento Nacional de Identidad* (DNI).
-   **Personal Details**: Returns date of birth, gender, civil status, and address.
-   **Identity Match**: Confirms that the name provided matches the DNI number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the person you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

Standard **Peruvian DNI (v3)** identity check against RENIEC: validates that the **document number** matches official records and returns core identity fields (name, dates, civil status, address, etc.). Use `documentType=DNI` and the 8-digit `documentNumber`.

params.description: Document type. Allowed value: `DNI`.

es.title: Ciudadano Peruano v3
es.description: Verificar identidades de ciudadanos peruanos usando DNI API v3
es.overview:
La API de Verificación de Identidad de Verifik te ayuda a autenticar ciudadanos peruanos usando el Documento Nacional de Identidad (DNI). Está diseñada para agilizar tus procesos de KYC (Conozca a su Cliente), prevenir fraudes y asegurar el cumplimiento normativo sin complicaciones.

Creamos esta integración para empresas que necesitan una forma rápida, segura y automatizada de confirmar la verdadera identidad de usuarios, empleados o clientes.

Nuestra API se conecta directamente con registros oficiales para validar:

-   **Nombre Completo y DNI**: Soporta *Documento Nacional de Identidad* (DNI).
-   **Detalles Personales**: Retorna fecha de nacimiento, género, estado civil y dirección.
-   **Coincidencia de Identidad**: Verifica que el nombre proporcionado coincida con el número DNI.

Al verificar estos detalles, puedes tener la certeza de que la persona con la que tratas es real y posee un documento válido, reduciendo significativamente el riesgo de suplantación y fraude.

Consulta estándar de **DNI peruano (v3)** ante RENIEC: valida el **número de documento** y devuelve datos básicos de identidad. Usa `documentType=DNI` y el `documentNumber` de 8 dígitos.

fr.description: Vérification d'identité au Pérou par DNI (v3/pe/cedula).
fr.overview:
L'API de vérification d'identité de Verifik vous permet d'authentifier les citoyens péruviens à partir du Document national d'identité (DNI). Elle est conçue pour fluidifier vos processus KYC (Know Your Customer), prévenir la fraude et vous assurer de respecter sans effort toutes les exigences réglementaires.

Nous avons construit cette intégration pour les entreprises qui ont besoin d'un moyen rapide, sécurisé et automatisé de confirmer la véritable identité de leurs utilisateurs, employés ou clients.

Notre API se connecte directement aux registres officiels pour valider :

-   **Nom complet et DNI** : prend en charge le *Documento Nacional de Identidad* (DNI).
-   **Données personnelles** : retourne la date de naissance, le sexe, l'état civil et l'adresse.
-   **Correspondance d'identité** : confirme que le nom fourni correspond au numéro DNI.

En vérifiant ces éléments, vous pouvez avoir la certitude que la personne avec qui vous traitez existe et possède un document valide, ce qui réduit considérablement les risques d'usurpation d'identité et de fraude.

Contrôle standard du **DNI péruvien (v3)** via le RENIEC : valide le **numéro de document** et renvoie les champs d’identité principaux. Utilisez `documentType=DNI` et un `documentNumber` à 8 chiffres.
