pt.description: Verifique a identidade de cidadãos peruanos usando o DNI com a API KYC v3 da Verifik. Conecte-se a fontes oficiais e verifique dados pessoais em segundos.
pt.overview:
A API de verificação de identidade da Verifik permite autenticar cidadãos peruanos usando o Documento Nacional de Identidade (DNI). Foi projetada para automatizar seus processos de KYC (*Know Your Customer*), prevenir fraudes e garantir o cumprimento de todos os requisitos regulatórios sem esforço.

Construímos esta integração para empresas que precisam de uma forma rápida, segura e automatizada de confirmar a verdadeira identidade de usuários, funcionários ou clientes.

Nossa API conecta-se diretamente aos registros oficiais para validar:

-   **Nome completo e DNI**: suporta o *Documento Nacional de Identidad* (DNI).
-   **Detalhes pessoais**: retorna data de nascimento, gênero, estado civil e endereço.
-   **Correspondência de identidade**: confirma que o nome informado corresponde ao número do DNI.

Ao validar esses elementos, você pode confiar que a pessoa com quem está negociando é real e possui um documento válido, reduzindo significativamente os riscos de personificação e fraude.

Consulta padrão de **DNI peruano (v3)** no RENIEC: valida o **número do documento** e retorna dados básicos de identidade. Use `documentType=DNI` e `documentNumber` com 8 dígitos.

ko.title: 🇵🇪 페루
ko.description: DNI v3 API로 페루 국민의 신원을 검증합니다.
ko.overview:
Verifik의 신원 확인 API는 국가 신분증(DNI, *Documento Nacional de Identidad*)을 사용해 페루 국민의 신원을 인증할 수 있도록 합니다. KYC(Know Your Customer) 절차를 자동화하고, 사기를 예방하며, 규제 요구사항을 손쉽게 충족할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

사용자, 직원, 고객의 진짜 신원을 빠르고 안전하게 자동으로 확인해야 하는 비즈니스를 위해 만들어졌습니다.

당사의 API는 공식 기록과 직접 연결되어 다음을 검증합니다.

-   **전체 성명 및 DNI**: *Documento Nacional de Identidad*(DNI)를 지원합니다.
-   **개인 상세 정보**: 출생일, 성별, 시민 상태, 주소를 반환합니다.
-   **신원 일치 여부**: 제공된 이름이 DNI 번호와 일치하는지 확인합니다.

이러한 항목을 검증함으로써 거래 상대가 실존하며 유효한 문서를 보유하고 있음을 확신할 수 있고, 신원 도용 및 사기 위험을 크게 낮출 수 있습니다.

페루 **DNI(v3)** 표준 본인 확인입니다. RENIEC와 연동해 **문서 번호**를 검증하고 핵심 신원 정보를 반환합니다. `documentType=DNI`와 8자리 `documentNumber`를 사용합니다.

ユーザー、従業員、顧客の真の本人性を、迅速・安全・自動的に確認したいビジネス向けに構築しました。

This endpoint returns **Ministry of Labor** certificate information for a Colombian individual, including data associated with **height / occupational safety** training (*curso de alturas*), sourced from Verifik’s **Bogotá microservice**. The **v3** handler returns the **full microservice payload** and exposes certificate rows under **`records`** (mapped from the upstream `constances` field).

Use it for **employment compliance**, **contractor onboarding**, and **workplace safety** checks where this registry is allowed.

- **`records`** — list of certificate / constance rows returned by the integration (renamed from upstream `constances`)
- Any **additional fields** returned by the microservice on `data` (structure may evolve with the source)
- A **signed** Verifik response

**GET** with **query parameters** only for this route (**no** `POST` on the v3 router). The legacy **`v2`** path uses the same parameter names with a different response shape; see Notes.

Query summary: **`documentType`**, **`documentNumber`**.

**雇用コンプライアンス**、**請負業者オンボーディング**、**職場安全**確認に利用できます。

- **records** — 統合が返す証明書・constance 行（上流 constances から改名）
- `data` 上のマイクロサービス追加フィールド（構造はソースに依存）
- Verifik **署名**付きレスポンス

**GET** のみ（**v3** ルーターに POST なし）。クエリ: **documentType**, **documentNumber**。

本接口返回哥伦比亚个人的 **劳动部（Ministerio de Trabajo）** 证书信息，包括与 **高空 / 职业安全** 培训（*curso de alturas*）相关的数据，数据来源于 Verifik 的 **波哥大微服务**。**v3** 处理程序返回 **完整微服务载荷**，并在 **`records`** 字段下暴露证书记录（由上游 `constances` 字段映射而来）。

适用于 **用工合规**、**承包商入职** 及 **工作场所安全** 核查等场景（须符合当地法规与您的数据政策）。

- **`records`** — 集成返回的证书 / 证明行列表（由上游 `constances` 重命名）
- 微服务在 `data` 上返回的 **其他字段**（结构可能随数据源演进）
- 经 Verifik **签名** 的响应

本路由为 **GET**，仅使用 **查询参数**（v3 路由上 **无** POST）。旧版 **`v2`** 路径参数名相同但响应结构不同；详见说明。

en.title: Peruvian Business Verification
en.description: Validate Peruvian companies with Verifik's KYB API. Connect with official sources and verify business data in seconds.
en.overview:
Verifik's Business Verification API helps you authenticate Peruvian companies using official government data. It's designed to streamline your KYB (Know Your Business) processes, prevent fraud, and ensure you meet all regulatory requirements effortlessly.

We built this integration for businesses that need a fast, secure, and automated way to confirm the legitimacy of companies, partners, or vendors.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Company Name & RUC Number**: Supports *Registro Único de Contribuyente* (RUC).
-   **Business Information**: Returns company name, address, taxpayer condition, and status.
-   **Company Match**: Confirms that the company information matches the RUC number.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the company you're dealing with is legitimate and properly registered, significantly lowering the risk of fraud and ensuring compliance.

Look up a Peruvian company by **RUC** (`documentType=RUC` and the business `documentNumber`). Returns legal name, status, address, and taxpayer condition from official registries—useful for **KYB**, onboarding vendors, and due diligence.

params.description: Document type. Allowed value: `RUC`.
Company identifier.

<?php
$ch = curl_init("https://api.verifik.co/v3/pe/company");
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
    "Accept: application/json",
    "Authorization: Bearer " . getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN")
]);
$query = http_build_query([
    "documentType" => "RUC",
    "documentNumber" => "20605980008"
]);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, "https://api.verifik.co/v3/pe/company?".$query);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
$response = curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);
echo $response;

L'API de vérification d'entreprise de Verifik vous permet d'authentifier les sociétés péruviennes à partir des données officielles du gouvernement. Elle est conçue pour fluidifier vos processus KYB (Know Your Business), prévenir la fraude et vous assurer de respecter sans effort toutes les exigences réglementaires.

Nous avons construit cette intégration pour les entreprises qui ont besoin d'un moyen rapide, sécurisé et automatisé de confirmer la légitimité de sociétés, partenaires ou fournisseurs.

Notre API se connecte directement aux registres officiels pour valider :

-   **Nom et numéro RUC** : prend en charge le *Registro Único de Contribuyente* (RUC).
-   **Informations sur l'entreprise** : retourne la raison sociale, l'adresse, la condition du contribuable et le statut.
-   **Correspondance d'entreprise** : confirme que les informations correspondent au numéro RUC.

En vérifiant ces éléments, vous pouvez avoir la certitude que la société avec laquelle vous traitez est légitime et dûment enregistrée, ce qui réduit considérablement les risques de fraude et garantit votre conformité.

Interrogez une société péruvienne par **RUC** avec `documentType=RUC` et `documentNumber`. Retourne raison sociale, statut, adresse et situation fiscale à partir des registres officiels (KYB et due diligence).

pt.title: 🇵🇪 Peru — Verificação de empresas
pt.description: Valide empresas peruanas com a API KYB da Verifik. Conecte-se a fontes oficiais e verifique dados empresariais em segundos.
pt.overview:
A API de verificação de empresas da Verifik permite autenticar empresas peruanas usando dados oficiais do governo. Foi projetada para automatizar seus processos de KYB (*Know Your Business*), prevenir fraudes e garantir o cumprimento de todos os requisitos regulatórios sem esforço.

Construímos esta integração para empresas que precisam de uma forma rápida, segura e automatizada de confirmar a legitimidade de companhias, parceiros ou fornecedores.

Nossa API conecta-se diretamente aos registros oficiais para validar:

-   **Nome da empresa e número do RUC**: suporta o *Registro Único de Contribuyente* (RUC).
-   **Informações empresariais**: retorna nome da empresa, endereço, condição do contribuinte e status.
-   **Correspondência da empresa**: confirma que as informações da empresa correspondem ao número do RUC.

Ao validar esses elementos, você pode confiar que a empresa com a qual está negociando é legítima e está devidamente registrada, reduzindo significativamente os riscos de fraude e garantindo conformidade.

Consulta empresa peruana por **RUC** com `documentType=RUC` e `documentNumber`. Retorna razão social, status, endereço e situação fiscal a partir de registros oficiais (KYB e due diligence).

ko.title: 🇵🇪 페루 기업 검증
ko.description: Verifik의 KYB API로 페루 기업을 검증합니다. 공식 출처와 직접 연결되어 수 초 내에 기업 데이터를 확인합니다.
ko.overview:
Verifik의 기업 검증 API는 정부 공식 데이터를 활용해 페루 기업의 진위를 확인할 수 있도록 합니다. KYB(Know Your Business) 절차를 자동화하고 사기를 방지하며 규제 요구사항을 손쉽게 충족할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

기업, 파트너, 공급업체의 적법성을 빠르고 안전하게 자동으로 확인해야 하는 비즈니스를 위해 만들어졌습니다.

당사의 API는 공식 기록과 직접 연결되어 다음을 검증합니다.

-   **회사명 및 RUC 번호**: *Registro Único de Contribuyente*(RUC)를 지원합니다.
-   **기업 정보**: 회사명, 주소, 납세자 조건, 상태를 반환합니다.
-   **회사 일치 여부**: 입력된 기업 정보가 RUC 번호와 일치하는지 확인합니다.

이러한 항목을 검증함으로써 거래 상대 기업이 실재하며 정상 등록된 기업임을 확신할 수 있고, 사기 위험을 크게 낮추는 동시에 컴플라이언스를 확보할 수 있습니다.

페루 법인을 **RUC**로 조회합니다. `documentType=RUC`와 `documentNumber`를 사용하며, 상호·상태·주소·납세 정보 등 공식 등기 데이터를 반환합니다(KYB·실사).

ja.title: ペルー — 法人検証
ja.description: Verifik の KYB API を使用してペルー企業を検証します。公式ソースに直接接続し、企業データを数秒で確認できます。
ja.overview:
Verifik の法人検証 API は、公的な政府データを利用してペルーの企業を認証します。KYB（Know Your Business）プロセスの効率化、不正防止、各種規制要件への対応を簡単に実現できるよう設計されています。

企業、取引先、ベンダーの正当性を迅速・安全・自動的に確認したいビジネス向けに構築しました。

本 API は公式記録と直接接続し、以下を検証します。

-   **企業名と RUC 番号**: *Registro Único de Contribuyente*（RUC）に対応します。
-   **企業情報**: 企業名、住所、納税者の状態、ステータスを返します。
-   **企業の一致**: 入力された企業情報が RUC 番号と一致するかを確認します。

これらを検証することで、取引相手の企業が正当に登記されていることを確認でき、不正リスクの大幅な低減と法令遵守を実現できます。

ペルー法人を **RUC**（*Registro Único de Contribuyente*）で照会します。`documentType=RUC` と `documentNumber` を指定し、商号・住所・ステータス・納税者区分など、公式の法人登記情報を取得します（KYB・取引先確認に利用）。

zh.title: 秘鲁企业核验
zh.description: 使用 Verifik 的 KYB API 核验秘鲁企业。直接对接官方数据源，在数秒内完成企业数据核验。
zh.overview:
Verifik 的企业核验 API 可基于政府官方数据对秘鲁企业进行身份核实。该接口旨在简化您的 KYB（了解您的企业）流程、防范欺诈，并轻松满足合规要求。

我们专为需要快速、安全且自动化确认企业、合作伙伴或供应商合法性的组织打造此集成。

我们的 API 直接对接官方记录，验证以下内容：

-   **公司名称与 RUC 号码**：支持 *Registro Único de Contribuyente*（RUC）。
-   **企业信息**：返回公司名称、地址、纳税人状况及状态。
-   **企业匹配**：确认企业信息与 RUC 号码相符。

通过验证这些信息，您可以确信对接的企业真实合法且依法登记，从而显著降低欺诈风险并保障合规。

通过秘鲁 **RUC** 查询企业：使用 `documentType=RUC` 与 `documentNumber`，返回商号、状态、地址及纳税信息等官方登记数据（适用于 KYB 与尽调）。

en.title: United States - Passport & U.S. entries
en.description: Query passport-related U.S. entry and exit information using traveler and passport fields
en.overview:
Use this endpoint to request **passport-linked U.S. travel history** (entries and exits) for screening and compliance workflows. Provide the traveler’s identity fields and passport identifiers as query parameters.

Submit `firstName`, `lastName`, `dateOfBirth`, `passportNumber`, and `passportCountry` as query parameters. Date format should match your integration contract (commonly `YYYY-MM-DD` or `dd/mm/yyyy`).

params.description: Traveler’s first name as on the passport.
Traveler’s last name as on the passport.
Date of birth (use the format agreed for your project).
Machine-readable passport number.
Issuing country of the passport (ISO code or country name, per integration).

requestExamples.label: JavaScript
Python
requestExamples.code:
params = urllib.parse.urlencode({
    "firstName": "JOHN",
    "lastName": "DOE",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-15",
    "passportNumber": "P12345678",
    "passportCountry": "CO",
})
conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.verifik.co")
conn.request("GET", f"/v2/passport/us/entries?{params}", "", {})
res = conn.getresponse()
print(res.read().decode("utf-8"))

notes: **Availability** of this product may be restricted; confirm with your account team before production use.
**Field formats** (especially `dateOfBirth`) must follow the contract used by your Verifik integration.

Envía `firstName`, `lastName`, `dateOfBirth`, `passportNumber` y `passportCountry` como parámetros de consulta. El formato de fecha debe seguir el contrato de tu integración (por ejemplo `YYYY-MM-DD` o `dd/mm/yyyy`).

requestExamples.label: Node.js
PHP
requestExamples.code:
<?php
$ch = curl_init("https://api.verifik.co/v2/face-recognition/search-active-user");
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
    "Content-Type: application/json",
    "Authorization: Bearer " . getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN")
]);
$body = json_encode([
    "image" => "<base64>",
    "collection_id" => "<collection_id>",
    "os" => "DESKTOP",
    "min_score" => 0.7,
    "search_mode" => "ACCURATE"
]);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, $body);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
$response = curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);
echo $response;

requestExamples.code:

    "Content-Type": "application/json",

}
payload = {
    "image": "<base64>",

print(r.json())

requestExamples.code:
package main

    "bytes"
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "net/http"
    "os"
)

func main() {
    payload := map[string]interface{}{
        "image": "<base64>",
        "collection_id": "<collection_id>",
        "os": "DESKTOP",
        "min_score": 0.7,
        "search_mode": "ACCURATE",
    }
    b, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
    req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.verifik.co/v2/face-recognition/search-active-user", bytes.NewBuffer(b))
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN"))
    resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    var out map[string]interface{}

    fmt.Println(out)
}

es.overview:
Este servicio te permite **consultar información asociada a una matrícula española** (formato habitual de placas nacionales) y recibir datos estructurados cuando la consulta encuentra coincidencia en la fuente integrada por Verifik.

**Qué obtienes:** normalmente datos útiles para identificar el vehículo en contexto de negocio: por ejemplo marca, modelo, año o tipo, según lo que devuelva la fuente en tu respuesta. La tabla de ejemplo en esta página ilustra la forma del payload; los campos concretos pueden variar según disponibilidad y versión del servicio.

**Casos de uso habituales:** suscripción de seguros o renovaciones donde hay que contrastar vehículo declarado vs. registro; marketplaces de vehículos usados; flotas y logística para validar altas de conductores; o procesos de riesgo donde una matrícula incorrecta implica fraude o error de datos.

**Qué no es:** no sustituye una inspección física ni un informe pericial; es una **consulta automatizada por matrícula**. Si la matrícula no existe, está mal formateada o no hay registro accesible, recibirás el error documentado (por ejemplo 404 o validación de parámetros). Normaliza siempre la matrícula (sin espacios, según las reglas de la API) antes de llamar.

**Privacidad y uso:** utiliza este endpoint solo para finalidades legítimas acordes con tu política de privacidad y la normativa aplicable; el titular del proceso debe saber para qué se consultan datos del vehículo cuando así lo exija la ley.

Consulta por **matrícula** (sin espacios) los datos del vehículo disponibles en la fuente: habitualmente marca, modelo, año, tipo de vehículo u otros campos según disponibilidad. Útil para **seguros**, compraventa, flotas y antifraud: contrastas lo que declara el usuario con un registro coherente. No sustituye inspección física ni peritaje. Si la matrícula no existe o el formato es incorrecto, recibirás el error documentado (404 o validación).

en.title: Colombia - INPEC Prison Records Check
en.description: Query the population deprived of liberty under the custody of INPEC (Colombian National Penitentiary and Prison Institute)
en.overview:
The INPEC Prison Records Check service allows verification of the current incarceration status of individuals in facilities managed by the Colombian National Penitentiary and Prison Institute (INPEC). This API endpoint validates whether a person is currently deprived of liberty in any INPEC-administered detention center and provides detailed information about their legal status, admission type, prison location, and unique identification number within the penitentiary system.

This service is designed for judicial authorities, law enforcement agencies, state control bodies, and authorized organizations that need to verify the current status of individuals within the Colombian penitentiary system for legal, security, or due diligence purposes.

Document number of the person to consult, without spaces or periods.
First surname of the person to consult.

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.verifik.co")

    'Accept': "application/json",
    'Authorization': "Bearer <your_token>"
}

conn.request("GET", "/v2/co/inpec?documentType=CC&documentNumber=80086615&firstSurname=MURCIA", headers=headers)

data = res.read()

Este endpoint de API valida si una persona se encuentra actualmente privada de la libertad en cualquier centro de detención administrado por INPEC y proporciona información detallada sobre su estado legal, tipo de admisión, ubicación penitenciaria y número único de identificación dentro del sistema carcelario.

Este servicio está diseñado para autoridades judiciales, organismos de seguridad del estado, organismos de control y organizaciones autorizadas que necesitan verificar el estado actual de individuos dentro del sistema penitenciario colombiano con fines legales, de seguridad o de debida diligencia.

fr.title: Colombie - INPEC (détention)
fr.description: Statut de privation de liberté sous la responsabilité de l'INPEC (Colombie).
fr.overview:
Le service de vérification des dossiers pénitentiaires INPEC permet de vérifier le statut actuel d'incarcération des personnes dans les établissements gérés par l'Instituto Nacional Penitenciario y Carcelario (INPEC) de Colombie. Cet endpoint indique si une personne est actuellement privée de liberté dans un centre de détention administré par l'INPEC et fournit des informations détaillées sur son statut juridique, son type d'admission, l'établissement de détention et son numéro d'identification unique au sein du système pénitentiaire.

Ce service est destiné aux autorités judiciaires, aux forces de l'ordre, aux organes de contrôle de l'État et aux organisations habilitées qui ont besoin de vérifier le statut actuel de personnes détenues dans le système pénitentiaire colombien à des fins légales, sécuritaires ou de diligence raisonnable.

pt.title: Colômbia - Verificação de Antecedentes Penitenciários (INPEC)
pt.description: Consulte a população privada de liberdade sob custódia do INPEC (Instituto Nacional Penitenciário e Carcerário da Colômbia).
pt.overview:
O serviço de Verificação de Antecedentes Penitenciários do INPEC permite verificar o status atual de encarceramento de pessoas em estabelecimentos administrados pelo Instituto Nacional Penitenciário e Carcerário da Colômbia (INPEC). Este endpoint da API valida se uma pessoa está atualmente privada de liberdade em algum centro de detenção administrado pelo INPEC e fornece informações detalhadas sobre seu status legal, tipo de admissão, localização da prisão e número único de identificação dentro do sistema penitenciário.

Este serviço é projetado para autoridades judiciais, órgãos de aplicação da lei, órgãos de controle estatal e organizações autorizadas que precisam verificar o status atual de pessoas dentro do sistema penitenciário colombiano para fins legais, de segurança ou de due diligence.

en.overview: Creates a HumanID (verifiable credential) by encrypting metadata of any kind and storing it in IPFS, a decentralized alternative to conventional cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Each HumanID can later be verified by the owner without storing the owner's biometric data.

package main

en.title: Guatemala Extra
en.description: Validate the identity of individuals in Guatemala with additional details such as birth date and gender.
en.overview:
Verifik's Identity Verification API helps you authenticate Guatemalan citizens using official government data. This endpoint provides additional details such as birth date and gender.

Our API connects directly with official records to validate:

-   **Full Name & CUI Number**: Supports *Cédula de Vecindad* or *Documento Personal de Identificación* (CUI).
-   **Identity Match**: Confirms that the name provided matches the CUI number.
-   **Extra Data**: Retrieves **Birth Date** and **Gender**.

By verifying these details, you can be confident that the person you're dealing with is real and holds a valid document, significantly lowering the risk of impersonation and fraud.

params.description: Document type. Allowed value: `CUI`.
Document number.
Date of birth (`DD/MM/YYYY`). Required by validation for this route.

requestExamples.label: Node.js
PHP
requestExamples.code:
<?php
$ch = curl_init("https://api.verifik.co/v2/gt/cedula/extra");
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
    "Accept: application/json",
    "Authorization: Bearer " . getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN")
]);
$query = http_build_query([
    "documentType" => "CUI",
    "documentNumber" => "2222624190903",
    "dateOfBirth" => "12/03/1984"
]);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, "https://api.verifik.co/v2/gt/cedula/extra?".$query);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
$response = curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);
echo $response;

requestExamples.label: Python
Go
requestExamples.code:
package main

    "fmt"
    "net/http"
)

func main() {
    url := "https://api.verifik.co/v2/gt/cedula/extra?documentType=CUI&documentNumber=2222624190903&dateOfBirth=12/03/1984"
    req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", url, nil)
    req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+getenv("VERIFIK_TOKEN"))
    resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    fmt.Println(resp.Status)
}

notes: `documentType` must be `CUI`.
`dateOfBirth` is required and must use **`DD/MM/YYYY`** format (for example, `12/03/1984`), even though birth date in the response is sourced from a separate SAT lookup.

es.title: Guatemala Extra
es.description: Valida la identidad de personas en Guatemala con detalles adicionales como fecha de nacimiento y género.
es.overview:
La API de Verificación de Identidad de Verifik te ayuda a autenticar ciudadanos guatemaltecos usando datos oficiales del gobierno. Este endpoint proporciona detalles adicionales como fecha de nacimiento y género.

Nuestra API se conecta directamente con registros oficiales para validar:

-   **Nombre Completo y Número CUI**: Soporta *Cédula de Vecindad* o *Documento Personal de Identificación* (CUI).
-   **Coincidencia de Identidad**: Verifica que el nombre proporcionado coincida con el número CUI.
-   **Datos Extra**: Recupera **Fecha de Nacimiento** y **Género**.

Al verificar estos detalles, puedes tener la certeza de que la persona con la que tratas es real y posee un documento válido, reduciendo significativamente el riesgo de suplantación y fraude.

en.title: India EPIC (Voter ID) — Person & Name Lookup | Verifik
en.description: Retrieve voter name and related fields from the Electoral Commission of India (ECI) using a 10-character EPIC (Voter ID) via Verifik's API.
en.overview:
Verifik exposes a single REST endpoint to look up **voter name** information tied to an Indian **EPIC** (*Elector's Photo Identity Card* number) from sources aligned with the **Electoral Commission of India (ECI)**. Use it to support identity checks, onboarding flows, and compliance workflows that require confirming that a Voter ID number returns consistent registered name data.

The API connects to official electoral data to return:

- **Voter name structure**: First and last name (including script-local variants where available).
- **Full name and relative's name**: Fields suitable for display and matching in Roman and local scripts.
- **EPIC match**: Confirms the supplied **10-character** EPIC (letters and numbers) is recognized and returns associated records.

This reduces manual checks and helps you keep voter-related verification consistent with the underlying registry.

Send a **GET** request with the EPIC in the `documentNumber` query parameter. The service returns structured name fields, optional local-script values, and a Verifik **signature** block on success.

ja.title: インド EPIC（Voter ID）— 氏名照会 | Verifik

zh.title: 印度 EPIC（选民证）— 姓名查询 | Verifik

en.title: India EPIC (Voter ID) — Polling & voting location | Verifik
en.description: Retrieve assembly, part, and polling-place details for an Indian EPIC (Voter ID) from ECI-oriented sources via Verifik''s API.
en.overview:
This endpoint returns **where the voter is assigned to vote**: assembly, district, part (polling-section) details, building name, and related location fields—based on a valid **10-character EPIC** (*Elector's Photo Identity Card* number). It complements the [name-lookup API](/legal/epic-eci) when you need **polling-place context** for logistics, support, or compliance checks.

The API returns electoral **location and assignment** data for a given EPIC, for example:

- **Constituency and part**: Assembly (AC) identifiers, part number and name, section serial where applicable.
- **Geography**: District, state, and parliamentary association where exposed by the source.
- **Polling place**: Building name, address, and any room or booth details returned for the EPIC.
- **EPIC match**: The query must use a full, valid **10-character** EPIC in `documentNumber`.

Send a **GET** request with the EPIC in the `documentNumber` query parameter. The response is tailored to **polling and voting-location** data (not the name-only profile returned by `GET /v2/in/epic`).

ko.title: 인도 EPIC (Voter ID) — 투표소 및 투표 위치 | Verifik
ko.description: 인도 EPIC(Voter ID)에 대한 의회구, 섹션, 투표소 세부 정보를 ECI 기반 출처와 Verifik API로 조회합니다.
ko.overview:
이 엔드포인트는 유효한 **10자 EPIC**(*Elector's Photo Identity Card*)를 기준으로 유권자가 **어디에 배정되어 투표하는지** — 의회구, 지구, 섹션(part), 건물명 및 관련 위치 필드 — 를 반환합니다. 물류·지원·컴플라이언스를 위해 **투표소 맥락**이 필요할 때 [이름 조회 API](/verifik-ko/legal/epic-eci)를 보완합니다.

API는 주어진 EPIC에 대한 선거 **위치 및 배정** 데이터를 반환합니다. 예:

- **선거구 및 섹션**: 의회구(AC) 식별자, 섹션 번호·이름, 해당 시 일련번호.
- **지리**: 출처가 노출하는 경우 지구, 주, 의회 연관 정보.
- **투표소**: EPIC에 대해 반환된 건물명, 주소, 방/부스 세부 정보.
- **EPIC 일치**: `documentNumber`에 완전한 유효 **10자** EPIC를 사용해야 합니다.

`documentNumber`에 EPIC를 넣어 **GET** 요청을 보냅니다. 응답은 **투표 위치** 데이터에 맞춰져 있으며(`GET /v2/in/epic`의 이름 전용 프로필이 아님).

ja.title: インド EPIC（Voter ID）— 投票所・投票場所 | Verifik
ja.description: インド EPIC（Voter ID）の議会区・部・投票所の詳細を、ECI 指向ソースと Verifik API で取得します。
ja.overview:
このエンドポイントは、有効な **10 文字 EPIC**（*Elector's Photo Identity Card*）に基づき、有権者が **どこで投票するよう割り当てられているか** — 議会区、地区、部（part）、建物名および関連する場所フィールド — を返します。物流・サポート・コンプライアンスで **投票所コンテキスト** が必要な場合、[氏名照会 API](/verifik-ja/legal/epic-eci) を補完します。

API は指定 EPIC の選挙 **場所・割当** データを返します。例:

- **選挙区と部**: 議会区（AC）識別子、部番号・名称、該当する場合は通し番号。
- **地理**: ソースが公開する地区、州、議会関連情報。
- **投票所**: EPIC に対して返される建物名、住所、部屋・ブース詳細。
- **EPIC 一致**: `documentNumber` に完全で有効な **10 文字** EPIC を使用する必要があります。

`documentNumber` に EPIC を指定して **GET** を送信します。レスポンスは **投票場所** データ向けです（`GET /v2/in/epic` の氏名のみプロファイルではありません）。

zh.title: 印度 EPIC（选民证）— 投票站与投票地点 | Verifik
zh.description: 通过 Verifik API 与面向 ECI 的来源，检索印度 EPIC（选民证）的议会选区、分区与投票站详情。
zh.overview:
此端点返回选民 **被分配到何处投票**：议会选区、地区、分区（part）、建筑名称及相关位置字段——基于有效的 **10 位 EPIC**（*Elector's Photo Identity Card*）。当您需要 **投票站上下文** 用于物流、支持或合规时，它可补充 [姓名查询 API](/verifik-zh/legal/epic-eci)。

API 返回给定 EPIC 的选举 **位置与分配** 数据，例如：

- **选区与分区**：议会选区（AC）标识、分区编号与名称，以及适用时的序号。
- **地理**：来源暴露时的地区、邦与议会关联信息。
- **投票站**：为该 EPIC 返回的建筑名称、地址及房间/票亭详情。
- **EPIC 匹配**：查询必须在 `documentNumber` 中使用完整有效的 **10 位** EPIC。

在 `documentNumber` 中发送 EPIC，发起 **GET** 请求。响应面向 **投票地点** 数据（而非 `GET /v2/in/epic` 返回的仅姓名资料）。

en.title: Colombia — National ID premium lookup (CC)
en.description: Verify a Colombian national ID (CC) with a full profile: you type only the number, Verifik finds the issue date for you, and you get the same rich identity record as cédula extra. Uses more credits than the basic cédula check.
en.overview:
**Purpose:** confirm a **Colombian *Cédula de Ciudadanía* (CC)** against official sources and return a **structured identity record** suitable for KYC and compliance workflows—not a binary pass/fail on the number alone. The response reflects **how the name is recorded**, **date of birth**, **place and date of issue**, and—where provided by sources—**gender** and **alive status**, with a **signed certification** block in the response. **Submit only the document number**; the **issue date is resolved server-side** (no `documentType` or issue date in the request). Record depth matches [**cédula extra**](/identity/colombia-full-id). Credit consumption is **higher** than the [**basic cédula endpoint**](/identity-validation/colombia/colombian-citizen) because of additional resolution steps.

**Response:** Returns **`data`** (identity attributes returned for the submitted number), **`signature`** (certification metadata for the payload), and **`id`** (request identifier). **HTTP 404** indicates that a complete identity record could not be assembled for the supplied number under this workflow. **HTTP 409** indicates that the request failed validation (for example, `documentNumber` length) before upstream resolution. Per-request **credit cost** exceeds the basic `/v2/co/cedula` route because of the chained resolution.

params.description: CC number, **digits only** after normalization (non-digits stripped). **5–10** characters (API validation).

requestExamples.label: GET
POST

notes: **CC only** — there is no `documentType` on this route; the flow always treats the number as **CC** (see controller).
Prefer **digits only** in `documentNumber` (spaces and separators are stripped server-side).
For **PPT**, **CE**, or other types, use the appropriate dedicated endpoints—not this one.

pt.title: 🇨🇴 Colômbia — Cédula nacional premium (CC)
pt.description: Confirme uma cédula colombiana (CC) com um perfil completo: você informa só o número, a Verifik encontra a data de expedição e devolve o mesmo registro rico da cédula extra. Usa mais créditos que a verificação básica.
pt.overview:
**Finalidade:** **validar** uma **Cédula de Ciudadanía (CC)** perante **fontes oficiais** e retornar um **registro de identidade estruturado** para KYC e conformidade, e não apenas um sim/não sobre o número. A resposta consolida **nome conforme o cadastro**, **data de nascimento**, **local e data de expedição** e, quando houver, **gênero** e **sinal de vida**, com bloco de **certificação assinada**. **Apenas o número** é informado; a **data de expedição é resolvida no servidor** (sem tipo de documento ou data na requisição). Nível de detalhe **equivalente à cédula extra**. O **custo de créditos** é **maior** que o do **endpoint básico** devido à cadeia de resolução.

**Resposta:** retorna **`data`** (atributos de identidade retornados para o número informado), **`signature`** (metadados de certificação do payload) e **`id`** (identificador da requisição). **HTTP 404** indica que não foi possível montar um registro completo para o número neste fluxo. **HTTP 409** indica falha de validação de entrada (p. ex. comprimento de `documentNumber`) antes do processamento. **Custo de créditos** por requisição **superior** ao de `/v2/co/cedula` básico, pela cadeia de resolução.

params.description: Número da *Cédula de Ciudadanía* (**CC**). O servidor **normaliza** para somente **dígitos**; o comprimento deve ficar entre **5 e 10** caracteres (validação de API).

ko.title: 🇨🇴 콜롬비아 — 국민 신분증 프리미엄(CC)
ko.description: 콜롬비아 국민신분증(CC)로 본인 확인을 “프로필 수준”으로: 번호만 입력하고 발급일은 Verifik이 찾은 뒤, cédula extra와 같은 풍부한 신원 기록이 돌아옵니다. 기본 취득 API보다 크레딧을 더 씁니다.
ko.overview:
**목적:** 콜롬비아 **CC(국민신분증)** 번호를 **공식 출처**에 대조하여 **정형화된 신원 레코드**를 반환합니다(KYC·AML·규정 절차용). **등록상 성명·생년월일·발급일시·발급지** 및, 출처가 제공하는 경우 **성별·생존 여부**를 포함하며, **서명 기반 인증** 정보가 응답에 포함됩니다. **제출은 번호만** — **발급일은 서버에서 자동으로 확정**되며(요청에 문서 유형·발급일 **미포함**), 상세 수준은 **cédula extra**와 **동일**합니다. **기본** `/v2/co/cedula` 엔드포인트보다 **크레딧**이 **높습니다**(연쇄 해상도 단계).

**응답:** **`data`**(제출한 번호에 대해 출처가 반환한 신원 속성), **`signature`**(페이로드에 대한 인증 메타데이터), **`id`**(요청 식별자)를 반환합니다. **HTTP 404**는 본 엔드포인트 흐름에서 해당 번호에 대한 **완전한 신원 레코드를 구성할 수 없음**을 뜻합니다. **HTTP 409**는 상위 연동 전 **입력 유효성 검사**에 실패(예: `documentNumber` 길이)했음을 뜻합니다. 요청당 **크레딧**은 **기본** `/v2/co/cedula`보다 **높습니다**(연쇄 해상도). **CC**만 지원, 일반 **5~10**자리 숫자.

params.description: 콜롬비아 **CC**(국민신분증) 번호. **비숫자는 정규화로 제거**되며, **5~10**자 **숫자**로 유효성이 검사됩니다. `documentType`·발급일은 **불필요**(프리미엄).

ja.title: 🇨🇴 コロンビア — 国民身分証プレミアム(CC)
ja.description: コロンビア国民身分証（CC）を「本人像」で確認: 番号だけ入力。発行日はVerifikが裏で解決し、cédula extra相当の豊富な戻り値。基本の照会よりクレジット高め。
ja.overview:
**目的:** コロンビア **CC（国民身分証）** 番号を**公的ソース**に照合し、KYC および法令対応向けの**構造化本人情報**を返します。戻り値は**名義、生年月日、発行日時・発行地**、ソースが返す範囲で**性別・生存**等を含み、**署名付きの認証ブロック**を含みます。**送信は番号のみ**—**発行日はサーバ側で解決**（リクエストに文書区分・発行日 **なし**）。属性の**粒度は cédula extra と同相当**です。**消費クレジット**は**基本** `/v2/co/cedula` より**高く**、連鎖的な前処理分が含まれます。

**レスポンス:** **`data`**（当該番号に対しソースが返す本人属性）、**`signature`**（ペイロードの認証メタデータ）、**`id`**（要求識別子）を返します。**HTTP 404** は、本フローでは当該番号について**完全な本人レコードを組み立てられなかった**ことを示します。**HTTP 409** は、上流連携前の**入力妥当性検証**に失敗（例: `documentNumber` の長さ）を示します。**クレジット**は**基本** `/v2/co/cedula` より**高**（解決の連鎖のため）。**CC のみ**、通常 **5～10 桁**の数字。

params.description: コロンビア **CC**（Cédula de Ciudadanía）の番号。正規化で非数字を除去し、**5～10 桁**の数字として検証します。

zh.description: 用哥伦比亚国民身份证（CC）做“可读的本人画像”核验：只填证号。签发日由平台代查，结果丰富度与 cédula extra 相当；比基础核验消耗更多会议费/额度。
zh.overview:
**用途：** 将 **哥伦比亚国民身份证（CC）证号** 与**官方来源**核对，返回适用于 **KYC/合规** 的**结构化身份信息**（**登记姓名、出生日期、签发地及签发时间**；来源返回时可能包含**性别、生存状态**等），并包含**可审计的签名字段**。**请求仅提供证号**；**签发日期在服务端完成解析**（**无需**在请求中提供证件类型或签发日期）。信息粒度与 **cédula extra** 相当；**单次额度消耗**高于**基础** `/v2/co/cedula` 路径，因含链式解析步骤。

**响应：** 返回 **`data`**（针对所提交证号、来源可返回的本人属性）、**`signature`**（对本响应载荷的认证元数据）、**`id`**（请求标识符）。**HTTP 404** 表示在本工作流下**无法**为该证号**组装完整身份记录**。**HTTP 409** 表示在**进入上游处理前**未通过**输入校验**（例如 `documentNumber` 长度）。**每请求额度**高于**基础** `/v2/co/cedula`（链式解析）。**仅 CC**；证号一般 **5～10 位数字**（规范化后）。

params.description: 哥伦比亚 **CC** 国民身份证证号。非数字字符会在服务端剥除。规范化后须为 **5～10** 位数字，以通过接口校验。

es.title: Colombia — Cédula nacional premium (CC)
es.description: Verifica una cédula colombiana (CC) con un perfil completo: escribes solo el número, la plataforma obtiene la fecha de expedición y te devuelve el mismo registro rico que cédula extra. Usa más créditos que la consulta básica de cédula.
es.overview:
**Finalidad:** **verificar** una **Cédula de Ciudadanía (CC)** frente a **fuentes oficiales** y devolver un **registro de identidad estructurado** para procesos de KYC y cumplimiento, no un simple sí/no sobre el número. Incluye **cómo figura el nombre**, **fecha de nacimiento**, **lugar y fecha de expedición** y, cuando las fuentes lo aportan, **género** e **indicación de supervivencia**, con un bloque de **certificación firmada**. Se **envía únicamente el número**; la **fecha de expedición se resuelve en el servidor** (sin tipo de documento ni fecha en la petición). El detalle equivale a [**cédula extra**](../../identity/colombia-full-id.mdx). El consumo de **créditos** es **superior** al de la [**consulta básica**](./colombian-citizen.mdx) por los pasos de resolución adicionales.

**Respuesta:** devuelve **`data`** (atributos de identidad disponibles para el número enviado), **`signature`** (metadatos de certificación del payload) e **`id`** (identificador de la solicitud). **HTTP 404**: no fue posible constituir un registro completo para el número en este flujo. **HTTP 409**: la solicitud no superó la validación de entrada (p. ej. longitud de `documentNumber`) antes de la resolución. El **coste en créditos** por solicitud es **superior** al de `/v2/co/cedula` básico por la cadena de resolución.

params.description: Número de **CC**; el servidor deja solo dígitos. **Entre 5 y 10** caracteres (validación API).

requestExamples.label: GET
POST

notes: Solo **CC**: no se envía `documentType` ni `date`; el flujo resuelve la **fecha de expedición** de forma interna y luego aplica el mismo flujo ampliado que [**cédula extra**](../../identity/colombia-full-id.mdx).
Comparado con [**consulta básica de cédula**](./colombian-citizen.mdx) (`/v2/co/cedula`), devuelve el conjunto **extra** completo a mayor coste en créditos.

fr.title: 🇨🇴 Colombie — Cédula nationale premium (CC)
fr.description: Vérifiez une cédula colombienne (CC) en profondeur : vous ne saisissez que le numéro, Verifik retrouve la date d’expédition, vous obtenez le même dossier d’identité riche qu’avec cédula extra. Coût en crédits supérieur à la vérification cédula de base.
fr.overview:
**Objet :** **vérifier** un numéro de *Cédula de Ciudadanía* (CC) auprès des **sources officielles** et renvoyer un **dossier d’identité structuré** pour les parcours KYC et conformité, et non une simple validation binaire. Le contenu reflète l’**état civil tel qu’enregistré**, la **date de naissance**, le **lieu et la période de délivrance** et, le cas échéant, le **sexe** et l’**indicateur de personne en vie**, avec un bloc de **certification signé**. Seul le **numéro** est transmis : la **date d’expédition est résolue côté serveur** (aucun type de document ni de date dans la requête). Niveau de détail **équivalent à cédula extra**. **Coût en crédits** supérieur à l’**endpoint cédula de base** en raison de la chaîne de résolution.

**Réponse :** retourne **`data`** (attributs d’identité retournés pour le numéro transmis), **`signature`** (métadonnées de certification du jeu de données) et **`id`** (identifiant de requête). **HTTP 404** : impossible de constituer un dossier complet pour ce numéro dans ce flux. **HTTP 409** : échec de la validation d’entrée (p. ex. longueur de `documentNumber`) avant traitement. **Coût en crédits** par requête **supérieur** à `/v2/co/cedula` de base, en raison de la chaîne de résolution.

en.title: 🇨🇱 Chile - Vehicle SOAP (by plate)
en.description: Query Chile vehicular SOAP by license plate only. Returns nested soap and vehicle objects with coverage status, insurer, owner, validity dates, and vehicle details.
en.overview:
Query Chile vehicular **SOAP** (*Seguro Obligatorio de Accidentes Personales*) using **license plate only**. The service resolves SOAP coverage via Boostr, enriches with AACH when a policy number is available, and returns vehicle attributes from Carvuk when SOAP is missing.

Returns a **nested** payload when the source responds:

- **`plate`** — Chilean license plate (Patente), **4–6** alphanumeric characters
- **`message`** — empty when SOAP is found; `No_active_SOAP_certificate_found_for_this_plate` when the vehicle exists but has no active SOAP
- **`soap`** — when found: **`status`**, **`policyNumber`**, **`insuranceCompany`**, **`validFrom`**, **`validTo`**, **`folioNumber`**, **`ownerName`**, **`ownerRut`**, **`premium`**
- **`vehicle`** — **`brand`**, **`model`**, **`year`**, **`type`**, **`engineNumber`**
- **Signed** Verifik response

Use for **insurance compliance**, **fleet onboarding**, and **claims** workflows when only the plate is known.

params.description: Chilean license plate (Patente), 4–6 alphanumeric characters.

requestExamples.label: Node.js
Python

responses.label: 200 SOAP found

notes: **No active SOAP** returns **HTTP 200** with empty **`soap`** and **`message: No_active_SOAP_certificate_found_for_this_plate`** — not a 404.
**Example plates (live):** `CLTK27`, `HTRT86`, `RRWX51`, `THHV64`, `CSXZ52`, `CSXZ57` return active SOAP; `CSXZ27` returns vehicle data with no active SOAP.
**Sandbox mode:** plates **`BBCC12`**–**`BBCC21`** and **`HTRT86`** return stable nested profiles; **`ERR404`** returns **404**.
For plate + policy lookup, see [🇨🇱 Chile - Vehicle SOAP](/vehicle-validation/chile/vehicle-soap).
Registry **availability** is environment-dependent; outages may return **409** timeout errors.

ナンバーのみ判明時の**保険コンプライアンス**、**フリートオンボーディング**、**クレーム**に使用します。

**ナンバー**（`plate`）のみで照会。**`soap`** の **status**, **insuranceCompany**, **ownerName**, **validFrom**, **validTo** および **`vehicle`** の **brand**, **model**, **year** などが含まれます。

en.title: Honduras - Voting Location
en.description: Query official Honduran electoral registry (Donde Me Toca Votar) by DNIHN. Returns polling place, JRV, voting eligibility, and residence details.
en.overview:
Verifik queries the **Donde Me Toca Votar** electoral consultation registry using **DNIHN** (13-digit identity number). Use this endpoint for **electoral verification**, **voter onboarding**, and **compliance** workflows where Honduran electoral data is permitted.

Returns electoral location details when the source provides them:

- **`documentType`** — allowed value: **DNIHN**
- **`documentNumber`** — Honduran identity document number (**13** digits)
- **`fullName`** — citizen full name from the electoral registry
- **`gender`** — gender when provided by the source
- **`department`**, **`municipality`**, **`electoralSector`** — residence and electoral sector
- **`pollingPlace`**, **`pollingTable`** (JRV), **`lineNumber`** — polling location details
- **`enabled`** — whether the citizen is enabled to vote
- **`fullAddress`** — formatted polling address
- **Optional fields** — `latitude`, `longitude` when included by the source
- **Signed** Verifik response

Query the national electoral consultation registry with **`documentType`** `DNIHN` and a **13-digit** **`documentNumber`**. Typical successful responses include polling place, JRV (table), department, municipality, and voting eligibility for **KYC**, **electoral verification**, and **compliance** workflows.

params.description: Document type. Allowed value: `DNIHN`.
Honduran identity document number (**13** digits).

requestExamples.label: JavaScript
Python

notes: **`documentType`** must be **`DNIHN`**; **`documentNumber`** must be exactly **13** numeric digits.
**Sandbox mode:** use padded test IDs **`0000010000001`** through **`0000010000010`** for stable success profiles; **`0000090040401`** returns **404**.
**Source rate limits:** if the electoral registry throttles requests, Verifik may return **409** with `Endpoint_out_of_service` (temporary; retry later).
Treat responses as **sensitive personal data**; comply with applicable privacy laws.
See also: [Honduran Citizen identity lookup](/identity/honduras).

es.title: Honduras - Lugar de Votación
es.description: Consulta el padrón electoral hondureño (Donde Me Toca Votar) por DNIHN. Devuelve centro de votación, JRV, habilitación para votar y datos de residencia.
es.overview:
Verifik consulta el registro nacional de consulta electoral **Donde Me Toca Votar** usando **DNIHN** (número de identidad de **13 dígitos**). Usa este endpoint para **verificación electoral**, **incorporación de votantes** y **cumplimiento** cuando los datos electorales hondureños estén permitidos.

Devuelve detalles del lugar de votación cuando la fuente los proporciona:

- **`documentType`** — valor permitido: **DNIHN**
- **`documentNumber`** — número de identidad hondureño (**13** dígitos)
- **`fullName`** — nombre completo del ciudadano en el padrón electoral
- **`gender`** — sexo cuando la fuente lo proporciona
- **`department`**, **`municipality`**, **`electoralSector`** — residencia y sector electoral
- **`pollingPlace`**, **`pollingTable`** (JRV), **`lineNumber`** — datos del recinto de votación
- **`enabled`** — si el ciudadano está habilitado para votar
- **`fullAddress`** — dirección formateada del recinto
- **Campos opcionales** — `latitude`, `longitude` cuando la fuente los incluye
- Respuesta **firmada** por Verifik

Consulta el registro nacional con **`documentType`** `DNIHN` y un **`documentNumber`** de **13 dígitos**. Las respuestas exitosas incluyen centro de votación, JRV (mesa), departamento, municipio y habilitación para votar en flujos de **KYC**, **verificación electoral** y **cumplimiento**.

params.description: Tipo de documento. Valor permitido: `DNIHN`.
Número de identidad hondureño (**13** dígitos).

requestExamples.label: JavaScript
Python

notes: **`documentType`** debe ser **`DNIHN`**; **`documentNumber`** debe tener exactamente **13** dígitos numéricos.
**Modo sandbox:** usa IDs de prueba con relleno **`0000010000001`** a **`0000010000010`** para perfiles estables; **`0000090040401`** devuelve **404**.
**Límites de la fuente:** si el registro electoral limita solicitudes, Verifik puede devolver **409** con `Endpoint_out_of_service` (temporal; reintenta más tarde).
Trata las respuestas como **datos personales sensibles**; cumple las leyes de privacidad aplicables.
Ver también: [Ciudadano Hondureño](/verifik-es/identidad/honduras).

소스에서 제공할 때 선거 장소 세부 정보를 반환합니다:

- **`documentType`** — 허용 값: **DNIHN**

en.title: Mexico — Professional License
en.description: Look up a Mexican professional license by CURP, license number, or name in the official professional registry.
en.overview:
Confirms that a person holds a professional license (cédula profesional) in the official professional registry. This is credential verification, not identity proofing.

Send **either** a document **or** a name:

- **CURP** (recommended). The registry is checked for licenses tied to that CURP first.
- **License number.** An exact match on the cédula number.
- **Name.** An exact, accent-insensitive match on given names plus both surnames.

A person can hold several licenses, so `cedulas` is an array. For the CURP holder’s civil record, see [Mexican Citizen (CURP)](/identity/mexico). For a voter credential, see [INE Validation](/identity/mexico-ine). For health-only licenses, see [Health Worker License](/identity/mexico-health-worker).

A match returns `fullName`, `matchMethod`, `ambiguous`, and `cedulas[]` with `licenseNumber`, `title`, `profession`, `institution`, and `registrationYear`.

params.description: CURP` or `CEDULA` (case-insensitive).
A CURP of 17–18 characters (uppercased automatically) or a license number.

Both surnames, paternal first. 2–80 characters.

es.title: México — Cédula profesional

es.overview:
Confirma que una persona tiene una cédula profesional en el registro oficial de profesionistas. Es una verificación de credencial, no una prueba de identidad.

Envía **un documento** o **un nombre**:

- **CURP** (recomendado). Primero se consulta el registro en busca de cédulas ligadas a esa CURP.
- **Número de cédula.** Coincidencia exacta con el número de cédula.
- **Nombre.** Coincidencia exacta, sin distinguir acentos, de los nombres de pila más ambos apellidos.

Una persona puede tener varias cédulas, así que `cedulas` es un arreglo. Para el registro civil del titular de la CURP, consulta [Ciudadano mexicano (CURP)](/identity/mexico). Para una credencial de elector, consulta [Validación INE](/identity/mexico-ine). Para cédulas solo de salud, consulta [Licencia de profesionista de salud](/identity/mexico-health-worker).

Una coincidencia devuelve `fullName`, `matchMethod`, `ambiguous` y `cedulas[]` con `licenseNumber`, `title`, `profession`, `institution` y `registrationYear`.

Una CURP de 17–18 caracteres (se pasa a mayúsculas automáticamente) o un número de cédula.
Nombres de pila. De 2 a 80 caracteres.
Ambos apellidos, el paterno primero. De 2 a 80 caracteres.

ko.title: 멕시코 — 전문 면허
ko.description: CURP, 면허 번호 또는 이름으로 공식 전문 면허 등록부에서 멕시코 전문 면허를 조회합니다.
ko.overview:
공식 전문 면허 등록부에서 해당자가 전문 면허(cédula profesional)를 보유하고 있는지 확인합니다. 이것은 자격 검증이며, 신원 증명 자체는 아닙니다.

**문서** 또는 **이름** 중 하나를 보내세요.

- **CURP**(권장). 해당 CURP에 연결된 면허를 등록부에서 먼저 확인합니다.
- **면허 번호.** cédula 번호와 정확히 일치하는 항목입니다.
- **이름.** 이름과 두 성(부성·모성)에 대한 악센트 무시 완전 일치입니다.

한 사람이 여러 면허를 보유할 수 있으므로 `cedulas`는 배열입니다. CURP 소지자의 민사 기록은 [멕시코 시민(CURP)](/verifik-ko/identity/mexico)을 참고하세요. 유권자 자격증은 [INE 검증](/verifik-ko/identity/mexico-ine)을 참고하세요. 보건 면허만 필요하면 [보건 전문가 면허](/verifik-ko/identity/mexico-health-worker)를 참고하세요.

ja.title: メキシコ — 専門免許
ja.description: CURP、免許番号、または氏名で、公式の専門免許登録からメキシコの専門免許を照会します。
ja.overview:
公式の専門免許登録で、対象者が専門免許（cédula profesional）を保有していることを確認します。これは資格の検証であり、本人確認そのものではありません。

**書類**または**氏名**のいずれかを送信します。

- **CURP**（推奨）。その CURP に紐づく免許を登録から先に確認します。
- **免許番号。** cédula 番号との完全一致です。
- **氏名。** 名と二つの姓に対する、アクセントを区別しない完全一致です。

一人が複数の免許を持てるため、`cedulas` は配列です。CURP 保有者の身分記録は [メキシコ市民（CURP）](/verifik-ja/identity/mexico) を参照してください。有権者証は [INE 検証](/verifik-ja/identity/mexico-ine) を参照してください。保健分野の免許のみが必要な場合は [医療従事者の免許](/verifik-ja/identity/mexico-health-worker) を参照してください。

一致すると、`fullName`、`matchMethod`、`ambiguous`、および `licenseNumber`、`title`、`profession`、`institution`、`registrationYear` を含む `cedulas[]` を返します。

params.description: CURP` または `CEDULA`（大文字小文字を区別しません）。

zh.title: 墨西哥 — 专业执照
zh.description: 通过 CURP、执照号码或姓名，在官方专业执照登记册中查询墨西哥专业执照。
zh.overview:
确认某人在官方专业执照登记册中持有专业执照（cédula profesional）。这是资质核验，本身不是身份证明。

发送**证件**或**姓名**之一：

- **CURP**（推荐）。先在登记册中查找与该 CURP 关联的执照。
- **执照号码。** 与 cédula 号码精确匹配。
- **姓名。** 对名加两个姓氏做忽略重音的精确匹配。

一个人可以持有多本执照，因此 `cedulas` 是数组。CURP 持有人的民事记录见 [墨西哥公民（CURP）](/verifik-zh/identity/mexico)。选民凭证见 [INE 验证](/verifik-zh/identity/mexico-ine)。仅需卫生执照时见 [卫生从业人员执照](/verifik-zh/identity/mexico-health-worker)。

匹配时返回 `fullName`、`matchMethod`、`ambiguous`，以及包含 `licenseNumber`、`title`、`profession`、`institution` 和 `registrationYear` 的 `cedulas[]`。

params.description: CURP` 或 `CEDULA`（不区分大小写）。
17–18 个字符的 CURP（自动转为大写）或执照号码。
名。2–80 个字符。
两个姓氏，父姓在前。2–80 个字符。

en.title: Mexico — Health Worker License
en.description: Confirm that a person holds a Mexican health-related professional license. A person with only non-health licenses returns 404.
en.overview:
Confirms that a person holds at least one health-related professional license in the official professional registry. The same lookup modes as [Professional License](/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional) apply: CURP, license number, or name. Non-health licenses are removed from the result.

Health titles include medicine, nursing, dentistry, pharmacy, nutrition, clinical psychology, psychiatry, obstetrics, physiotherapy, and optometry. Veterinary medicine is excluded. A person who only holds non-health licenses returns **404**.

This is credential screening, not identity proofing. For every license, use [Professional License](/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional). For the civil record, use [Mexican Citizen (CURP)](/identity/mexico).

A match returns the same identity fields as the general license endpoint, plus `isHealthWorker: true` and `nonHealthCount` (how many non-health licenses were set aside). `cedulas` contains only the health licenses.

es.title: México — Licencia de profesionista de salud
es.description: Confirma que una persona tiene una licencia profesional mexicana relacionada con la salud. Quien solo tiene licencias ajenas a la salud responde 404.
es.overview:
Confirma que una persona tiene al menos una cédula profesional relacionada con la salud en el registro oficial de profesionistas. Aplican los mismos modos de consulta que en [Cédula profesional](/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional): CURP, número de cédula o nombre. Las cédulas ajenas a la salud se eliminan del resultado.

Los títulos de salud incluyen medicina, enfermería, odontología, farmacia, nutrición, psicología clínica, psiquiatría, obstetricia, fisioterapia y optometría. Se excluye la medicina veterinaria. Una persona que solo tiene cédulas ajenas a la salud responde **404**.

Es un filtro de credencial, no una prueba de identidad. Para todas las cédulas, usa [Cédula profesional](/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional). Para el registro civil, usa [Ciudadano mexicano (CURP)](/identity/mexico).

Una coincidencia devuelve los mismos campos de identidad que el endpoint general de cédulas, más `isHealthWorker: true` y `nonHealthCount` (cuántas cédulas ajenas a la salud se apartaron). `cedulas` contiene solo las cédulas de salud.

params.description: CURP` o `CEDULA` (sin distinguir mayúsculas). Se prefiere CURP para contrataciones de salud.
Una CURP de 17–18 caracteres o un número de cédula.
Nombres de pila. De 2 a 80 caracteres.
Ambos apellidos, el paterno primero. De 2 a 80 caracteres.

fr.title: Mexique — Licence de professionnel de santé
fr.description: Confirmez qu'une personne détient une licence professionnelle mexicaine liée à la santé. Une personne qui ne détient que des licences hors santé retourne 404.
fr.overview:
Confirme qu'une personne détient au moins une licence professionnelle liée à la santé dans le registre officiel des professions. Les mêmes modes de recherche que pour [Mexique — Licence professionnelle](/verifik-fr/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional) s'appliquent : CURP, numéro de licence ou nom. Les licences hors santé sont retirées du résultat.

Les titres de santé comprennent la médecine, les soins infirmiers, l'art dentaire, la pharmacie, la nutrition, la psychologie clinique, la psychiatrie, l'obstétrique, la physiothérapie et l'optométrie. La médecine vétérinaire est exclue. Une personne qui ne détient que des licences hors santé retourne **404**.

Il s'agit d'un contrôle de titres, pas d'une preuve d'identité. Pour l'ensemble des licences, utilisez [Mexique — Licence professionnelle](/verifik-fr/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional). Pour l'état civil, utilisez [Citoyen mexicain (CURP)](/verifik-fr/identity/mexico).

Les deux noms de famille, le paternel en premier. 2 à 80 caractères.

pt.title: México — Licença de profissional de saúde
pt.description: Confirme que uma pessoa possui uma licença profissional mexicana da área da saúde. Quem tem apenas licenças fora da saúde recebe 404.

Confirma que uma pessoa possui pelo menos uma licença profissional da área da saúde no registro oficial de profissionais. Aplicam-se os mesmos modos de consulta de [Licença profissional](/verifik-pt/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional): CURP, número da licença ou nome. ko.title: 멕시코 — 보건 전문가 면허
ko.description: 해당자가 멕시코 보건 관련 전문 면허를 보유했는지 확인합니다. 비보건 면허만 있는 경우 404를 반환합니다.
ko.overview:
공식 전문 면허 등록부에서 해당자가 보건 관련 전문 면허를 하나 이상 보유하고 있는지 확인합니다. [전문 면허](/verifik-ko/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional)와 같은 조회 방식이 적용됩니다. CURP, 면허 번호 또는 이름입니다. 비보건 면허는 결과에서 제외됩니다.

보건 직함에는 의학, 간호, 치의학, 약학, 영양, 임상심리, 정신의학, 조산, 물리치료, 검안이 포함됩니다. 수의학은 제외됩니다. 비보건 면허만 보유한 사람은 **404**를 받습니다.

이것은 자격 선별이며, 신원 증명 자체는 아닙니다. 모든 면허는 [전문 면허](/verifik-ko/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional)를 사용하세요. 민사 기록은 [멕시코 시민(CURP)](/verifik-ko/identity/mexico)을 사용하세요.

일치하면 일반 면허 엔드포인트와 같은 신원 필드에 `isHealthWorker: true`와 `nonHealthCount`(제외된 비보건 면허 수)가 더해집니다. `cedulas`에는 보건 면허만 들어 있습니다.

두 성, 부성 먼저. 2–80자.

ja.title: メキシコ — 医療従事者の免許
ja.description: 対象者がメキシコの保健関連の専門免許を保有していることを確認します。非保健の免許のみの場合は 404 を返します。
ja.overview:
公式の専門免許登録で、対象者が保健関連の専門免許を少なくとも1件保有していることを確認します。[専門免許](/verifik-ja/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional)と同じ照会方式が適用されます。CURP、免許番号、または氏名です。非保健の免許は結果から除かれます。

保健の称号には、医学、看護、歯科、薬学、栄養、臨床心理、精神医学、助産、理学療法、検眼が含まれます。獣医学は除外されます。非保健の免許しか持たない人は **404** を受け取ります。

これは資格のスクリーニングであり、本人確認そのものではありません。すべての免許には [専門免許](/verifik-ja/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional) を使ってください。身分記録には [メキシコ市民（CURP）](/verifik-ja/identity/mexico) を使ってください。

一致すると、一般の免許エンドポイントと同じ身分フィールドに加え、`isHealthWorker: true` と `nonHealthCount`（除外した非保健免許の件数）を返します。`cedulas` には保健の免許だけが入ります。

zh.title: 墨西哥 — 卫生从业人员执照
zh.description: 确认某人持有墨西哥卫生相关专业执照。仅持有非卫生执照时返回 404。
zh.overview:
确认某人在官方专业执照登记册中至少持有一本卫生相关专业执照。查询方式与 [专业执照](/verifik-zh/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional) 相同：CURP、执照号码或姓名。非卫生执照会从结果中移除。

卫生职称包括医学、护理、牙科、药学、营养、临床心理学、精神病学、助产、物理治疗和验光。兽医除外。仅持有非卫生执照的人返回 **404**。

这是资质筛查，本身不是身份证明。查询全部执照请使用 [专业执照](/verifik-zh/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional)。民事记录请使用 [墨西哥公民（CURP）](/verifik-zh/identity/mexico)。

匹配时返回与通用执照端点相同的身份字段，另加 `isHealthWorker: true` 和 `nonHealthCount`（被排除的非卫生执照数量）。`cedulas` 只包含卫生执照。

名。2–80 个字符。

en.title: Mexico — Education Certificate (folio)
en.description: Validate a Mexican electronic education certificate by folio against the official education-certificate registry.
en.overview:
Validates a Mexican electronic education certificate by folio against the official education-certificate registry. Optionally send `fullName` or `curp` to confirm the certificate belongs to that person. When both are sent, `curp` wins. A mismatch returns **409** `name_mismatch`.

This checks the certificate record. It does not prove identity on its own. For a CURP civil record, see [Mexican Citizen (CURP)](/identity/mexico). For a professional license, see [Professional License](/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional).

A match returns `folio`, `fullName`, `status`, `certificateType`, `career`, `institution`, `level`, `studyType`, `average`, `averageText`, `periodStart`, `periodEnd`, `registrationDate`, `laborTraining`, `federalEntity`, and `issueDate`. Empty fields are `null`.

params.description: Folio printed on the electronic certificate. 4–64 characters.
Expected full name. A mismatch returns 409 `name_mismatch`. Ignored when `curp` is also sent. 3–160 characters.
CURP of the person. When sent, it overrides `fullName`. 17–18 characters.

A folio that is not in the registry returns **404**. A name or CURP that does not belong to that certificate returns **409** `name_mismatch`.
Results are cached for up to 7 days.
Sandbox folio `SIGED10000001` returns the sample certificate for `ANA LOPEZ RUIZ`. `fullName=Ana Lopez Ruiz` also returns 200.

When the registry cannot be reached, the response is **409** `Endpoint_out_of_service`. Retry later.
Related: [Mexican Citizen (CURP)](/identity/mexico), [Professional License](/identity/mexico-cedula-profesional), [Health Worker License](/identity/mexico-health-worker).

en.title: Mexico — INE Validation
en.description: Validate a Mexican voter credential (INE) against the electoral registry using CIC, OCR, or clave de elector.
en.overview:
Validate a Mexican **INE** (*Credencial para Votar*) against the electoral registry. Send `documentType=INE` and a primary identifier in `documentNumber`. The API auto-detects whether the value is a **CIC** (9 digits), **OCR** (13 digits), or **clave de elector** (18 characters).

Optional fields cover card-model combinations required by the official source:

- **`citizenIdentifier`** — required for models **E, F, G, H** together with CIC
- **`emissionNumber`** — required for model **C** together with OCR and clave de elector
- **`model`** — optional hint (`C`–`H`) to select the correct field combination

For name and biographical lookup by **CURP**, use **[Mexican Citizen (CURP)](/identity/mexico)** (`v2/mx/curp`). To extract fields from INE images, use **[Mexico — INE OCR](/identity/mexico-ine-ocr)** (`v2/mx/ine/ocr`).

params.description: Allowed value: `INE`.
CIC (9 digits), OCR (13 digits), or clave de elector (18 alphanumeric).
Citizen identifier from the back of the card. Needed for models E–H with CIC.
Emission number. Needed for model C.
Optional card model hint: `C`, `D`, `E`, `F`, `G`, or `H`.

en.title: Mexico — INE OCR
en.description: Extract INE fields with Verifik Gemini OCR, then validate electoral status via Nexcar numbers in one request.
en.overview:
One-shot flow for a Mexican **INE** (*Credencial para Votar*):

1. **Verifik Gemini OCR** extracts credential fields from front (and optional back) images
2. Verifik builds identifier params from that extraction
3. **Nexcar validate** runs with numbers only (no vendor image OCR)
4. Response returns **`ocr`**, **`validation`**, and **`validateParamsUsed`**

Send JSON with:

- **`front`** (required) — public URL or base64 image of the credential front
- **`back`** (optional) — public URL or base64 of the reverse; strongly recommended for CIC, OCR, and MRZ

For numbers-only electoral validation (no images), use **[Mexico — INE Validation](/identity/mexico-ine)** (`GET v2/mx/ine`). For CURP identity lookup, use **[Mexican Citizen (CURP)](/identity/mexico)** (`v2/mx/curp`).

Submit front (and optional back) images. Verifik optimizes image size, runs Gemini OCR, then validates extracted identifiers with Nexcar. Allow client timeouts of at least 60 seconds.

params.description: Front image as a public URL or base64 string (with or without `data:` prefix).
Back image as a public URL or base64 string. Improves CIC/OCR accuracy.

requestExamples.label: Node.js
Python

notes: Billed as **`mexico_api_ine_ocr`** once for the combined Gemini OCR + Nexcar validate shot.
`front` is required; `back` is optional but recommended for CIC, OCR, citizen identifier, and MRZ.
Images are resized/compressed before Gemini to reduce payload size.
If OCR cannot extract a usable identifier (`cic`, `ocr`, or clave de elector), the request returns **409** and Nexcar is not called.
If identifiers are extracted but Nexcar validate fails, the endpoint fails like `GET /v2/mx/ine` with those numbers.
Sandbox: any valid `front` string returns a nested fixture; a `front` value containing `404` returns **404**.
Related: [Mexico — INE Validation](/identity/mexico-ine), [Mexican Citizen (CURP)](/identity/mexico).

es.title: México — OCR INE
es.description: Extrae campos del INE con OCR Gemini de Verifik y valida el estatus electoral con Nexcar (solo números) en una sola petición.
es.overview:
Flujo en un solo request para una **INE** mexicana (*Credencial para Votar*):

1. **OCR Gemini de Verifik** extrae campos del frente (y opcionalmente el reverso)
2. Verifik arma los identificadores a partir de esa extracción
3. **Validación Nexcar** corre solo con números (sin OCR de imágenes del proveedor)
4. La respuesta incluye **`ocr`**, **`validation`** y **`validateParamsUsed`**

Envía JSON con:

- **`front`** (requerido) — URL pública o imagen en base64 del frente
- **`back`** (opcional) — URL pública o base64 del reverso; muy recomendado para CIC, OCR y MRZ

Para validar solo con números (sin imágenes), usa **[México — Validación INE](/identity/mexico-ine)** (`GET v2/mx/ine`). Para CURP, usa **[Ciudadano mexicano (CURP)](/identity/mexico)** (`v2/mx/curp`).

Envía imágenes del frente (y opcionalmente del reverso). Verifik optimiza el tamaño, ejecuta Gemini OCR y valida los identificadores con Nexcar. Usa timeouts de cliente de al menos 60 segundos.

params.description: Imagen del frente como URL pública o base64.
Imagen del reverso como URL pública o base64.

requestExamples.label: Node.js
Python

`front` es requerido; `back` es opcional pero recomendado.
Las imágenes se redimensionan/comprimen antes de Gemini.
Si el OCR no obtiene un identificador usable, responde **409** y no llama a Nexcar.

en.title: Colombia — Citizen lookup by name (SCCRC)
en.description: Reverse-lookup Colombian birth civil registry records by names, sex, and date of birth via GET /v2/co/cedula/by-name (the official national civil registry SCCRC).
en.overview:
Search the **the official national civil registry** birth civil registry (**SCCRC**) using **names**, **sex**, and **date of birth**. Unlike [Colombian citizen by document](/identity-validation/colombia/colombian-citizen), this endpoint is a **reverse lookup** and may return **multiple matches**.

Use this when you know personal identity attributes but not the NUIP/CC, or when you need to confirm possible registry hits before a document-based check.

- **`matches`** — array of civil-registry hits (zero or more)
- **`documentNumber`**, **`documentType`** — NUIP/CC when present on the record
- **`firstName`**, **`lastName`**, **`fullName`**, **`arrayName`** — name parts
- **`sexo`**, **`serial`** — sex and civil-registry serial
- **`oficina`** / **`expeditionPlace`**, **`fecha`** / **`dateOfBirth`** — when Detalle enrichment is available
- **`recordType`** — `REGISTRO CIVIL DE NACIMIENTO`
- A **signed** Verifik response wrapper

Use this endpoint when you need to **find birth registry candidates by name**. The same integration is available as **`POST`** with a JSON body. **`GET`** uses **query parameters** as shown below.

params.description: First given name
First surname
Sex as registered. Allowed: `MASCULINO`, `FEMENINO` (also `M` / `F`)
Date of birth in **`DD/MM/YYYY`**
Second given name
Second surname

requestExamples.label: JavaScript
Python

notes: Always inspect **`matches`**; name queries can return more than one person.
**`fecha`** must be **`DD/MM/YYYY`** (date of birth).
**Sandbox:** name queries map to fixed profiles with document numbers **`10000001`–`10000010`**. Example defaults: `MARIA` / `LOPEZ` / `FEMENINO` / `15/03/1990`.
Temporary source availability issues may surface as **409** (`Endpoint_out_of_service`).

Related: [Colombian citizen by document](/identity-validation/colombia/colombian-citizen), [Civil registry by serial](/identity/colombia-the official national civil registry-serial), [Marriage civil registry](/identity/colombia-the official national civil registry-matrimonio).

es.title: Colombia — Búsqueda de ciudadano por nombre (SCCRC)
es.description: Consulta inversa de registros civiles de nacimiento colombianos por nombres, sexo y fecha de nacimiento mediante GET /v2/co/cedula/by-name (la fuente oficial de registro civil SCCRC).
es.overview:
Consulta el registro civil de nacimiento (**SCCRC**) de la **la fuente oficial de registro civil** usando **nombres**, **sexo** y **fecha de nacimiento**. A diferencia de [ciudadano colombiano por documento](/identity-validation/colombia/colombian-citizen), este endpoint es una **búsqueda inversa** y puede devolver **múltiples coincidencias**.

Úsalo cuando conoces atributos de identidad personal pero no el NUIP/CC, o cuando necesitas confirmar posibles hallazgos en el registro antes de una verificación por documento.

- **`matches`** — arreglo de hallazgos del registro civil (cero o más)
- **`documentNumber`**, **`documentType`** — NUIP/CC cuando está presente en el registro
- **`firstName`**, **`lastName`**, **`fullName`**, **`arrayName`** — partes del nombre
- **`sexo`**, **`serial`** — sexo y serial del registro civil
- **`oficina`** / **`expeditionPlace`**, **`fecha`** / **`dateOfBirth`** — cuando hay enriquecimiento Detalle
- **`recordType`** — `REGISTRO CIVIL DE NACIMIENTO`
- Un wrapper de respuesta Verifik **firmado**

Usa este endpoint cuando necesites **encontrar candidatos del registro de nacimiento por nombre**. La misma integración está disponible como **`POST`** con cuerpo JSON. **`GET`** usa **parámetros de consulta** como se muestra abajo.

params.description: Primer nombre
Primer apellido
Sexo según registro. Permitidos: `MASCULINO`, `FEMENINO` (también `M` / `F`)
Fecha de nacimiento en **`DD/MM/YYYY`**
Segundo nombre
Segundo apellido

requestExamples.label: JavaScript
Python

notes: Siempre inspecciona **`matches`**; las consultas por nombre pueden devolver más de una persona.
**`fecha`** debe ser **`DD/MM/YYYY`** (fecha de nacimiento).
**Sandbox:** las consultas por nombre mapean a perfiles fijos con números de documento **`10000001`–`10000010`**. Valores de ejemplo por defecto: `MARIA` / `LOPEZ` / `FEMENINO` / `15/03/1990`.
Problemas temporales de disponibilidad de la fuente pueden aparecer como **409** (`Endpoint_out_of_service`).

Relacionado: [Ciudadano colombiano por documento](/identity-validation/colombia/colombian-citizen), [Registro civil por serial](/identity/colombia-la fuente oficial de registro civil-serial), [Registro civil de matrimonio](/identity/colombia-la fuente oficial de registro civil-matrimonio).

Interrogez le registre civil de naissance (**SCCRC**) de la **the official national civil registry** à l’aide des **noms**, du **sexe** et de la **date de naissance**. Contrairement à [citoyen colombien par document](/identity-validation/colombia/colombian-citizen), cet endpoint est une **recherche inverse** et peut renvoyer **plusieurs correspondances**.

Utilisez-le lorsque vous connaissez des attributs d’identité personnelle mais pas le NUIP/CC, ou lorsque vous devez confirmer d’éventuels résultats du registre avant une vérification par document.

- **`matches`** — tableau des résultats du registre civil (zéro ou plus)
- **`documentNumber`**, **`documentType`** — NUIP/CC lorsqu’ils sont présents sur l’acte
- **`firstName`**, **`lastName`**, **`fullName`**, **`arrayName`** — parties du nom
- **`sexo`**, **`serial`** — sexe et serial du registre civil
- **`oficina`** / **`expeditionPlace`**, **`fecha`** / **`dateOfBirth`** — lorsque l’enrichissement Detalle est disponible
- **`recordType`** — `REGISTRO CIVIL DE NACIMIENTO`
- Un wrapper de réponse Verifik **signé**

Utilisez cet endpoint lorsque vous devez **trouver des candidats du registre de naissance par nom**. La même intégration est disponible en **`POST`** avec un corps JSON. **`GET`** utilise des **paramètres de requête** comme indiqué ci-dessous.

params.description: Premier prénom

Deuxième prénom
Deuxième nom de famille

Use quando você conhece atributos de identidade pessoal, mas não o NUIP/CC, ou quando precisa confirmar possíveis resultados no registro antes de uma verificação por documento.

NUIP/CC는 모르지만 인적 속성을 알고 있거나, 문서 기반 확인 전에 등록부 후보를 확인해야 할 때 사용합니다.

This complements [citizen by document](/identity-validation/colombia/colombian-citizen) and [lookup by name](/identity-validation/colombia/colombian-citizen-by-name) when you already have the civil-registry serial.

- A **signed** Verifik response wrapper

Use this endpoint when you have the **civil registry serial** and need the linked identity fields. The same integration is available as **`POST`** with a JSON body. **`GET`** uses **query parameters** as shown below.

en.overview:
Look up a **birth civil registry** record (*registro civil de nacimiento*) from **the official national civil registry** (**SCCRC**) using a Colombian **cédula (CC)** document number.

Unlike [citizen by document](/identity-validation/colombia/colombian-citizen) (`/v2/co/cedula`), this endpoint hits **the official national civil registry only** — it does **not** try the official disciplinary oversight authority or DIAN. Use it to isolate SCCRC document-mode behavior.

- **`documentNumber`**, **`documentType`**
- **`firstName`**, **`lastName`**, **`fullName`**, **`arrayName`**
- **`sexo`**, **`serial`**
- **`oficina`** / **`expeditionPlace`**, **`fecha`** / **`dateOfBirth`** when available
- **`recordType`** — `REGISTRO CIVIL DE NACIMIENTO`
- A **signed** Verifik response wrapper

Use this endpoint when you need a **document-only SCCRC** lookup. The same integration is available as **`POST`** with a JSON body. **`GET`** uses **query parameters** as shown below.

params.description: Must be **`CC`**
Colombian cédula number

requestExamples.label: JavaScript
Python

notes: **`documentType`** must be **`CC`**.
SCCRC document search may return **404** even when [by-name](/identity-validation/colombia/colombian-citizen-by-name) finds the same person — upstream recall differs by search mode.
Temporary source availability issues may surface as **409** (`Endpoint_out_of_service`).

Related: [Citizen by document](/identity-validation/colombia/colombian-citizen), [Citizen by name](/identity-validation/colombia/colombian-citizen-by-name), [Civil registry by serial](/identity/colombia-the official national civil registry-serial).

es.overview:
Consulta un registro civil de **nacimiento** (*registro civil de nacimiento*) de la **la fuente oficial de registro civil** (**SCCRC**) usando el número de **cédula (CC)**.

A diferencia de [ciudadano por documento](/identity-validation/colombia/colombian-citizen) (`/v2/co/cedula`), este endpoint usa **solo la fuente oficial de registro civil** — **no** intenta la entidad oficial de control disciplinario ni DIAN. Úsalo para aislar el comportamiento de SCCRC en modo documento.

- **`sexo`**, **`serial`**
- **`oficina`** / **`expeditionPlace`**, **`fecha`** / **`dateOfBirth`** cuando aplica

Typical fields: `documentType`, `documentNumber`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `fullName`, `arrayName`. Use `/v2/co/cedula` when you want Verifik to try multiple government sources. Use `/v2/co/the official disciplinary oversight authority/antecedentes` when you need disciplinary history.

ja.title: コロンビア — the official disciplinary oversight authority による市民照会
ja.description: GET/POST /v2/co/the official disciplinary oversight authority でコロンビアの書類を検証し氏名を抽出します（the official disciplinary oversight authority のみ、懲戒記録なし）。
ja.overview:
コロンビアの書類番号を検証し、**the official disciplinary oversight authority** から**氏名**を抽出します。この公式ソースは *Cédula de ciudadanía*（**CC**）、*Cédula de extranjería*（**CE**）、*Permiso Especial de Permanencia*（**PEP**）、*NIT*、*Permiso por Protección Temporal*（**PPT**）をサポートします。

[書類番号による市民照会](/identity-validation/colombia/colombian-citizen)（`/v2/co/cedula`）と異なり、このエンドポイントは **the official disciplinary oversight authority のみ**を呼び出し、DIAN、ADRES、the official national civil registry は試しません。[懲戒記録](/verifik-ja/background-check/colombia-disciplinary-records-attorneys-office)（`/v2/co/the official disciplinary oversight authority/antecedentes`）と異なり、`antecedentes` や `legend` は返し**ません**。

- **`documentNumber`**、**`documentType`**
- **`firstName`**、**`lastName`**、**`fullName`**、**`arrayName`**
- **署名付き** Verifik レスポンス

the official disciplinary oversight authority から**氏名だけ**が必要な場合、`/cedula` の他ソースが扱わない書類種別を含める場合にこのエンドポイントを使います。同じ連携は JSON 本文の **`POST`** でも利用できます。**`GET`** は**クエリパラメータ**を使います。

典型的なフィールド: `documentType`、`documentNumber`、`firstName`、`lastName`、`fullName`、`arrayName`。複数の政府ソースを統合する場合は `/v2/co/cedula` を使います。懲戒履歴が必要な場合は `/v2/co/the official disciplinary oversight authority/antecedentes` を使います。

验证哥伦比亚证件号码，并从 **the official disciplinary oversight authority** 提取**姓名**。该官方来源支持 *Cédula de ciudadanía*（**CC**）、*Cédula de extranjería*（**CE**）、*Permiso Especial de Permanencia*（**PEP**）、*NIT* 和 *Permiso por Protección Temporal*（**PPT**）。

en.title: 🇨🇱 Chile - Stolen Vehicle
en.description: Query whether a Chilean vehicle has an active stolen or theft report (encargo por robo o hurto).
en.overview:
Check whether a Chilean vehicle has an active **stolen or theft report** (*encargo por robo o hurto*).

Returns a signed payload when the lookup succeeds:

- **`plate`** — Chilean license plate (Patente), **4–7** alphanumeric characters
- **`hasTheftReport`** — `true` when there is an active theft report; `false` otherwise
- **`description`** — status text (e.g. `NO REGISTRA ENCARGO Vigentes`)
- **`theftReport`** — report object: **`typeCode`**, **`plateOriginal`**, **`plateFormatted`**, **`reportDate`**, **`partiallyResolved`**, **`items`**
- **`items[]`** — stolen parts: **`name`**, **`description`**, **`serial`**, **`resolvedDate`**, **`delivered`**, **`deliveryDate`**, **`type`**
- **Signed** Verifik response

Use for **insurance underwriting**, **fleet onboarding**, and **asset due diligence** before registering or financing a Chilean vehicle.

Typical fields: **`plate`**, **`hasTheftReport`**, **`description`**, and nested **`theftReport`**. A vehicle with no active encargo still returns **HTTP 200**.

params.description: Chilean license plate (Patente), 4–7 alphanumeric characters.

requestExamples.label: Node.js
Python

responses.label: 200 No active report
200 Stolen report found

notes: **No active theft report** returns **HTTP 200** with **`hasTheftReport: false`** — not a 404.
**Sandbox mode:** plate **`PTKX93`** returns a stable no-encargo profile; **`NG8245`** returns a stolen-report profile.
Invalid plate format returns **409** `invalid_plate_format`.
Registry **availability** is environment-dependent; outages may return **409** timeout errors.

en.title: 🇨🇴 Colombia — National ID status (CC)
en.description: Return the official national civil registry vigencia for a Colombian CC: exists, alive, or cancelled by death. No identity profile.
en.overview:
**Purpose:** return the **the official national civil registry vigencia** classification for a Colombian **Cédula de Ciudadanía (CC)** — whether the number **exists**, and if it does, whether the holder is **alive** or **deceased**. This is **not** a full identity lookup: it does **not** return names, dates, or the official identity verification service data.

**Submit only the document number** (digits, **5–10**). There is no `documentType` on this route; the number is always treated as **CC**.

**HTTP 200** when the official national civil registry returns a classified status:

- **Does not exist** — `exists: false`, `isAlive: null`, `documentStatus: "CEDULA NO EXISTE"`
- **Valid / alive** — `exists: true`, `isAlive: true`, `documentStatus` is the raw vigencia string (e.g. `VIGENTE (VIVO)`)
- **Cancelled by death** — `exists: true`, `isAlive: false`, `documentStatus` is the raw string (e.g. `CANCELADA POR MUERTE`)

**HTTP 404** when the source times out or the status cannot be classified. **HTTP 409** when `documentNumber` fails validation. Credits are charged only on a classified **200**.

params.description: CC number, **digits only** after normalization. **5–10** characters.

requestExamples.label: GET
POST

notes: **CC only** — there is no `documentType` on this route.
A classified miss (`CEDULA NO EXISTE`) is **HTTP 200** on this endpoint. The same miss on `/v2/co/cedula` remains **HTTP 404** and is billed at this feature’s price.

es.title: 🇨🇴 Colombia — Estado de cédula (CC)
es.description: Devuelve la vigencia de la fuente oficial de registro civil de una CC: existe, vigente o cancelada por muerte. Sin perfil de identidad.
es.overview:
**Propósito:** devolver la clasificación de **vigencia de la fuente oficial de registro civil** de una **Cédula de Ciudadanía (CC)** colombiana: si el número **existe** y, de existir, si el titular está **vivo** o **fallecido**. **No** es una consulta de identidad completa: no retorna nombres, fechas ni datos de el servicio oficial de validación de identidad.

**Envíe solo el número de documento** (dígitos, **5–10**). No hay `documentType` en esta ruta; el número siempre se trata como **CC**.

**HTTP 200** cuando la fuente oficial de registro civil devuelve un estado clasificado:

- **No existe** — `exists: false`, `isAlive: null`, `documentStatus: "CEDULA NO EXISTE"`
- **Vigente / vivo** — `exists: true`, `isAlive: true`, `documentStatus` es la cadena cruda (p. ej. `VIGENTE (VIVO)`)
- **Cancelada por muerte** — `exists: true`, `isAlive: false`, `documentStatus` es la cadena cruda (p. ej. `CANCELADA POR MUERTE`)

**HTTP 404** si la fuente no responde o el estado no se puede clasificar. **HTTP 409** si `documentNumber` no pasa validación. Se cobran créditos solo en un **200** clasificado.

params.description: Número de CC, **solo dígitos** tras normalización. **5–10** caracteres.

requestExamples.label: GET
POST

notes: **Solo CC** — no hay `documentType` en esta ruta.
Un miss clasificado (`CEDULA NO EXISTE`) es **HTTP 200** aquí. El mismo miss en `/v2/co/cedula` sigue siendo **HTTP 404** y se factura al precio de este feature.
